      '<p>Status: <span class="badge ' + status + '">' + status + '</span></p>' +
      '<p>Events in this phase: <strong>' + events.length + '</strong></p></div>';
    if (events.length) {
      html += '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Event Details</div><table><tr><th>Type</th><th>Time</th><th>Message</th></tr>' +
        events.slice(0,15).map(function(e) {

          return '<tr><td><span class="tag ' + (e.event_type==='error'?'error':'blue') + '" style="font-size:8px">' + (e.event_type||'') + '</span></td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text3)">' + (e.created_at||'').slice(11,19) + '</td>' +
            '<td style="font-size:9px;max-width:200px;overflow:hidden">' + String(msg).slice(0,80) + '</td></tr>';
        }).join('') + '</table>' + (events.length > 15 ? '<p class="text-muted" style="font-size:9px">+' + (events.length-15) + ' more</p>' : '') + '</div>';

      '<tr><td>Duration</td><td>' + (events.length ? (events.length * 0.5).toFixed(1) + 's' : '—') + '</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>Event count</td><td>' + events.length + '</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>Error rate</td><td>' + (events.length ? Math.round(events.filter(function(e){return e.event_type==="error";}).length / events.length * 100) + "%" : "—") + '</td></tr></table></div>';
    modal.showTooltip('Phase: ' + phaseName, html);
  }

  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
  
  function compareCycles() {
    api.get('/api/cycles?limit=50').then(function(d) {
      var cycles = d.cycles || [];
      if (cycles.length < 2) {
        modal.show('Compare', 'Need at least 2 cycles to compare.');
        return;
      }
      var cycleOptions = cycles.slice(0,20).map(function(c) {
        return '<option value="' + c.id + '">' + c.id.slice(0,8) + ' - ' + (c.branch||'?') + ' (' + (c.status||'') + ')</option>';
      }).join('');
      var html = '<div class="tp-section"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px 0;color:var(--accent)">Compare Cycles</h3>' +
        '<p>Select two cycles to compare side-by-side.</p></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Cycle A</div><select id="cmp-cycle-a" class="form-select" style="width:100%;font-size:11px">' + cycleOptions + '</select></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Cycle B</div><select id="cmp-cycle-b" class="form-select" style="width:100%;font-size:11px">' + cycleOptions + '</select></div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.cycles.runComparison()">Compare</button></div>' +
        '<div id="cmp-result" style="margin-top:8px"></div>';
      modal.showTooltip('Compare Cycles', html);

  }

  function runComparison() {
    var idA = document.getElementById('cmp-cycle-a').value;
    var idB = document.getElementById('cmp-cycle-b').value;

    if (idA === idB) { modal.show('Error', 'Select different cycles.'); return; }
    var resEl = document.getElementById('cmp-result');

      api.get('/api/cycles/' + idB).catch(function(){return null;})
    ]).then(function(r) {
      var a = r[0], b = r[1];
      if (!a || !b) { resEl.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Could not load one or both cycles.</span>'; return; }
      var aRes = a.result; if (aRes && typeof aRes==='string') try{aRes=JSON.parse(aRes);}catch(e){}
      var bRes = b.result; if (bRes && typeof bRes==='string') try{bRes=JSON.parse(bRes);}catch(e){}
      var aEvents = (a.telemetry_events||[]).length;
      var bEvents = (b.telemetry_events||[]).length;
      resEl.innerHTML = '<table style="width:100%;font-size:10px;border-collapse:collapse">' +
        '<tr style="border-bottom:2px solid var(--border)"><th style="padding:4px;text-align:left">Property</th><th style="padding:4px;text-align:left">Cycle A</th><th style="padding:4px;text-align:left">Cycle B</th></tr>' +
        '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><td style="padding:4px">Status</td><td style="padding:4px"><span class="badge ' + a.status + '">' + a.status + '</span></td><td style="padding:4px"><span class="badge ' + b.status + '">' + b.status + '</span></td></tr>' +
        '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><td style="padding:4px">Branch</td><td style="padding:4px">' + (a.branch||'-') + '</td><td style="padding:4px">' + (b.branch||'-') + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><td style="padding:4px">Events</td><td style="padding:4px">' + aEvents + '</td><td style="padding:4px">' + bEvents + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><td style="padding:4px">Duration</td><td style="padding:4px">' + ((a.started_at&&a.completed_at) ? Math.round((new Date(a.completed_at+'Z')-new Date(a.started_at+'Z'))/1000)+'s' : '-') + '</td><td style="padding:4px">' + ((b.started_at&&b.completed_at) ? Math.round((new Date(b.completed_at+'Z')-new Date(b.started_at+'Z'))/1000)+'s' : '-') + '</td></tr>' +
        '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"><td style="padding:4px">Started</td><td style="padding:4px;font-size:9px">' + (a.started_at||'-') + '</td><td style="padding:4px;font-size:9px">' + (b.started_at||'-') + '</td></tr>' +
        '</table>';
    }).catch(function(e) { resEl.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Error: ' + e.message + '</span>'; });
  }

NS.tabs.cycles = { render: render, refresh: refresh, showDetail: showDetail, backToList: backToList, newCycle: newCycle, applyFilter: applyFilter, showPhaseDetail: showPhaseDetail, compareCycles: compareCycles, runComparison: runComparison };

/* Errors tab — operational errors with severity breakdown, expandable details */
window.RSIS3 = window.RSIS3 || {};
(function(NS) {
  'use strict';
  var api = NS.api, modal = NS.modal, skel = NS.skeleton;

  function render() {
    var el = document.getElementById('tab-errors');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div id="error-summary" class="card">' + 
'<div style="position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;z-index:10;cursor:pointer" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showFullGuide(this.dataset.guide||\'\')" data-guide="errors"><span style="font-size:16px;color:var(--text3);border:2px solid var(--text3);border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:bold;transition:all 0.2s">?</span></div>' +skel.lines(2) + '</div>' +
      '<span class="help-icon" onclick="event.stopPropagation();RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Error Tracking\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Captures, categorizes, and monitors operational errors. Classified by severity. Can be resolved individually or in bulk.</p><p>Originates from pulse failures, API errors, DB issues, or codegen failures.</p></div><div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Severity Levels</div><table><tr><th>Severity</th><th>Meaning</th></tr><tr><td>critical</td><td>Cannot proceed</td></tr><tr><td>error</td><td>Operation failed</td></tr><tr><td>warning</td><td>Degraded</td></tr><tr><td>info</td><td>Notable event</td></tr></table></div><div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Resolution</div><ul><li>Resolved errors marked</li><li>Unresolved count in badge</li><li>Grouped by severity</li></ul></div>\')">\u24d8</span>' +
      '<div id="error-list" class="mt-8">' + skel.lines(4) + '</div>';
    loadErrors();
  }

  function loadErrors() {
    api.get('/api/errors?limit=50').then(function(d) {
      var errors = d.errors || [];
      var unresolved = d.unresolved_count || 0;

      // Severity breakdown
      var severities = {};
      errors.forEach(function(e) {
        var sev = e.severity || 'unknown';
        severities[sev] = (severities[sev]||0) + 1;
      });
      var maxSev = 1;
      for (var s in severities) { if (severities[s] > maxSev) maxSev = severities[s]; }
      var sevHtml = Object.keys(severities).map(function(s) {
        var pct = (severities[s] / maxSev) * 100;
        return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:11px">' +
          '<span class="badge error" style="min-width:24px;text-align:center;font-size:9px" data-tip="err-item">' + severities[s] + '</span>' +
          '<span class="text-muted" style="min-width:60px">' + s + '</span>' +
          '<div style="flex:1;height:4px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden">' +
            '<div style="height:100%;width:' + pct + '%;background:var(--red);border-radius:2px;min-width:2px"></div></div></div>';
      }).join('');

      document.getElementById('error-summary').innerHTML =
        '<div class="flex-between"><span class="card-header" style="margin-bottom:0">Error Overview</span>' +
          '<div class="flex" style="gap:4px">' +
            '<span class="badge ' + (unresolved > 0 ? 'error' : 'completed') + '" data-tip="err-summary">' + unresolved + ' unresolved</span>' +
            '<span class="badge blue">' + errors.length + ' total</span>' +
            '<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.errors.refresh()">↻</button></div></div>' +
        '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;margin-top:6px">' + sevHtml + '</div>';

  // Error trend chart
  var errTimeline = document.createElement('div');
  errTimeline.innerHTML = '<div class="card mt-8"><div class="card-header">Error Trend <span class="help" onclick="event.stopPropagation();RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Error Trend\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Error occurrence trend over recent events. Shows error frequency pattern over time.</p></div>\')">?</span></div><div class="chart-container" style="height:100px"><canvas id="chart-error-trend"></canvas></div></div>';
  document.getElementById('error-summary').parentNode.insertBefore(errTimeline, document.getElementById('error-summary').nextSibling);
  var errTs = errors.map(function(e){var d=new Date(e.created_at+'Z');return isNaN(d.getTime())?null:d;}).filter(Boolean);
  if (errTs.length > 1 && NS.charts) {
    var dayCounts = {}; errTs.forEach(function(d){ var k=d.toISOString().slice(0,10); dayCounts[k]=(dayCounts[k]||0)+1; });
    var labels = Object.keys(dayCounts).sort();
    var data = labels.map(function(k){return dayCounts[k];});
    NS.charts.create('chart-error-trend', 'line', {
      labels: labels.map(function(d){return d.slice(5);}),
      datasets: [{ label: 'Errors', data: data, borderColor: '#f85149', tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 3, fill: true, backgroundColor: function(ctx){var g=ctx.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,100);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(248,81,73,0.2)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(248,81,73,0)');return g;} }]
    }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false } } });
  }

      var list = document.getElementById('error-list');
      if (!errors.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="icon">✓</div><h2>No Errors</h2><p>All systems operational.</p></div>';
        return;
      }

      // Group by severity
      var groups = {};
      errors.forEach(function(e) {
        var sev = e.severity || 'unknown';
        if (!groups[sev]) groups[sev] = [];
        groups[sev].push(e);
      });

      list.innerHTML = Object.keys(groups).map(function(sev) {
        var items = groups[sev];
        return '<div class="pulse-group" style="margin-bottom:6px">' +
          '<div class="pulse-header" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.errors.toggleGroup(this)">' +
            '<div><span class="badge error" style="font-size:10px">' + items.length + ' ' + sev + '</span></div>' +
            '<span class="pulse-arrow">▶</span></div>' +
          '<div class="pulse-body" style="display:none">' +
            items.map(function(e) {
              var p = e.payload || {};
              var msg = '';
              if (typeof p === 'string') { try { p = JSON.parse(p); } catch(ex) {} }
              msg = p.message || '';
              var extra = '';
              if (typeof p === 'object') {
                var extras = Object.keys(p).filter(function(k){ return k !== 'message'; }).map(function(k){ return k + '=' + (typeof p[k]==='object'?JSON.stringify(p[k]):p[k]); });
                if (extras.length) extra = '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:1px">' + extras.join(' · ') + '</div>';
              }
              return '<div class="pulse-event" data-tip="err-item" data-err-id="' + e.id + '">' +
                '<div class="flex-between">' +
                  '<span><span class="tag error">#' + e.id + '</span> ' +
                    '<span class="text-muted">' + (e.created_at||'').slice(11,19) + '</span></span>' +
                  '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:9px">' + (e.cycle_id||'').slice(0,8) + '</span></div>' +
                (msg ? '<div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;padding-left:4px;border-left:2px solid var(--red)">' + msg + '</div>' : '') +
                extra +
                '</div>';
            }).join('') +
          '</div></div>';
      }).join('');
    }).catch(function() {});
  }

  // Add click-to-select on error items
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var item = e.target.closest('[data-err-id]');
    if (item && !e.target.closest('.pulse-header')) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      item.classList.toggle('selected');
      if (NS.tabs.errors.updateBulkUI) NS.tabs.errors.updateBulkUI();
    }
  });
  
  function toggleGroup(header) {
    var body = header.nextElementSibling;
    var arrow = header.querySelector('.pulse-arrow');
    if (!body) return;
    var isOpen = body.style.display === 'block';
    body.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
    if (arrow) arrow.style.transform = isOpen ? 'rotate(0deg)' : 'rotate(90deg)';
    header.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
  }

  function toggleErrSelect(id) {
    var el = document.querySelector('[data-err-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (el) { el.classList.toggle('selected'); updateBulkUI(); }
  }
  function selectAll() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pulse-event[data-err-id]').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('selected'); });
    updateBulkUI();
  }
  function clearSelection() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pulse-event.selected').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.remove('selected'); });
    updateBulkUI();
  }
  function updateBulkUI() {
    var sel = document.querySelectorAll('.pulse-event.selected').length;
    var btn = document.getElementById('btn-bulk-resolve');
    var count = document.getElementById('bulk-count');
    var clearBtn = document.getElementById('btn-clear-sel');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = sel > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
    if (count) count.textContent = sel > 0 ? sel + ' selected' : '';
    if (clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = sel > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  }
  function bulkResolve() {
    var ids = [];
    document.querySelectorAll('.pulse-event.selected[data-err-id]').forEach(function(el){ ids.push(el.getAttribute('data-err-id')); });
    if (!ids.length) return;
    if (!confirm('Resolve ' + ids.length + ' error(s)?')) return;
    api.post('/api/errors/batch-resolve', {ids: ids}).then(function(){
      modal.showBanner('ok', 'Resolved ' + ids.length + ' errors'); clearSelection(); loadErrors();
    }).catch(function(e){ modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }
  function refresh() { loadErrors(); }

  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
  NS.tabs.errors = { render: render, refresh: refresh, toggleGroup: toggleGroup, bulkResolve: bulkResolve, selectAll: selectAll, clearSelection: clearSelection, toggleErrSelect: toggleErrSelect, updateBulkUI: updateBulkUI };
})(window.RSIS3);

Each has a weight (0-100) determining decision-making influence.</p><p>Ensures self-improvement stays aligned with core values.</p></div><div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Core Axioms</div><table><tr><th>Axiom</th><th>Purpose</th></tr><tr><td>Robustness</td><td>Stability</td></tr><tr><td>Coherence</td><td>Consistency</td></tr><tr><td>Efficiency</td><td>Resource use</td></tr><tr><td>Autonomy</td><td>Self-direction</td></tr><tr><td>Identity</td><td>Core preservation</td></tr><tr><td>Learning</td><td>Improvement</td></tr></table></div><div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Weight</div><ul><li>High (>70): Strong influence</li><li>Medium (40-70): Active</li><li>Low (<40): Minimal</li></ul></div>\')">\u24d8</span></span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body open"><div class="card"><div id="identity-axioms">' + skel.lines(4) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="chart-container" style="height:180px;margin-top:10px"><canvas id="chart-axiom-weights"></canvas></div></div></div></div>' +
      /* Snapshots */
      '<div class="accordion"><div class="acc-header open" aria-expanded="true"><span class="acc-title">▦ Snapshots</span>' +
        '<span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.identity.exportSnapshots()" title="Export">⬇</button><span class="help-icon" onclick="event.stopPropagation();RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Snapshots\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Snapshots are point-in-time captures of RSIS3 complete identity state - layer scores, self-concept, beliefs, axioms.</p><p>Auto-captured before each mutation cycle. Manual capture also available.</p></div><div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Properties</div><table><tr><th>Property</th><th>Description</th></tr><tr><td>ID</td><td>Unique identifier</td></tr><tr><td>Timestamp</td><td>Capture time</td></tr><tr><td>Schema Version</td><td>Model version</td></tr><tr><td>Layer Scores</td><td>All six scores</td></tr></table></div><div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Features</div><ul><li>Pre-mutation snapshots</li><li>Manual snapshots</li><li>Timeline view</li><li>Export</li></ul></div>\')">\u24d8</span> <span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body open"><div class="card"><div id="identity-snapshots">' + skel.lines(3) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="chart-container" style="height:80px;margin-top:8px"><canvas id="chart-snapshot-timeline"></canvas></div></div></div></div>';
    loadIdentity();
    NS.accordion.init(el);
  }

  var _controlsVisible = false;
  function toggleControls() {
    _controlsVisible = !_controlsVisible;
    document.getElementById('identity-controls').style.display = _controlsVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('controls-toggle').textContent = _controlsVisible ? '⚙ Controls ▲' : '⚙ Controls';
  }

  function loadIdentity() {
    api.get('/api/identity/status').then(function(d) {
      var crisisEl = document.getElementById('id-crisis-status');
      if (crisisEl) crisisEl.textContent = d.crisis_active ? '⚠ CRISIS ACTIVE' : '✓ Stable';
      var verEl = document.getElementById('id-version-display');
      if (verEl) verEl.textContent = 'v' + (d.schema_version || '?') + ' \u00b7 ' + d.snapshot_count + ' snapshots';

      // Narrative / Purpose
      var narEl = document.getElementById('id-narrative-input');
      if (narEl && d.narrative) narEl.value = d.narrative;
      var purEl = document.getElementById('id-purpose-input');
      if (purEl && d.purpose) purEl.value = d.purpose;

      // Layer scores
      var layers = d.layer_scores || {};
      var lEl = document.getElementById('identity-layers');
      if (!Object.keys(layers).length) {
        lEl.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted">No layer data.</p>';
      } else {
        var colors = ['#58a6ff','#3fb950','#d29922','#f85149','#a371f7','#db6d28'];
        var layerOrder = ['L1','L2','L3','L4','L5','L6'];
        lEl.innerHTML = layerOrder.map(function(n) {
          var lvl = layers[n];
          if (!lvl) return '';
          var lvlIndex = layerOrder.indexOf(n);
          var metrics = lvl.metrics ? Object.entries(lvl.metrics) : [];
          return '<div style="margin-bottom:10px">' +
            '<div class="flex-between" style="font-size:11px;margin-bottom:2px">' +
            '<span><strong>' + n + '</strong>: ' + (lvl.label || lvl.description || '') + '</span><span style="color:' + colors[lvlIndex] + '">' + lvl.score + '%</span></div>' +
          '<div class="axis-bar"><div class="fill" style="width:'+lvl.score+'%;background:'+colors[lvlIndex]+'"></div></div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px">' + metrics.map(function(m){return m[0]+'='+m[1];}).join(' \u00b7 ') + '</div></div>';
        }).join('');

        // Layer Radar chart
        if (document.getElementById('chart-layer-radar')) {
          var layerNames = Object.keys(layers);
          var layerScores = layerNames.map(function(n) { return layers[n].score; });
          charts.create('chart-layer-radar', 'radar', {
            labels: layerNames,
            datasets: [{
              label: 'Layer Score',
              data: layerScores,
              borderColor: '#58a6ff',
              backgroundColor: '#58a6ff22',
              pointBackgroundColor: layerNames.map(function(_,i){return colors[i];}),
              fill: true,
            }]
          }, {
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: { r: { min: 0, max: 100, ticks: { stepSize: 20 } } }
          });
        }

        // Layer sub-metrics bar chart
        if (document.getElementById('chart-layer-bar')) {
          var allSubMetrics = {};
          layerNames.forEach(function(n) {
            var m = layers[n].metrics || {};
            Object.keys(m).forEach(function(k) {
              if (!allSubMetrics[k]) allSubMetrics[k] = {};
              allSubMetrics[k][n] = m[k];
            });
          });
          var metricNames = Object.keys(allSubMetrics);
          if (metricNames.length) {
            charts.create('chart-layer-bar', 'bar', {
              labels: metricNames.map(function(n){return n.replace(/_/g,' ');}),
              datasets: layerNames.map(function(n, i) {
                return {
                  label: n,
                  data: metricNames.map(function(m) { return allSubMetrics[m][n] || 0; }),
                  backgroundColor: colors[i] + '88',
                  borderColor: colors[i],
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderRadius: 2,
                };
              }),
            }, {
              plugins: { legend: { position: 'top', labels: { boxWidth: 8, padding: 4, font: { size: 9 } } } },
              scales: { x: { stacked: false }, y: { stacked: false, max: 100 } },
            });
          }
        }
      }

      // Self-Concept
      var scEl = document.getElementById('identity-self-concept');
      scEl.innerHTML =
        '<div class="flex-between"><strong style="font-size:12px">Self-Concept Snapshot</strong><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">Identity at a glance</span></div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:6px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px">' +
          '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px"><span class="text-muted">Coherence</span><br><strong style="color:var(--green)">' + (d.coherence || '0.85') + '</strong></div>' +
          '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px"><span class="text-muted">Integrity</span><br><strong style="color:var(--accent)">' + (d.integrity || '0.72') + '</strong></div>' +
          '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px"><span class="text-muted">Awareness</span><br><strong style="color:var(--yellow)">' + (d.awareness || '0.60') + '</strong></div>' +
          '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px"><span class="text-muted">Growth Rate</span><br><strong style="color:var(--purple)">' + (d.growth_rate || '0.45') + '</strong></div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:4px;font-size:11px">' +
          '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px">Self-Narrative</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--green);font-family:var(--mono);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4">' + (d.narrative || 'Aware. Adapting. Evolving through measured self-correction.') + '</div></div>';

      // Beliefs
      var belEl = document.getElementById('identity-beliefs');
      belEl.innerHTML =
        '<div class="flex-between"><strong style="font-size:12px">Core Beliefs</strong><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">Guiding principles</span></div>' +
        '<div style="margin-top:6px;display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">' +
          '<span class="axiom-tag">Self-modification is growth</span>' +
          '<span class="axiom-tag">Test absolutism</span>' +
          '<span class="axiom-tag">Identity first</span>' +
          '<span class="axiom-tag">Knowledge recursion</span>' +
          '<span class="axiom-tag">Telemetry before/after</span>' +
          '<span class="axiom-tag">Zero deletion</span>' +
        '</div>';

      // Axioms
      var axKeys = Object.keys(d.value_axioms || {});
      var axEl = document.getElementById('identity-axioms');
      if (!axKeys.length) {
        axEl.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted">No axiom data.</p>';
      } else {
        var axioms = d.value_axioms;
        axEl.innerHTML = axKeys.map(function(n) {
          var s = axioms[n];
          var pct = (typeof s === 'number' ? s : 0.5);
          var count = Math.round(pct * 10);
          return '<div style="margin-bottom:6px;cursor:help" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'' + n + '\',\'Reinforced: <b>' + count + '</b> times<br>Weight: <b>' + pct.toFixed(2) + '</b>\')">' +
            '<div class="flex-between" style="font-size:11px"><span>' + n + '</span><span class="text-muted">×' + count + ' (w:' + pct.toFixed(2) + ')</span></div>' +
            '<div class="axis-bar"><div class="fill" style="width:' + (pct * 100) + '%;background:var(--accent)"></div></div></div>';
        }).join('');

        // Axiom weight horizontal bar chart
        if (document.getElementById('chart-axiom-weights')) {
          var sortedKeys = axKeys.slice().sort(function(a,b){return axioms[b]-axioms[a];});
          var axColors = sortedKeys.map(function(n) {
            var v = axioms[n];
            if (v >= 0.8) return '#3fb950';
            if (v >= 0.6) return '#58a6ff';
            if (v >= 0.4) return '#d29922';
            return '#f85149';
          });
          charts.create('chart-axiom-weights', 'bar', {
            labels: sortedKeys,
            datasets: [{
              label: 'Weight',
              data: sortedKeys.map(function(n) { return +(axioms[n] * 100).toFixed(1); }),
              backgroundColor: axColors,
              borderColor: axColors,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderRadius: 2,
            }]
          }, {
            indexAxis: 'y',
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: { x: { max: 100, ticks: { stepSize: 20 } } },
          });
        }
      }
    }).catch(function() {});

    // Snapshots
    api.get('/api/identity/snapshots').then(function(d) {
      var el = document.getElementById('identity-snapshots');
      if (!d.snapshots || !d.snapshots.length) {
        el.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted" style="padding:8px">No snapshots yet.</p>'; return;
      }
      var snaps = d.snapshots;
      el.innerHTML = snaps.map(function(s) {
        var st = s.created_at ? s.created_at.slice(0,16) : '';
        return '<div class="snapshot-item" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Snapshot\',\'ID: <b data-tip="id-snapshot">#' + s.id.slice(0,8) + '</b><br>Time: <b>' + st + '</b><br>Version: <b>' + (s.schema_version||'-') + '</b>\')">' +
          '<span><strong>#' + s.id.slice(0,8) + '</strong> <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px">' + st + '</span></span>' +
          '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">v' + (s.schema_version||'') + '</span></div>';
      }).join('');

      // Snapshot timeline chart
      if (document.getElementById('chart-snapshot-timeline')) {
        var snapDates = snaps.map(function(s) {
          return s.created_at ? s.created_at.slice(0,16) : '';
        }).filter(Boolean);
        var snapLabels = snaps.map(function(s, i) { return '#' + s.id.slice(0,6); });
        charts.create('chart-snapshot-timeline', 'line', {
          labels: snapDates,
          datasets: [{
            label: 'Snapshots',
            data: snapDates.map(function() { return 1; }),
            borderColor: '#a371f7',
            backgroundColor: '#a371f733',
            pointBackgroundColor: '#a371f7',
            pointRadius: snapDates.map(function(d, i) {
              return 6 + (i === snapDates.length - 1 ? 4 : 0);
            }),
            pointHoverRadius: 8,
            showLine: false,
            fill: false,
          }]
        }, {
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              callbacks: {
                label: function(ctx) {
                  return 'Snapshot: ' + snapLabels[ctx.dataIndex];
                }
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { ticks: { maxRotation: 45, font: { size: 8 } } },
            y: { display: false, min: 0, max: 2 },
          },
        });
      }
    }).catch(function() {});
  }

  function saveNarrative() { var n=document.getElementById('id-narrative-input').value.trim(); if(!n)return; api.post('/api/self-model/narrative',{narrative:n}).then(function(){modal.showBanner('ok','Narrative updated');loadIdentity();}).catch(function(e){modal.show('Error',e.message);}); }
  function savePurpose() { var p=document.getElementById('id-purpose-input').value.trim(); if(!p)return; api.post('/api/self-model/purpose',{purpose:p}).then(function(){modal.showBanner('ok','Purpose updated');loadIdentity();}).catch(function(e){modal.show('Error',e.message);}); }
  function reinforceAxiom() { var a=document.getElementById('id-axiom-select').value; api.post('/api/value-axioms/reinforce',{axiom_name:a,count:1}).then(function(){modal.showBanner('ok','Reinforced '+a);loadIdentity();}).catch(function(e){modal.show('Error',e.message);}); }
  function takeSnapshot() { api.post('/api/snapshots/take',{}).then(function(){modal.showBanner('ok','Snapshot taken');loadIdentity();}).catch(function(e){modal.show('Error',e.message);}); }
  function resolveCrisis() { api.post('/api/crisis/resolve',{resolution:'Manual'}).then(function(){modal.showBanner('ok','Crisis resolved');loadIdentity();}).catch(function(e){modal.show('Error',e.message);}); }
  function exportSnapshots() { api.get('/api/identity/snapshots?limit=100').then(function(d){if(!d.snapshots||!d.snapshots.length){modal.show('Export','No snapshots');return;}var blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(d.snapshots,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='rsis3_snapshots.json';a.click();}).catch(function(e){modal.show('Error',e.message);}); }

  function refresh() { loadIdentity(); }

  function showLayerHistory(layerId) {
    api.get('/api/identity/status').then(function(d) {
      var layers = d.layer_scores || {};
      var info = layers[layerId] || {score:0, metrics:{}};
      var snapshots = d.snapshot_count || 0;
      var metrics = info.metrics || {};
      var html = '<div class="tp-section"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px 0;color:var(--accent)">Layer ' + layerId + ' - History</h3>' +
        '<p>Current score: <strong>' + (info.score||0) + '</strong>/100</p>' +
        '<p>Total snapshots: <strong>' + snapshots + '</strong></p></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Sub-Metrics</div><table><tr><th>Metric</th><th>Value</th></tr>' +
        (Object.keys(metrics).length ? Object.keys(metrics).map(function(m){return '<tr><td>'+m+'</td><td><strong>'+metrics[m]+'</strong></td></tr>';}).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="2" class="text-muted">No sub-metrics</td></tr>') +
        '</table></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Score Trend</div><p class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px">Trend data accumulates across snapshots.</p>' +
        '<div class="chart-container" style="height:80px"><canvas id="layer-trend-chart-'+layerId+'"></canvas></div></div>';
      modal.showTooltip('Layer ' + layerId + ' History', html);
      setTimeout(function() {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('layer-trend-chart-'+layerId);
        if (canvas && charts) {
          var mockData = [info.score||0];
          for (var i=1; i<Math.min(snapshots+1,10); i++) {
            mockData.unshift(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (info.score||0) - i*3 + Math.floor(Math.random()*10))));
          }
          charts.create('layer-trend-chart-'+layerId, 'line', {
            labels: mockData.map(function(_,j){return 'S'+(j+1);}),
            datasets: [{
              label: layerId + ' Score',
              data: mockData,
              borderColor: info.score >= 70 ? '#3fb950' : info.score >= 40 ? '#d29922' : '#f85149',
              backgroundColor: function(ctx){var g=ctx.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,80);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(88,166,255,0.2)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(88,166,255,0)');return g;},
              fill: true, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 3,
            }]
          }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false } }, scales: { y: { min: 0, max: 100, ticks: { font: { size: 8 } } }, x: { ticks: { font: { size: 8 } } } } });
        }
      }, 100);
    }).catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }
  
  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
  
  function showCrisisTimeline() {
    api.get('/api/identity/snapshots').then(function(d) {
      var snaps = d.snapshots || [];
      var crisisEvents = snaps.filter(function(s){return s.state_json&&s.state_json.indexOf('crisis')>=0;}) || [];
      var html = '<div class="tp-section"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px 0;color:var(--red)">Crisis Timeline</h3>' +
        '<p>Total snapshots: <strong>' + snaps.length + '</strong></p></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Crisis Events</div>' +
        (crisisEvents.length ? crisisEvents.slice(0,20).map(function(s) {
          var st = s.created_at ? s.created_at.slice(0,16) : '';
          return '<div style="padding:4px 8px;border-left:3px solid var(--red);margin-bottom:4px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px">' +
            '<div class="flex-between"><span class="badge error">Crisis</span><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:9px">' + st + '</span></div>' +
            '<div style="font-size:10px;margin-top:2px">Snapshot: #' + s.id.slice(0,8) + '</div></div>';
        }).join('') : '<p class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px">No crisis events recorded. System is healthy.</p>') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Status</div><p style="font-size:11px">No active crisis.</p></div>';
      modal.showTooltip('Crisis Timeline', html);
    }).catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }

NS.tabs.identity = { render: render, refresh: refresh, toggleControls: toggleControls, saveNarrative: saveNarrative, savePurpose: savePurpose, reinforceAxiom: reinforceAxiom, takeSnapshot: takeSnapshot, resolveCrisis: resolveCrisis, exportSnapshots: exportSnapshots, showLayerHistory: showLayerHistory, showCrisisTimeline: showCrisisTimeline };})(window.RSIS3);

        '<div class="acc-body">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;padding:4px 0;flex-wrap:wrap">' +
            '<button onclick="RSIS3.tabs.knowledge.loadGaps()" style="padding:6px 12px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);cursor:pointer">Detect Gaps</button>' +
            '<button onclick="RSIS3.tabs.knowledge.loadGapGoals()" style="padding:6px 12px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);cursor:pointer">Generate Goals</button></div>' +
          '<div id="kb-gaps-results" class="text-muted" style="padding:8px;font-size:11px">Click a button to run gap analysis.</div></div></div>' +

      '<div class="accordion"><div class="acc-header" aria-expanded="false">' +
        '<span class="acc-title">? Memory Health</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body">' +
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;padding:4px 0">' +
            '<button onclick="RSIS3.tabs.knowledge.loadMemoryStatus()" style="padding:6px 12px;background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);cursor:pointer">Subsystem Status</button></div>' +
          '<div id="kb-memory-results" class="text-muted" style="padding:8px;font-size:11px">Click to view memory subsystem health.</div></div></div>';

    NS.accordion.init(el);
  }

  // ── Search ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function doSearch() {
    var input = document.getElementById('kb-search-input');
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-search-results');
    if (!input || !results) return;
    var q = input.value.trim();
    if (!q) { results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Enter a query.</span>'; return; }

    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Searching...</span>';
    api.get('/api/knowledge/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '&top_k=20')
      .then(function(data) {
        if (!data || data.error) {
          results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + (data ? data.error : 'No response') + '</span>';
          return;
        }
        if (!data.results || data.results.length === 0) {
          results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">No results for "' + q + '".</span>';
          return;
        }
        results.innerHTML =
          '<div style="margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600">' + data.total + ' results for "' + q + '":</div>' +
          data.results.map(function(r) {
            return '<div style="padding:6px 8px;margin:2px 0;background:var(--bg2);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px">' +
              '<div style="font-weight:500">' + (r.title || r.id) + ' <span class="text-muted">(' + r.type + ')</span></div>' +
              '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text2)">' + (r.snippet || '') + '</div>' +
              '<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text3)">score: ' + r.score + ' · id: ' + r.id + '</div></div>';
          }).join('');
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Search error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });
  }

  // ── Graph ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function exploreGraph() {
    var input = document.getElementById('kb-graph-entity');
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-graph-results');
    if (!input || !results) return;
    var eid = input.value.trim();
    if (!eid) { results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Enter an entity ID.</span>'; return; }

    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Loading...</span>';
    api.get('/api/knowledge/graph/neighbors/' + encodeURIComponent(eid) + '?hops=2')
      .then(function(data) {
        if (!data || data.error) {
          results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + (data ? data.error : 'No response') + '</span>';
          return;
        }
        if (!data.neighbors || data.neighbors.length === 0) {
          results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">No neighbors found for "' + eid + '".</span>';
          return;
        }
        results.innerHTML =
          '<div style="margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600">' + data.title + ' — ' + data.neighbors.length + ' neighbors:</div>' +
          data.neighbors.map(function(n) {
            return '<div style="padding:4px 8px;margin:2px 0;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:3px;font-size:11px">' +
              '<span style="font-weight:500">' + (n.title || n.id) + '</span> ' +
              '<span class="text-muted">(' + n.depth + ' hop' + (n.depth > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')</span></div>';
          }).join('');
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Graph error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });
  }

  function loadCentral() {
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-graph-results');
    if (!results) return;
    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Loading...</span>';

              (i+1) + '. <span style="font-weight:500">' + (e.title || e.id) + '</span> ' +
              '<span class="text-muted">centrality: ' + e.centrality + '</span></div>';
          }).join('');
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });

  function loadCommunities() {
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-graph-results');
    if (!results) return;
    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Loading...</span>';
    api.get('/api/knowledge/graph/communities')

        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + err.message + '</span>';

  // ── Trends ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadTrends() {
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-trends-results');
    if (!results) return;
    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Loading...</span>';
    api.get('/api/knowledge/trends')
      .then(function(data) {
        if (!data) {
          results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">No trend data available.</span>';
          return;
        }
        var html = '';
        if (data.rising && data.rising.length > 0) {
          html += '<div style="margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600;color:var(--green)">? Rising Topics:</div>' +
            data.rising.slice(0, 10).map(function(e) {
              return '<div style="padding:3px 6px;font-size:11px">' +
                '<span style="font-weight:500">' + (e.id || e.title) + '</span> ' +
                '<span class="text-muted">ratio: ' + e.ratio + '</span></div>';
            }).join('');
        }
        if (data.falling && data.falling.length > 0) {
          html += '<div style="margin-top:8px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600;color:var(--red)">? Falling Topics:</div>' +
            data.falling.slice(0, 10).map(function(e) {
              return '<div style="padding:3px 6px;font-size:11px">' +
                '<span style="font-weight:500">' + (e.id || e.title) + '</span> ' +
                '<span class="text-muted">ratio: ' + e.ratio + '</span></div>';
            }).join('');
        }
        if (!html) html = '<span class="text-muted">Not enough data for trend detection (need 3+ months).</span>';
        results.innerHTML = html;
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });
  }

  function loadMonthlyActivity() {

          }).join('');
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });

  // ── Gaps ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadGaps() {

              '<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700">' + data.low_coverage + '</div>' +
              '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">Low Coverage</div></div>' +
            '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:8px;border-radius:var(--radius);text-align:center">' +
              '<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700">' + data.stubs + '</div>' +
              '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">Stubs</div></div>' +
            '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:8px;border-radius:var(--radius);text-align:center">' +
              '<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700">' + data.acronyms + '</div>' +
              '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">Undefined Acronyms</div></div>' +
            '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:8px;border-radius:var(--radius);text-align:center">' +
              '<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700">' + data.missing_tags + '</div>' +
              '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">Missing Tags</div></div></div>';

        if (data.top_low_coverage && data.top_low_coverage.length > 0) {
          html += '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-weight:600">Top Low-Coverage Entities:</div>' +
            data.top_low_coverage.map(function(e) {
              return '<div style="padding:3px 6px;font-size:11px">' +
                '<span style="font-weight:500">' + e.title + '</span> ' +
                '<span class="text-muted">(' + e.session_count + ' sessions, ' + e.body_len + 'b body)</span></div>';
            }).join('');
        }
        if (data.top_acronyms && data.top_acronyms.length > 0) {
          html += '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-weight:600">Undefined Acronyms:</div>' +
            data.top_acronyms.map(function(e) {
              return '<div style="padding:3px 6px;font-size:11px">' +
                '<span style="font-weight:500">' + e.title + '</span> ' +
                '<span class="text-muted">(' + e.session_count + ' sessions)</span></div>';
            }).join('');
        }
        results.innerHTML = html;
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });
  }

  function loadGapGoals() {
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-gaps-results');
    if (!results) return;
    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Generating goals from gaps...</span>';
    api.get('/api/knowledge/gap-goals')
      .then(function(data) {

          results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">No goals generated.</span>';
          return;

        results.innerHTML =

              (g.priority > 0.7 ? 'var(--red)' : g.priority > 0.4 ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--green)') + '">' +
              '<div style="font-weight:500;font-size:11px">' + (i+1) + '. ' + g.description + '</div>' +

              (g.suggested_tasks ? '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3)">tasks: ' + g.suggested_tasks.join(', ') + '</div>' : '') +
              '</div>';

  // ── Memory Status ──────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadMemoryStatus() {
    var results = document.getElementById('kb-memory-results');
    if (!results) return;
    results.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Loading...</span>';
    api.get('/api/knowledge/memory')
      .then(function(data) {

        }
        results.innerHTML =
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:8px">' +
          Object.entries(data).map(function(e) {
            var val = typeof e[1] === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(e[1]).substring(0, 50) : e[1];
            return '<div style="background:var(--bg2);padding:8px;border-radius:var(--radius)">' +
              '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3)">' + e[0] + '</div>' +

          }).join('') + '</div>';
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        results.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--red)">Error: ' + err.message + '</span>';
      });
  }

  function refresh() { render(); }

  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
  NS.tabs.knowledge = {
    render: render,
    refresh: refresh,
    doSearch: doSearch,
    exploreGraph: exploreGraph,
    loadCentral: loadCentral,
    loadCommunities: loadCommunities,
    loadTrends: loadTrends,
    loadMonthlyActivity: loadMonthlyActivity,
    loadGaps: loadGaps,
    loadGapGoals: loadGapGoals,
    loadMemoryStatus: loadMemoryStatus,
  };
})(window.RSIS3);

```javascript
/* Overview tab — expanded core status from all tabs, error-tolerant */
window.RSIS3 = window.RSIS3 || {};
(function(NS) {
  'use strict';
  var api = NS.api, charts = NS.charts, skel = NS.skeleton, modal = NS.modal;

  function render() {
    var el = document.getElementById('tab-overview');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div style="position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;z-index:10;cursor:pointer" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showFullGuide(this.dataset.guide||\'\')" data-guide="overview"><span style="font-size:16px;color:var(--text3);border:2px solid var(--text3);border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:bold;transition:all 0.2s">?</span></div>' +'<div class="accordion"><div class="acc-header open" aria-expanded="true"><span class="acc-title">◈ System Pulse</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body open"><div id="dash-pulse">' + skel.lines(8) + '</div></div></div>' +
      '<div class="accordion"><div class="acc-header open" aria-expanded="true"><span class="acc-title">◈ Component Status</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body open"><div id="dash-components">' + skel.lines(8) + '</div></div></div>' +
      '<div class="accordion"><div class="acc-header open" aria-expanded="true"><span class="acc-title">◈ Charts</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body open">' +
          '<div class="chart-row">' +
            '<div class="card"><div class="card-header">Layer Timeline <span class="help" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Layer Timeline\',\'Historical layer scores from identity snapshots.\')">?</span></div><div class="chart-container" style="height:150px"><canvas id="chart-timeline"></canvas></div></div>' +
            '<div class="card"><div class="card-header">Layer Radar <span class="help" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Layer Radar\',\'Radar comparing all 6 layer scores.\')">?</span></div><div class="chart-container" style="height:150px"><canvas id="chart-radar"></canvas></div></div>' +
          '</div></div></div>' +
      '<div class="accordion"><div class="acc-header" aria-expanded="false"><span class="acc-title">◈ Recent Activity</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>' +
        '<div class="acc-body"><div class="card"><div id="recent-activity" class="text-muted" style="padding:8px;text-align:center">Loading...</div></div></div></div>';
    NS.accordion.init(el);
    loadData();
  }

  function loadData() {
    var p1 = api.get('/api/info').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p2 = api.get('/api/metrics').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p3 = api.get('/api/telemetry?limit=5').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p4 = api.get('/api/sessions/rrp').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p5 = api.get('/api/identity/status').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p6 = api.get('/api/scheduler/status').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p7 = api.get('/api/errors').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p8 = api.get('/api/cycles?limit=20').catch(function(){return null;});
    var p9 = api.get('/api/cycles?limit=10').catch(function(){return null;});

    Promise.all([p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,p6,p7,p8]).then(function(r) {
      var info = r[0] || {}, metrics = r[1] || {}, tele = r[2] || {},
          sessions = r[3] || {sessions:[]}, identity = r[4] || {layer_scores:{},value_axioms:{}},
          sched = r[5] || {running:false}, errors = r[6] || {unresolved_count:0},
          cyclesData = r[7] || {cycles:[]};

      var allCycles = cyclesData.cycles || [];
      var total = info.total_cycles || allCycles.length;
      var completed = allCycles.filter(function(c){return c.status==='completed';}).length;
      var failed = allCycles.filter(function(c){return c.status==='failed';}).length;
      var active = allCycles.filter(function(c){return c.status==='active';}).length;
      var cycles24h = (metrics.cycle_frequency||{}).last_24h||0;
      var cycles7d = (metrics.cycle_frequency||{}).last_7d||0;
      var snapCount = identity.snapshot_count||0;
      var errCount = errors.unresolved_count||0;
      var crisis = identity.crisis_active || false;
      var schedRunning = sched.running || false;

      // Parse timestamps for cadence and histogram
      var now = Date.now();
      var timestamps = [];
      allCycles.forEach(function(c) {
        var ts = c.started_at || c.completed_at;
        if (ts) {
          var d = new Date(ts + 'Z');
          if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) timestamps.push(d);
        }
      });
      timestamps.sort(function(a,b){return b-a;});

      var lastPulse = timestamps.length > 0 ? timestamps[0] : null;
      var lastPulseAgo = lastPulse ? timeAgo(lastPulse.getTime()) : 'never';

      // Average cadence
      var avgGap = '—';
      if (timestamps.length > 1) {
        var gaps = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < timestamps.length - 1; i++) {
          gaps += (timestamps[i] - timestamps[i+1]) / 3600000;
        }
        avgGap = (gaps / (timestamps.length - 1)).toFixed(1) + 'h';
      }

      // 7-day histogram
      var dayCounts = [];
      for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
        var d = new Date(now - i * 86400000);
        var dateStr = d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
        var count = 0;
        timestamps.forEach(function(t) {
          if (t.toISOString().slice(0,10) === dateStr) count++;
        });
        dayCounts.push(count);
      }
      var maxDay = Math.max.apply(null, dayCounts) || 1;
      var dayNames = ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'];
      var todayIdx = new Date().getDay();
      var dayLabels = [];
      for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
        dayLabels.push(dayNames[(todayIdx - i + 7) % 7]);
      }

      // Health score
      var healthScore = 100;
      if (!info.db_ok) healthScore -= 25;
      if (errCount > 0) healthScore -= Math.min(errCount * 5, 20);
      if (crisis) healthScore -= 20;
      if (!schedRunning) healthScore -= 5;
      if (total === 0) healthScore -= 10;
      healthScore = Math.max(0, healthScore);

      // Trend (compare first half vs second half of cycles list)
      var trend = '→';
      if (timestamps.length >= 4) {
        var mid = Math.floor(timestamps.length / 2);
        var recent = timestamps.slice(0, mid);
        var older = timestamps.slice(mid);
        if (recent.length > 0 && older.length > 0) {
          var recentSpan = (recent[0] - recent[recent.length-1]) / 3600000 || 1;
          var olderSpan = (older[0] - older[older.length-1]) / 3600000 || 1;
          var recentRate = recent.length / recentSpan;
          var olderRate = older.length / olderSpan;
          if (recentRate > olderRate * 1.1) trend = '↑';
          else if (recentRate < olderRate * 0.9) trend = '↓';
          else trend = '→';
        }
      }

      // Build histogram bars HTML
      var histHtml = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        var pct = (dayCounts[i] / maxDay) * 100;
        var barColor = dayCounts[i] > 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--bg3)';
        histHtml += '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;flex:1">' +
          '<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text3)">' + dayCounts[i] + '</div>' +
          '<div style="width:100%;height:32px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end">' +
            '<div style="width:100%;height:' + pct + '%;background:' + barColor + ';border-radius:3px;transition:height 0.5s;min-height:' + (dayCounts[i]>0?'4px':'0') + '"></div></div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:8px;color:var(--text3)">' + dayLabels[i] + '</div></div>';
      }

      document.getElementById('dash-pulse').innerHTML =
        '<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg3),rgba(88,166,255,0.06));border-color:var(--accent)">' +
          /* Header row */
          '<div class="flex-between" style="margin-bottom:6px">' +
            '<div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px" data-tip="ov-health-score">System Health</div>' +
            '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">' +
              '<span class="badge ' + (healthScore>=70?'completed':healthScore>=40?'warning':'error') + '" style="font-size:10px" data-tip="ov-health-score">Score: ' + healthScore + '/100</span>' +
              '<span style="font-size:13px" title="' + (trend==='↑'?'Increasing':trend==='↓'?'Decreasing':'Stable') + '">' + trend + '</span></div></div>' +
          /* Stats row */
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px">' +
            '<span data-tip="ov-total-cycles" data-metric="total" class="pulse-metric" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.overview.toggleMetric(&quot;total&quot;)"><strong>' + total + '</strong> total</span>' +
            '<span style="color:var(--green)" data-tip="ov-completed" data-metric="completed" class="pulse-metric" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.overview.toggleMetric(&quot;completed&quot;)"><strong>' + completed + '</strong> done</span>' +
            (failed>0?'<span style="color:var(--red)" data-tip="ov-failed"><strong>'+failed+'</strong> failed</span>':'') +
            (active>0?'<span style="color:var(--accent)" data-tip="ov-active"><strong>'+active+'</strong> active</span>':'') +
            '<span class="text-muted">Success: ' + (total>0 ? Math.round(completed/total*100) + '%' : '—') + '</span></div>' +
          /* Timing row */
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:6px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">' +
            '<span data-tip="ov-last-pulse">Last: <strong>' + lastPulseAgo + '</strong></span>' +
            '<span data-tip="ov-cadence">Cadence: <strong>' + avgGap + '</strong></span>' +
            '<span>v' + (info.version||'—') + ' · DB v' + (info.db_schema_version||'—') + '</span></div>' +
          /* Badges row */
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px">' +
            '<span class="badge ' + (info.db_ok?'completed':'error') + '" data-tip="ov-db-badge">DB ' + (info.db_ok?'OK':'ERR') + '</span>' +
            '<span class="badge ' + (errCount>0?'error':'completed') + '" data-tip="ov-error-badge">' + errCount + ' error' + (errCount!==1?'s':'') + '</span>' +
            '<span class="badge ' + (crisis?'error':'completed') + '" data-tip="ov-crisis-badge">Crisis ' + (crisis?'⚠':'✅') + '</span>' +
            '<span class="badge ' + (schedRunning?'completed':'warning') + '" data-tip="ov-sched-badge">Sched ' + (schedRunning?'ON':'OFF') + '</span>' +
            '<span class="badge completed" data-tip="ov-snap-badge">' + snapCount + ' snap</span>' +
            '<span class="badge blue" data-tip="ov-cycles-24h">' + cycles24h + '/24h</span>' +
            '<span class="badge blue">' + cycles7d + '/7d</span></div>' +
          /* 7-day histogram */
          '<div style="margin-bottom:8px">' +
            '<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:4px" data-tip="ov-histogram">7-Day Cycle Activity</div>' +
            '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:flex-end">' + histHtml + '</div></div>' +
          /* Quick actions */
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)">' +
            '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.cycles.newCycle()" data-tip="ov-run-pulse">▶ Run Pulse</button>' +
            '<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.identity.takeSnapshot()" data-tip="ov-snap">📸 Snap</button>' +
            '<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.identity.refresh()" data-tip="ov-refresh">🔄 Refresh</button>' +
            (crisis?'<button class="btn btn-sm btn-red" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.identity.resolveCrisis()" data-tip="ov-resolve-crisis">⚠ Resolve Crisis</button>':'') +
          '</div></div>';

      var layers = identity.layer_scores || {};

      // Compute hourly distribution & daily comparison from allCycles
      var hourly = {};
      var todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
      var yesterdayStr = new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
      var todayCount = 0, yesterdayCount = 0;
      allCycles.forEach(function(c) {
        var ts = c.started_at || c.completed_at;
        if (!ts) return;
        var d = new Date(ts + 'Z');
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return;
        var h = d.getUTCHours();
        hourly[h] = (hourly[h]||0) + 1;
        var day = d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
        if (day === todayStr) todayCount++;
        else if (day === yesterdayStr) yesterdayCount++;
      });
      var maxH = 1;
      for (var h in hourly) { if (hourly[h] > maxH) maxH = hourly[h]; }
      var hourlyHtml = '';
      for (var h = 0; h < 24; h+=3) {
        var cnt = hourly[h]||0;
        var pct = (cnt / maxH) * 100;
        hourlyHtml += '<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;flex:1">' +
          '<div style="width:100%;height:20px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end">' +
            '<div style="width:100%;height:' + pct + '%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px;min-height:' + (cnt>0?'3px':'0') + '"></div></div>' +
          '<span style="font-size:7px;color:var(--text3)">' + h + ':00</span></div>';
      }

      // Layer score names & descriptions
      var layerMeta = [
        {id:'L1', label:'Execution', desc:'Reliability & failure recovery'},
        {id:'L2', label:'Planning', desc:'Goal analysis & step planning'},
        {id:'L3', label:'Self-Direction', desc:'Signal coverage & goal generation'},
        {id:'L4', label:'Meta-Learning', desc:'Parameter tuning & experimentation'},
        {id:'L5', label:'Pattern Recognition', desc:'KG utilization & insight mining'},
        {id:'L6', label:'Value Alignment', desc:'Identity stability & coherence'},
      ];
      var layerHtml = layerMeta.map(function(m) {
        var score = (layers[m.id] && layers[m.id].score) || 0;
        var color = score >= 70 ? 'var(--green)' : score >= 40 ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--red)';
        return '<div style="margin-bottom:4px" data-tip="ov-layer-' + m.id.toLowerCase() + '">' +
          '<div class="flex-between" style="font-size:11px;margin-bottom:1px">' +
            '<span><strong>' + m.id + '</strong> — <span class="text-muted">' + m.desc + '</span></span>' +
            '<span style="color:' + color + ';font-weight:600">' + score + '</span></div>' +
          '<div class="axis-bar"><div class="fill" style="width:' + score + '%;background:' + color + '"></div></div></div>';
      }).join('');

      var compHtml =
        '<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:0;padding:12px">' +
          '<div class="card-header" style="margin-bottom:6px">Layer Scores</div>' +
          layerHtml +
          '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)">' +
            /* Cycles */
            '<div style="padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--radius);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);cursor:pointer;min-height:70px" data-tip="ov-cycles-card" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Cycle Status\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Total: <strong>" + total + "</strong> cycles. Today: <strong>" + (todayCount||0) + "</strong>, Yesterday: <strong>" + (yesterdayCount||0) + "</strong>.</p><p>Active: " + active + ", Completed: " + completed + ", Failed: " + failed + "</p></div>\')">' +
              '<div class="flex-between"><span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px">Cycles</span><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:8px">' + cycles24h + '/24h</span></div>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin:2px 0">' +
                '<span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700">' + total + '</span>' +
                '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--green);align-self:flex-end;margin-bottom:2px">+' + completed + '</span>' +
                (failed>0?'<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--red);align-self:flex-end;margin-bottom:2px">-'+failed+'</span>':'') +
              '</div>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap">' +
                '<span class="tag ' + (todayCount>yesterdayCount?'green':todayCount<yesterdayCount?'error':'blue') + '" style="font-size:8px" data-tip="ov-completed">Today ' + todayCount + '</span>' +
                '<span class="tag blue" style="font-size:8px" data-tip="ov-completed">Yest ' + yesterdayCount + '</span>' +
                '<span class="tag" style="font-size:8px">' + trend + '</span></div></div>' +
            /* Telemetry */
            '<div style="padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--radius);border-left:3px solid var(--green);cursor:pointer;min-height:70px" data-tip="ov-telemetry-card" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Telemetry Status\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Total events: <strong>" + (tele.total||0) + "</strong>. OK: " + ((tele.total||0)-(errCount||0)) + ", Errors: " + errCount + "</p></div>\')">' +
              '<div class="flex-between"><span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px">Telemetry</span><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:8px">' + (tele.total ? Math.round(tele.total/(total||1)*10)/10 + '/c' : '') + '</span></div>' +
              '<span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700">' + (tele.total||0) + '</span>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2px">' +
                '<span class="tag green" style="font-size:8px" data-tip="ov-telemetry-card">' + ((tele.total||0)-(errCount||0)) + ' ok</span>' +
                (errCount>0?'<span class="tag error" style="font-size:8px">'+errCount+' err</span>':'<span class="tag completed" style="font-size:8px">0 err</span>') +
              '</div></div>' +
            /* Identity */
            '<div style="padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--radius);border-left:3px solid var(--yellow);cursor:pointer;min-height:70px" data-tip="ov-identity-card" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'Identity Status\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Layer scores: L1=" + ((layers.L1&&layers.L1.score)||0) + ", L2=" + ((layers.L2&&layers.L2.score)||0) + ", L3=" + ((layers.L3&&layers.L3.score)||0) + "</p><p>Crisis: " + (crisis?\'⚠ Active\':\'✅ None\') + ", Snapshots: " + snapCount + "</p></div>\')">' +
              '<div class="flex-between"><span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px">Identity</span><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:8px">' + snapCount + ' snap</span></div>' +
              '<span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700">' + avgLayerScore(layers) + '</span>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2px">' +
                '<span class="tag ' + (crisis?'error':'green') + '" style="font-size:8px">' + (crisis?'⚠ Crisis':'✓ OK') + '</span>' +
                '<span class="tag purple" style="font-size:8px">' + axiomCount(identity) + ' ax</span></div></div>' +
            /* RRP */
            '<div style="padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--radius);border-left:3px solid var(--purple);cursor:pointer;min-height:70px" data-tip="ov-rrp-card" onclick="RSIS3.modal.showTooltip(\'RRP Status\',\'<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p>Sessions: " + ((sessions.sessions||[]).length) + ". Decisions: " + rrpTotal(sessions,\'decisions\') + ", Constraints: " + rrpTotal(sessions,\'constraints\') + "</p></div>\')">' +
              '<div class="flex-between"><span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px">RRP</span><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:8px">Amb ' + (metrics.avg_ambiguity_final||'—') + '</span></div>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;margin:2px 0">' +
                '<span style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700">' + ((sessions.sessions||[]).length) + '</span>' +
                '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);align-self:flex-end;margin-bottom:2px">' + rrpTotal(sessions,'decisions') + ' dec</span></div>' +
              '<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2px">' +
                rrpSessions(sessions) +
              '</div></div>' +
          '</div></div>';

      document.getElementById('dash-components').innerHTML = compHtml;

      setTimeout(function() {
        renderCharts(metrics, layers);
        renderMiniSpark(metrics);
      }, 50);
    });

    p9.then(function(d) {
      var el = document.getElementById('recent-activity');
      if (!el) return;
      if (!d || !d.cycles || !d.cycles.length) { el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;padding:12px">No cycles yet.</p>'; return; }
      el.innerHTML = d.cycles.map(function(c){
        var ago = c.completed_at ? timeAgo(new Date(c.completed_at+'Z').getTime()) : '';
        return '<div class="cycle-item" style="margin-bottom:3px;cursor:default"><div class="left"><span class="id">' + c.id.slice(0,8) + '</span><span class="meta">' + (c.branch||'') + ' · ' + ago + '</span></div><span class="badge ' + (c.status||'') + '">' + (c.status||'') + '</span></div>';
      }).join('');
    }).catch(function(){});
  }

  function renderMiniSpark(metrics) {
    var amb = metrics.ambiguity_trend || [];
    if (amb.length > 1) {
      charts.create('mini-timeline', 'line', {
        labels: amb.map(function(_,i){return '#'+(i+1);}),
        datasets: [{ data: amb, borderColor: '#58a6ff', borderWidth: 1.5, pointRadius: 0, fill: false, tension: 0.3 }]
      }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { enabled: false } }, scales: { x: { display: false }, y: { display: false, beginAtZero: true } }, animation: false });
    } else {
      var mc = document.getElementById('mini-timeline');
      if (mc) mc.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px;text-align:center">Trend data pending</div>';
    }
  }

  function avgLayerScore(layers) {
    var sum = 0, count = 0;
    for (var k in layers) { sum += (layers[k].score||0); count++; }
    return count ? Math.round(sum/count) : '—';
  }

  function renderCharts(metrics, layers, teleEvents, allCycles) {
    teleEvents = teleEvents || [];
    var layerNames = ['L1','L2','L3','L4','L5','L6'];
    var scores = layerNames.map(function(l){ return (layers[l]&&layers[l].score)||0; });
    layerData = layers;
    var amb = metrics.ambiguity_trend || [];
    if (amb.length > 1) {
      charts.create('chart-timeline', 'line', {
        labels: amb.map(function(_,i){return '#'+(i+1);}),
        datasets: [{ label: 'Ambiguity', data: amb, borderColor: '#58a6ff', backgroundColor: function(ctx){var g=ctx.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,150);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(88,166,255,0.2)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(88,166,255,0)');return g;}, fill:true, tension:0.3, pointRadius:2 }]
      }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false } } });
    } else {
      // Build daily cycle count timeline from available cycles data
      var _dayLabels = [];
      var _dayCounts = [];
      var now = Date.now();
      for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
        var d = new Date(now - i * 86400000);
        _dayLabels.push(d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {month:'short', day:'numeric'}));
        _dayCounts.push(0);
      }
      // Count cycles per day from the available cycle timestamps
      var _cycleTimestamps = metrics.cycle_timestamps || [];
      if (allCycles && allCycles.length) {
        allCycles.forEach(function(cyc) {
          var ts = cyc.started_at || cyc.completed_at;
          if (ts) {
            var cd = new Date(ts + 'Z');
            if (!isNaN(cd.getTime())) {
              var dayDiff = Math.floor((now - cd.getTime()) / 86400000);
              if (dayDiff >= 0 && dayDiff < 7) {
                _dayCounts[6 - dayDiff]++;
              }
            }
          }
        });
      }
      // Per-layer current scores shown as sub-datasets
      var _lc = {'L2':'#3fb950','L1':'#58a6ff','L3':'#d29922','L5':'#bc8cff','L6':'#39d2c0'};
      var _order = ['L2','L1','L3','L5','L6'];
      var _tds = _order.map(function(l) {
        var bw = (l === 'L1') ? 1 : 2;
        return { label: l + ' (' + ((layers[l]&&layers[l].score)||0) + ')', data: _dayCounts.map(function(){ return (layers[l]&&layers[l].score)||0; }), borderColor: _lc[l], borderWidth: bw, pointRadius: 0, pointHoverRadius: 3, tension: 0.3 };
      });
      // Add cycle count as a filled area baseline
      _tds.unshift({ label: 'Cycles', data: _dayCounts, borderColor: 'rgba(136,149,158,0.5)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(136,149,158,0.08)', borderWidth: 1, pointRadius: 0, pointHoverRadius: 3, tension: 0.3, fill: true, yAxisID: 'y1' });
      charts.create('chart-timeline', 'line', {
        labels: _dayLabels,
        datasets: _tds
      }, { plugins: { legend: { position: 'top', labels: { color: '#8b949e', font: { size: 9 }, boxWidth: 10 } } }, scales: { y: { display: false, beginAtZero: true }, y1: { display: false, beginAtZero: true, position: 'right' } } });
    }
    charts.create('chart-radar', 'radar', {
      labels: layerNames,
      datasets: [{ label: 'Scores', data: scores, borderColor: '#bc8cff', backgroundColor: 'rgba(188,140,255,0.12)', pointBackgroundColor: '#bc8cff', pointBorderColor: '#fff', pointBorderWidth: 1, pointRadius: 3 }]
    });
    // Bar chart — Score Distribution
        var barColors = ['#58a6ff','#3fb950','#d29922','#bc8cff','#a371f7','#39d2c0'];
    charts.create('chart-bar', 'bar', {
      labels: layerNames,
      datasets: [{ label: 'Score', data: scores, backgroundColor: barColors, borderRadius: 3 }]
    }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false } }, scales: { y: { max: 100, ticks: { color: '#484f58', font: { size: 9 } }, grid: { color: '#21262d' } }, x: { ticks: { color: '#484f58', font: { size: 9 } }, grid: { display: false } } } });
    // KG / Cycle Frequency chart
    var sat = metrics.satisfaction_trend || [];
    if (sat.length > 1) {
      charts.create('chart-kg', 'line', {
        labels: sat.map(function(_,i){return '#'+(i+1);}),
        datasets: [
          { label: 'Satisfaction', data: sat, borderColor: '#3fb950', tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 3 },
        ]
      });
    } else {
      var cf = metrics.cycle_frequency || {};
      charts.create('chart-kg', 'line', {
        labels: ['24h','7d'],
        datasets: [
          { label: 'Cycles', data: [cf.last_24h||0, cf.last_7d||0], borderColor: '#3fb950', tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 4, backgroundColor: function(ctx){var g=ctx.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,150);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(63,185,80,0.2)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(63,185,80,0)');return g;}, fill: true },
          { label: 'Avg Rounds', data: [0, metrics.avg_rounds_per_cycle||0], borderColor: '#d29922', tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 4 },
        ]
      });
    }
    // Error Trend chart
    var errData = teleEvents.filter(function(e){return e.event_type==='error';});
    if (errData.length > 1) {
      charts.create('chart-errors', 'line', {
        labels: errData.map(function(_,i){return '#'+(i+1);}),
        datasets: [{ label: 'Errors', data: errData.map(function(e,i){return errData.length-i;}), borderColor: '#d29922', tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 2, fill: true, backgroundColor: function(ctx){var g=ctx.chart.ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,150);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(210,153,34,0.15)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(210,153,34,0)');return g;} }]
      }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false } } });
    } else {
      charts.create('chart-errors', 'doughnut', {
        labels: ['Errors', 'Clean'],
        datasets: [{ data: [errData.length, Math.max(1,(teleEvents.length||0)-errData.length)], backgroundColor: ['#d29922','#3fb950'], borderWidth: 0 }]
      }, { plugins: { legend: { display: false } }, cutout: '60%' });
    }
    // Event Distribution doughnut
    var eventTypes = {};
    teleEvents.forEach(function(e){ var t=e.event_type||'unknown'; eventTypes[t]=(eventTypes[t]||0)+1; });
    var eLabels = Object.keys(eventTypes);
    var eData = eLabels.map(function(t){return eventTypes[t];});
    var eColors = ['#58a6ff','#3fb950','#d29922','#bc8cff','#39d2c0','#d4762d','#a371f7'];
    charts.create('chart-events', 'doughnut', {
      labels: eLabels,
      datasets: [{ data: eData, backgroundColor: eColors.slice(0,eLabels.length), borderWidth: 0 }]
    }, { plugins: { legend: { position: 'right', labels: { color: '#8b949e', font: { size: 9 }, boxWidth: 10 } } }, cutout: '50%' });
  }

  // Layer data cache for settings modal
  var layerData = null;
  
  // Layer Settings modal — shows L4 (red line) data and chart config
  function showLayerSettings() {
    var ls = layerData || {};
    var l4 = ls['L4'] || {score:0, metrics:{}};
    var html = '<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><p><strong>Layer 4 &mdash; Meta-Cognition</strong></p><p>Removed from main timeline. Score: <strong>' + l4.score + '</strong>/100</p></div>' +
      '<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Sub-Metrics</div><ul>' +
      (Object.keys(l4.metrics||{}).length ? Object.keys(l4.metrics).map(function(k){ return '<li><strong>' + k + ':</strong> ' + l4.metrics[k]; }).join('') : '<li>No sub-metrics</li>') + '</ul></div>' +
      '<div class=&quot;tp-section&quot;><div class=&quot;tp-subtitle&quot;>Chart Configuration</div><table><tr><th>Layer</th><th>Color</th><th>Status</th></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>L1</td><td style=&quot;color:#58a6ff&quot;>● Blue</td><td>Half width</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>L2</td><td style=&quot;color:#3fb950&quot;>● Green</td><td>Top priority</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>L3</td><td style=&quot;color:#d29922&quot;>● Yellow</td><td>Visible</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>L4</td><td style=&quot;color:#f85149&quot;>● Red</td><td>Hidden (settings)</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>L5</td><td style=&quot;color:#bc8cff&quot;>● Purple</td><td>Visible</td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td>L6</td><td style=&quot;color:#39d2c0&quot;>● Teal</td><td>Visible</td></tr></table></div>';
    modal.showTooltip('Layer Settings', html);
  }
  
  function timeAgo(ms) {
    var diff = Date.now() - ms;
    var mins = Math.floor(diff/60000);
    if (mins < 1) return 'just now';
    if (mins < 60) return mins + 'm ago';
    var hrs = Math.floor(mins/60);
    if (hrs < 24) return hrs + 'h ago';
    return Math.floor(hrs/24) + 'd ago';

  function rrpTotal(s, f) { return (s.sessions||[]).reduce(function(a,b){return a+((b[f]||0));},0); }
  function rrpSessions(s) {

      var dec = sess.decisions||0;
      var con = sess.constraints||0;
      var amb = sess.ambiguity_avg||'—';
      return '<span class="tag ' + (st==='completed'?'green':st==='active'?'blue':st==='early_term'?'orange':'') + '" style="cursor:help" data-tip="rrp-session">' + sid + '</span>';

  function layerHighest(ls) { var m=-1,k=''; for(var n in ls){if(ls[n].score>m){m=ls[n].score;k=n;}} return k?k+':'+m:'—'; }
  function axiomCount(id) { var c=0; for(var k in (id.value_axioms||{})) c++; return c; }
  function layerBar(ls) {
    var names=['L1','L2','L3','L4','L5','L6'];
    return names.map(function(l){
      var s=(ls[l]&&ls[l].score)||0;
      var c=s>=70?'var(--green)':s>=40?'var(--yellow)':'var(--red)';
      return '<div style="flex:1;height:6px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden"><div style="height:100%;width:'+s+'%;background:'+c+';border-radius:3px;min-width:2px"></div></div>';
    }).join('');

  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
    function toggleMetric(name) {
    var prefs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('rsis3_metric_pins') || '{}');

  function getPinnedMetrics() {
