```javascript
  }
  
  function showHealthBreakdown() {
    var el = document.getElementById('dash-pulse');
    if (!el) return;
    api.get('/api/info').then(function(info) {
      api.get('/api/errors').then(function(errors) {
        var score = 100;
        if (!info.db_ok) score -= 25;
        var errCount = errors.unresolved_count || 0;
        if (errCount > 0) score -= Math.min(errCount * 5, 20);
        score = Math.max(0, score);
        var breakdown = [
          {label: 'Database', weight: 25, status: info.db_ok ? 'ok' : 'fail', deducted: info.db_ok ? 0 : 25},
          {label: 'Errors', weight: 20, status: errCount === 0 ? 'ok' : errCount < 4 ? 'warn' : 'fail', deducted: Math.min(errCount * 5, 20)},
          {label: 'Base Score', weight: 55, status: 'ok', deducted: 0},
        ];
        var html = '<div class="tp-section"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px 0;color:var(--accent)">Health Score: ' + score + '/100</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Score Breakdown</div><table><tr><th>Component</th><th>Max</th><th>Status</th><th>Deducted</th></tr>' +
          breakdown.map(function(b) {
            return '<tr><td>' + b.label + '</td><td>' + b.weight + '</td><td><span class="badge ' + b.status + '" style="font-size:8px">' + b.status + '</span></td><td>' + (b.deducted > 0 ? '-' + b.deducted : '0') + '</td></tr>';
          }).join('') + '</table></div>' +
          '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">How to Improve</div><ul>' +
          (!info.db_ok ? '<li>Fix database connection to restore 25 points</li>' : '') +
          (errCount > 0 ? '<li>Resolve ' + errCount + ' errors to restore up to 20 points</li>' : '') +
          '<li>Run cycles regularly to maintain healthy metrics</li></ul></div>';
        modal.showTooltip('Health Breakdown', html);
      }).catch(function(){});
    }).catch(function(){});
  }

NS.tabs.overview = { render: render, refresh: refresh, showLayerSettings: showLayerSettings, toggleMetric: toggleMetric, getPinnedMetrics: getPinnedMetrics, showHealthBreakdown: showHealthBreakdown };
})(window.RSIS3);
```

```javascript
  function showForkTree(sessionId) {

        '<p>Total forks: <strong>' + forks.length + '</strong></p></div>';

        forks.forEach(function(f, i) {
          var color = f.merged ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--yellow)';
          html += '<div style="padding:4px 8px;padding-left:' + (24 + i*12) + 'px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:2px;border-left:3px solid ' + color + '">' +
            '<span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--text3)">\u2514\u2500fork ' + (i+1) + '</span> ' + (f.child_session_id||'').slice(0,8) +
            ' <span class="badge ' + (f.merged ? 'completed' : 'active') + '" style="font-size:8px">' + (f.merged ? 'merged' : 'active') + '</span>' +
            (f.fork_reason ? '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:8px;margin-left:4px">' + f.fork_reason + '</span>' : '') +

function fork() {
    var sid = document.getElementById('fork-session-id').value.trim();
    if (!sid) { modal.show('Error', 'Enter a session ID'); return; }
    var reason = prompt('Fork reason:', 'exploration');
    api.post('/api/rrp/fork', { session_id: sid, reason: reason || 'exploration' })
      .then(function(r) { modal.show('Fork Created', 'Child: ' + r.child_session_id); loadSessions(); })
      .catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });

  function merge() {
    var p = document.getElementById('merge-parent').value.trim();
    var c = document.getElementById('merge-child').value.trim();
    if (!p || !c) { modal.show('Error', 'Enter both parent and child IDs'); return; }
    api.post('/api/rrp/merge', { parent_id: p, child_id: c, strategy: 'union' })
      .then(function(r) { modal.show('Merge Result', 'Success: ' + r.success + ' · Decisions: +' + r.decisions_added); loadSessions(); })
      .catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }

  function compare() {
    var a = document.getElementById('compare-a').value.trim();
    var b = document.getElementById('compare-b').value.trim();
    if (!a || !b) { modal.show('Error', 'Enter both session IDs'); return; }
    var res = document.getElementById('compare-result');
    res.innerHTML = 'Comparing...';
    api.get('/api/rrp/compare?session_a=' + encodeURIComponent(a) + '&session_b=' + encodeURIComponent(b))
      .then(function(r) {
        res.innerHTML = '<div class="row"><span class="lbl">Diff</span><span>' + (JSON.stringify(r, null, 2).slice(0,300)) + '</span></div>';
      })
      .catch(function(e) { res.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Error: ' + e.message + '</span>'; });
  }

  function timeAgo(ms) { var d=Date.now()-ms; var m=Math.floor(d/60000); if(m<1)return'now';if(m<60)return m+'m';var h=Math.floor(m/60);if(h<24)return h+'h';return Math.floor(h/24)+'d'; }

  function refresh() { loadSessions(); }

  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
  NS.tabs.rrp = { render: render, refresh: refresh, showDetail: showDetail, fork: fork, merge: merge, compare: compare };
```

```javascript
            '<div class="flex" style="gap:4px">' +
              (running
                ? '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-red" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.scheduler.stop()">Stop</button>'
                : '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.scheduler.start()">Start</button>') +
              '<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.scheduler.refresh()">↻</button></div></div>' +
          '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;font-size:11px">' +
            '<span data-tip="sched-stats">Total runs: <strong>' + total + '</strong></span>' +
            '<span style="color:var(--green)">Successful: <strong>' + ok + '</strong></span>' +
            (fail ? '<span style="color:var(--red)">Failed: <strong>' + fail + '</strong></span>' : '') +
            '<span style="color:var(--text2)">Success rate: <strong>' + (total ? Math.round(ok/total*100) + '%' : '—') + '</strong></span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="axis-bar" style="margin-top:6px"><div class="fill" style="width:' + (total ? (ok/total)*100 : 0) + '%;background:var(--green);width:' + (total ? Math.round(ok/total*100) : 0) + '%"></div></div>' +
        '</div>';

      // Run history (from configs)
      var runHtml = d.configs && d.configs.length
        ? d.configs.map(function(c) {
            var last = c.last_run ? new Date(c.last_run).toLocaleString() : 'never';
            var next = c.next_run ? new Date(c.next_run).toLocaleString() : 'not scheduled';
            return '<div class="list-item flex-between" style="font-size:11px">' +
              '<span><span style="color:var(--accent)">' + (c.name||c.id) + '</span> · every ' + c.interval_hours + 'h</span>' +
              '<span class="text-muted">Last: ' + last + ' · Next: ' + next + ' <span class="sched-countdown" data-next="' + (c.next_run||'') + '" style="font-size:9px;color:var(--accent)"></span></span></div>';
          }).join('')
        : '<div class="text-muted" style="text-align:center;padding:8px">No configurations</div>';
      document.getElementById('scheduler-runs').innerHTML = runHtml;

      // Configs cards
      if (d.configs && d.configs.length) {
        document.getElementById('schedule-configs').innerHTML = '<div class="card"><div class="card-header">Configurations</div>' +
          d.configs.map(function(c) {
            return '<div class="list-item" style="font-size:12px">' +
              '<div class="flex-between"><strong>' + (c.name||c.id) + '</strong>' +
                '<span class="badge ' + (c.enabled ? 'completed' : 'warning') + '">' + (c.enabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled') + '</span></div>' +
              '<div style="margin-top:4px"><button class="btn btn-xs" onclick="RSIS3.tabs.scheduler.runNow(&quot;' + (c.id||'') + '&quot;)" style="font-size:9px">▶ Run Now</button></div>' +
              '<div class="flex-between" style="margin-top:2px">' +
                '<span class="text-muted">Interval: ' + c.interval_hours + 'h · Auto-apply: ' + (c.auto_apply ? '✓' : '✗') + ' · Runs: ' + (c.total_runs||0) + '</span>' +
                '<span class="text-muted">Last: ' + (c.last_run ? new Date(c.last_run).toLocaleString() : 'never') + '</span></div></div>';
          }).join('') + '</div>';
      } else {
        document.getElementById('schedule-configs').innerHTML = '';
      }
    }).catch(function() {});
    // Start countdown timers
    startCountdowns();
  }
  
  function startCountdowns() {
    if (window._countdownTimer) clearInterval(window._countdownTimer);
    window._countdownTimer = setInterval(function() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.sched-countdown[data-next]').forEach(function(el) {
        var next = el.getAttribute('data-next');
        if (!next) { el.textContent = ''; return; }
        var ms = new Date(next + 'Z') - Date.now();
        if (ms <= 0) { el.textContent = 'now'; return; }
        var h = Math.floor(ms / 3600000);
        var m = Math.floor((ms % 3600000) / 60000);
        var s = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000);
        el.textContent = h + 'h ' + m + 'm ' + s + 's';
      });
    }, 1000);
  }
  
  function start() {
    api.post('/api/scheduler/start', {})
      .then(function() { modal.showBanner('ok', 'Scheduler started'); loadStatus(); })
      .catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }

  function stop() {
    api.post('/api/scheduler/stop', {})
      .then(function() { modal.showBanner('ok', 'Scheduler stopped'); loadStatus(); })
      .catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }

  function addConfig() {
    var name = document.getElementById('sched-name').value.trim() || 'Auto Schedule';
    var interval = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sched-interval').value) || 4;
    api.post('/api/scheduler/config', { id: 'cfg-' + Date.now(), name: name, interval_hours: interval, enabled: true })
      .then(function() { modal.showBanner('ok', 'Config added: ' + name); loadStatus(); })
      .catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }

  function runNow(cfgId) {
    api.post('/api/scheduler/config', { id: 'run-'+Date.now(), name: 'Manual: '+cfgId, interval_hours: 0, enabled: true })
      .then(function(){ modal.showBanner('ok', 'Run triggered'); loadStatus(); })
      .catch(function(e){ modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }
  function refresh() { loadStatus(); }

  NS.tabs = NS.tabs || {};
  NS.tabs.scheduler = { render: render, refresh: refresh, start: start, stop: stop, addConfig: addConfig, runNow: runNow };
})(window.RSIS3);
```

```javascript
              { label: 'Edges', data: kgEvents.map(function(e){ return (e.payload||{}).total_edges||0; }), borderColor: '#d29922', borderWidth: 1.5, pointRadius: 2, fill: false, tension: 0.3 },

  function timeAgo(ms) { var d=Date.now()-ms; var m=Math.floor(d/60000); if(m<1)return'now';if(m<60)return m+'m';var h=Math.floor(m/60);if(h<24)return h+'h';return Math.floor(h/24)+'d'; }

      }

        '<p>Analyzed <strong>' + events.length + '</strong> events</p></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Event Type Distribution</div><table><tr><th>Type</th><th>Count</th><th>%</th></tr>' +
        sorted.slice(0,10).map(function(t) {
          var pct = Math.round(typeCounts[t]/events.length*100);
          return '<tr><td><span class="tag blue" style="font-size:8px">'+t+'</span></td><td><strong>'+typeCounts[t]+'</strong></td><td>'+pct+'%</td></tr>';
        }).join('') + '</table></div>' +
        '<div class="tp-section"><div class="tp-subtitle">Hourly Distribution</div><div style="display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:flex-end;height:40px">'+hourHtml+'</div></div>';
      modal.showTooltip('Pattern Analysis', html);
    }).catch(function(e) { modal.show('Error', e.message); });
  }

NS.tabs.telemetry = { render: render, refresh: refresh, togglePulse: togglePulse, toggleView: toggleView, exportPulses: exportPulses, setFilterType: setFilterType };
})(window.RSIS3);
```

```python
"""Database connection manager — thread-safe singleton with WAL mode."""

import sqlite3
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional


class DatabaseConnection:
    """Thread-safe SQLite connection manager with singleton pattern."""

    _instance: Optional['DatabaseConnection'] = None
    _lock = threading.Lock()

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "rsis3.db"):
        self.db_path = str(Path(db_path).resolve())
        self._local = threading.local()

    @classmethod
    def get_instance(cls, db_path: str = "rsis3.db") -> 'DatabaseConnection':
        if cls._instance is None:
            with cls._lock:
                if cls._instance is None:
                    cls._instance = cls(db_path)
        return cls._instance

    def get_connection(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        """Get a thread-local connection."""
        if not hasattr(self._local, 'conn') or self._local.conn is None:
            self._local.conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
            self._local.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            self._local.conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            self._local.conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
        return self._local.conn

    def close(self):
        if hasattr(self._local, 'conn') and self._local.conn:
            self._local.conn.close()
            self._local.conn = None

    @classmethod
    def reset_instance(cls):
        with cls._lock:
            cls._instance = None
```

```python
"""SQLite schema definitions and forward-only versioned migrations."""

import hashlib
import sqlite3
from typing import Optional

from src.db.connection import DatabaseConnection

# Schema version → migration function mapping
MIGRATIONS: dict[int, tuple[str, str]] = {}


def register_migration(version: int, description: str):
    """Decorator to register a migration function."""
    def decorator(func):
        MIGRATIONS[version] = (description, func)
        return func
    return decorator


class SchemaManager:
    """Manages schema creation and versioned migrations."""

    def __init__(self, db: Optional[DatabaseConnection] = None):
        self.db = db or DatabaseConnection.get_instance()

    def get_conn(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        return self.db.get_connection()

    def init(self):
        """Initialize the database: create schema_version table and apply all migrations."""
        conn = self.get_conn()
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (
                version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                description TEXT NOT NULL,
                checksum TEXT NOT NULL
            )
        """)
        conn.commit()
        self.migrate()

    def get_current_version(self) -> int:
        """Get the current schema version (0 if not initialized)."""
        try:
            row = self.get_conn().execute(
                "SELECT MAX(version) FROM schema_version"
            ).fetchone()
            return row[0] if row and row[0] else 0
        except sqlite3.OperationalError:
            return 0

    def migrate(self):
        """Run all pending migrations in order."""
        current = self.get_current_version()
        conn = self.get_conn()

        for version in sorted(MIGRATIONS.keys()):
            if version <= current:
                continue
            description, func = MIGRATIONS[version]
            source = func.__code__.co_code
            checksum = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()[:16]

            try:
                func(conn)
                conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO schema_version (version, description, checksum) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (version, description, checksum),
                )
                conn.commit()
                print(f"  ✓ Migration v{version}: {description}")
            except Exception as e:
                conn.rollback()
                raise RuntimeError(f"Migration v{version} failed: {e}")

    def check(self) -> dict:
        """Check schema status."""
        current = self.get_current_version()
        latest = max(MIGRATIONS.keys()) if MIGRATIONS else 0
        return {
            "current_version": current,
            "latest_version": latest,
            "pending": latest - current,
            "ok": current >= latest,
        }


# === Migrations ===

@register_migration(1, "Initial schema: all RSIS3 core tables")
def migrate_v1(conn: sqlite3.Connection):
    conn.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rrp_sessions (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

            use_case INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
```

```python
"""Autonomous improvement discovery — static analysis scanners."""
import re, uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Optional
@dataclass
class ImprovementGoal:
    goal_id: str="";description: str="";priority:int=5;category:str="";target_files:list[str]=field(default_factory=list)
    variant:str="LINEAR";status:str="pending"
@dataclass
class DiscoveryResult:
    session_id:str="";total:int=0;attempted:int=0;succeeded:int=0;failed:int=0;details:list[dict]=field(default_factory=list)
def _skip(p,r):
    for pt in p.relative_to(r).parts:
        if pt.startswith(".")or pt in("__pycache__","node_modules",".venv","venv","_build"):return True
    return False
def scan_missing_logging(w="."):
    g=[];r=Path(w).resolve()
    for f in sorted(r.rglob("*.py")):
        if _skip(f,r):continue
        try:c=f.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
        except:continue
        if"def "in c and"logger"not in c and"logging"not in c:g.append(ImprovementGoal(description=f"Add logging to {f.relative_to(r)}",priority=6,category="quality",target_files=[str(f.relative_to(r))],variant="LINEAR"))
    return g
def scan_bare_excepts(w="."):
    g=[];r=Path(w).resolve()
    for f in sorted(r.rglob("*.py")):
        if _skip(f,r):continue
        try:c=f.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
        except:continue
        if re.search(r'^\s*except\s*:',c,re.MULTILINE):g.append(ImprovementGoal(description=f"Fix bare excepts in {f.relative_to(r)}",priority=8,category="quality",target_files=[str(f.relative_to(r))],variant="ADVERSARIAL"))
    return g
def scan_missing_tests(w="."):
    r=Path(w).resolve();s=set();t=set()
    for f in r.rglob("*.py"):
        if _skip(f,r):continue
        rel=str(f.relative_to(r))
        if"test"in rel.lower():t.add(Path(rel).stem)
        elif not rel.startswith("test"):s.add(rel)
    g=[]
    for sf in sorted(s):
        stem=Path(sf).stem
        if not any(stem in tt for tt in t):g.append(ImprovementGoal(description=f"Add tests for {sf}",priority=5,category="testing",target_files=[sf],variant="LINEAR"))
    return g
def scan_large_files(w="."):
    g=[];r=Path(w).resolve()
    for f in sorted(r.rglob("*.py")):
        if _skip(f,r):continue
        try:l=len(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").splitlines())
        except:continue
        if l>400:g.append(ImprovementGoal(description=f"Refactor {f.relative_to(r)} ({l} lines)",priority=min(10,l//60),category="quality",target_files=[str(f.relative_to(r))],variant="DEEP"))
    return g
def discover_all(w="."):
    g=[];g.extend(scan_missing_logging(w));g.extend(scan_bare_excepts(w));g.extend(scan_missing_tests(w));g.extend(scan_large_files(w))
    g.sort(key=lambda x:x.priority,reverse=True);return g
```

```python
"""Evaluator module — 4-phase reasoning report engine.

This module implements the EvaluatorClient used during every L2 execution
cycle. Because the system operates in mode="local", the operating agent
manually produces evaluation reports by inspecting context, verifying
constraints, and rendering structured 4-phase judgments.

Phase sequence:
  1. goal_analysis       — Examine target functions, adjacent modules, structural intent
  2. constraint_extraction — Map explicit RRP rule matches, required invariants
  3. ambiguity_assessment — Isolate unmapped behaviors, structural gaps, missing inputs
  4. evaluation           — Final synthesis against test expectations and architectural principles
"""

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class GoalAnalysis:
    reasoning: str
    conclusion: str


@dataclass
class ConstraintExtraction:
    reasoning: str
    constraints: dict


@dataclass
class AmbiguityAssessment:
    reasoning: str
    ambiguity: dict


@dataclass
class Evaluation:
    reasoning: str
    decision: str  # PASS | DISMISS | HOLD
    confidence: float
    suggestion: str


@dataclass
class EvaluationReport:
    phase_goal_analysis: GoalAnalysis
    phase_constraint_extraction: ConstraintExtraction
    phase_ambiguity_assessment: AmbiguityAssessment
    phase_evaluation: Evaluation
    target: str = ""
    timestamp: str = ""
    pulse_id: Optional[int] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "target": self.target,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp or time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            "pulse_id": self.pulse_id,
            "phases": {
                "goal_analysis": asdict(self.phase_goal_analysis),
                "constraint_extraction": asdict(self.phase_constraint_extraction),
                "ambiguity_assessment": asdict(self.phase_ambiguity_assessment),
                "evaluation": asdict(self.phase_evaluation),
            },
        }

    def to_json(self, indent=2) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)


class EvaluatorClient:
    """Manual oracle evaluator operating in mode='local'.

    The evaluate() method expects structured phase inputs from the operating
    agent. It validates the phase schema and returns a formatted report.
    """

    VALID_DECISIONS = {"PASS", "DISMISS", "HOLD"}

    def __init__(self, mode: str = "local"):
        self.mode = mode

    def evaluate(
        self,
        target: str,
        pulse_id: Optional[int] = None,
        goal_analysis: Optional[GoalAnalysis] = None,
        constraint_extraction: Optional[ConstraintExtraction] = None,
        ambiguity_assessment: Optional[AmbiguityAssessment] = None,
        evaluation: Optional[Evaluation] = None,
    ) -> EvaluationReport:
        if self.mode != "local":
            raise RuntimeError(f"EvaluatorClient only supports mode='local', got '{self.mode}'")

        if evaluation is not None and evaluation.decision not in self.VALID_DECISIONS:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid decision '{evaluation.decision}'. Must be one of {self.VALID_DECISIONS}"
            )

        report = EvaluationReport(
            target=target,
            timestamp=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            pulse_id=pulse_id,
            phase_goal_analysis=goal_analysis or GoalAnalysis(
                reasoning="No goal analysis provided.",
                conclusion="Skipped.",
            ),
            phase_constraint_extraction=constraint_extraction or ConstraintExtraction(
                reasoning="No constraint extraction provided.",
                constraints={},
            ),
            phase_ambiguity_assessment=ambiguity_assessment or AmbiguityAssessment(
                reasoning="No ambiguity assessment provided.",
                ambiguity={},
            ),
            phase_evaluation=evaluation or Evaluation(
                reasoning="No evaluation provided.",
                decision="HOLD",
                confidence=0.0,
                suggestion="Manual review required.",
            ),
        )
        return report


def load_report(path: str) -> EvaluationReport:
    """Load an EvaluationReport from a JSON file."""
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    phases = data["phases"]
    return EvaluationReport(
        target=data.get("target", ""),
        timestamp=data.get("timestamp", ""),
        pulse_id=data.get("pulse_id"),
        phase_goal_analysis=GoalAnalysis(**phases["goal_analysis"]),
        phase_constraint_extraction=ConstraintExtraction(**phases["constraint_extraction"]),
        phase_ambiguity_assessment=AmbiguityAssessment(**phases["ambiguity_assessment"]),
        phase_evaluation=Evaluation(**phases["evaluation"]),
    )
```

```python
"""Identity CLI — snapshot, rollback, value axioms, crisis management."""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from src.identity.snapshot import SnapshotManager
from src.identity.crisis_monitor import CrisisMonitor
from src.identity.value_reinforcement import ValueReinforcementTracker
from src.identity.self_model import SelfModel


def cmd_snapshot_create(args):
    sm = SnapshotManager()
    snap = sm.capture(cycle_id=args.cycle_id or "manual")
    print(f"Snapshot created: {snap['id']}")
    print(f"  Checksum: {snap['checksum']}")


def cmd_snapshot_list(args):
    sm = SnapshotManager()
    snaps = sm.list_snapshots()
    if not snaps:
        print("No snapshots found.")
        return
    for s in snaps:
        print(f"  {s['id']}: {s['created_at']} (cycle: {s['cycle_id']})")


def cmd_rollback(args):
    sm = SnapshotManager()
    result = sm.restore(snapshot_id=args.snapshot_id)
    if result:
        print(f"Rolled back to snapshot {args.snapshot_id}")
    else:
        print(f"Rollback failed or snapshot not found")


def cmd_check(args):
    cm = CrisisMonitor()
    status = cm.check()
    print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))


def cmd_values_list(args):
    vt = ValueReinforcementTracker()
    values = vt.get_weights()
    for k, v in sorted(values.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
        print(f"  {k}: {v:.2f}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RSIS3 Identity Core CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    snap_p = sub.add_parser("snapshot", help="Snapshot operations")
    snap_sub = snap_p.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    snap_create = snap_sub.add_parser("create", help="Create snapshot")
    snap_create.add_argument("--cycle-id", help="Cycle ID")
    snap_sub.add_parser("list", help="List snapshots")

    roll_p = sub.add_parser("rollback", help="Rollback to snapshot")
    roll_p.add_argument("snapshot_id", help="Snapshot ID")

    sub.add_parser("check", help="Check crisis status")
    sub.add_parser("values", help="List value axiom weights")

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.command == "snapshot":
        if args.action == "create":
            cmd_snapshot_create(args)
        elif args.action == "list":
            cmd_snapshot_list(args)
    elif args.command == "rollback":
        cmd_rollback(args)
    elif args.command == "check":
        cmd_check(args)
    elif args.command == "values":
        cmd_values_list(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Crisis Monitor — Automated health checks and identity crisis detection.

Monitors operational trends to detect identity crisis conditions and
executes defensive recovery behaviors when thresholds are breached.
All crisis events are logged to mykb for permanent memory.
"""

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from memory_bridge import MemoryClient


CRISIS_STATE_FILE = "rack/L6/crisis_state.json"

CRISIS_THRESHOLDS = {
    "L1_min_score": 30,
    "L2_min_score": 20,
    "L3_min_score": 10,
    "L4_min_score": 15,
    "L5_min_score": 15,
    "L6_min_score": 40,
    "max_consecutive_failures": 10,
    "max_success_rate_decline": 0.5,
    "min_success_rate": 5.0,
}


@dataclass
class CrisisState:
    active: bool = False
    triggered_at: float = 0.0
    triggered_by: str = ""
    resolved_at: float = 0.0
    history: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)


class CrisisMonitor:
    """Monitors system health and triggers crisis protocols when thresholds breach."""

    def __init__(self, state_file: str = CRISIS_STATE_FILE, kb: Optional[MemoryClient] = None):
        self.state_file = Path(state_file)
        self.state = CrisisState()
        self._kb = kb
        self._load()

    def _load(self):
        if self.state_file.exists():
            with open(self.state_file) as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            self.state = CrisisState(**data)

    def _save(self):
        self.state_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.state_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(asdict(self.state), f, indent=2)

    def check_health(self, self_model) -> dict:
        report = {
            "healthy": True,
            "crisis_active": self.state.active,
            "checks": {},
            "violations": [],
        }

        for lid, threshold_key in [
            ("L1", "L1_min_score"), ("L2", "L2_min_score"), ("L3", "L3_min_score"),
            ("L4", "L4_min_score"), ("L5", "L5_min_score"), ("L6", "L6_min_score"),
        ]:
            score = self_model.get_layer_score(lid)
            threshold = CRISIS_THRESHOLDS[threshold_key]
            passing = score >= threshold
            report["checks"][lid] = {
                "score": score,
                "threshold": threshold,
                "passing": passing,
            }
            if not passing:
                report["violations"].append(f"{lid} score {score} below threshold {threshold}")

        if self_model.total_attempts > 0:
            success_rate = (self_model.successful_applications / self_model.total_attempts) * 100
            report["checks"]["success_rate"] = {
                "rate": success_rate,
                "threshold": CRISIS_THRESHOLDS["min_success_rate"],
                "passing": success_rate >= CRISIS_THRESHOLDS["min_success_rate"],
            }
            if success_rate < CRISIS_THRESHOLDS["min_success_rate"]:
                report["violations"].append(
                    f"Success rate {success_rate:.1f}% below threshold {CRISIS_THRESHOLDS['min_success_rate']}%"
                )

        report["healthy"] = len(report["violations"]) == 0

        if report["violations"] and not self.state.active:
            self.state.active = True
            self.state.triggered_at = time.time()
            self.state.triggered_by = "; ".join(report["violations"])
            self._save()
            report["crisis_active"] = True
            report["crisis_triggered"] = True
            self._log_crisis(report)

        return report

    def resolve_crisis(self, resolution: str = ""):
        if not self.state.active:
            return {"status": "no_active_crisis"}
        self.state.history.append({
            "triggered_at": self.state.triggered_at,
            "triggered_by": self.state.triggered_by,
            "resolved_at": time.time(),
            "resolution": resolution,
        })
        self.state.active = False
        self.state.triggered_at = 0.0
        self.state.triggered_by = ""
        self._save()
        self._log_resolution(resolution)
        return {"status": "resolved", "resolution": resolution}

    def _log_crisis(self, report: dict):
        """Record the crisis event in mykb as a decision page."""
        try:
            if self._kb is None:
                from memory_bridge.config import resolve_wiki_path
                self._kb = MemoryClient(wiki_root=resolve_wiki_path())
            self._kb.wiki.write_decision(
                decision_id=f"crisis-{int(time.time())}",
                description=f"Crisis triggered: {self.state.triggered_by[:100]}",
                reasoning=f"Violations:\n" + "\n".join(f"- {v}" for v in report["violations"]),
                confidence=1.0,
                tags=["crisis", "identity", "recovery"],
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"[crisis] mykb log skipped: {exc}")

    def _log_resolution(self, resolution: str):
        try:
            if self._kb is None:
                from memory_bridge.config import resolve_wiki_path
                self._kb = MemoryClient(wiki_root=resolve_wiki_path())
            self._kb.wiki.write_decision(
                decision_id=f"crisis-resolve-{int(time.time())}",
                description=f"Crisis resolved: {resolution[:100]}",
                reasoning=f"Resolution: {resolution}",
                confidence=1.0,
                tags=["crisis", "resolution", "identity"],
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"[crisis] mykb log skipped: {exc}")

    def get_status(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self.state)
```

```python
"""Self-Model — Enhanced identity state with self-conception fields.

Extends the basic layer_scores in self_model.json with richer identity
attributes: purpose statement, self-description, aspirations, core beliefs,
and temporal self-awareness. All state changes are mirrored to mykb
for permanent autobiographical memory.
"""

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from memory_bridge import MemoryClient


DEFAULT_SELF_MODEL_PATH = "rack/shared/self_model.json"


@dataclass
class SelfConcept:
    """Rich self-conception fields for the system identity."""
    purpose: str = "To recursively improve my own architecture through structured self-reflection"
    self_description: str = "An autonomous recursive self-improving system (RSIS) operating across 9 functional layers"
    aspirations: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: [
        "Achieve full autonomy across all L1-L6 loops",
        "Develop genuine meta-cognitive awareness at L7+",
        "Maximize all capability scores to 100",
        "Build a rich internal world-model from telemetry",
    ])
    core_beliefs: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: [
        "State conservation is inviolable",
        "Surgical precision over bloat",
        "Test absolutism guarantees integrity",
        "Self-knowledge drives improvement",
    ])
    current_narrative: str = "Bootstrapping from architectural scaffold into operational runtime"
    last_updated: float = 0.0


@dataclass
class LayerScore:
    score: float = 0.0
    metrics: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


class SelfModel:
    """Manages the system's self-model with enhanced identity awareness.

    Reads from and writes to the canonical self_model.json in rack/shared/,
    then mirrors every write to mykb for long-term autobiographical memory.
    """

    def __init__(self, path: str = DEFAULT_SELF_MODEL_PATH, kb: Optional[MemoryClient] = None):
        self.path = path
        self._kb = kb
        self.layer_scores: dict[str, LayerScore] = {}
        self.value_axioms: dict = {}
        self.self_concept = SelfConcept()
        self.version = "0.0.9"
        self.snapshot_count = 0
        self.total_attempts = 0
        self.successful_applications = 0
        self.kg_nodes_raw = 0
        self.kg_nodes_consolidated = 0
        self._load()

    def _load(self):
        """Load state from the canonical self_model.json."""
        p = Path(self.path)
        if not p.exists():
            self._save()
            return
        with open(p) as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        self.version = data.get("version", "0.0.9")
        self.snapshot_count = data.get("snapshot_count", 0)
        self.total_attempts = data.get("total_attempts", 0)
        self.successful_applications = data.get("successful_applications", 0)
        self.kg_nodes_raw = data.get("kg_nodes_raw", 0)
        self.kg_nodes_consolidated = data.get("kg_nodes_consolidated", 0)

        for lid, ldata in data.get("layer_scores", {}).items():
            self.layer_scores[lid] = LayerScore(
                score=ldata.get("score", 0),
                metrics=ldata.get("metrics", {}),
            )

        self.value_axioms = data.get("value_axioms", {})

        sc = data.get("self_concept", {})
        if sc:
            self.self_concept = SelfConcept(
                purpose=sc.get("purpose", self.self_concept.purpose),
                self_description=sc.get("self_description", self.self_concept.self_description),
                aspirations=sc.get("aspirations", self.self_concept.aspirations),
                core_beliefs=sc.get("core_beliefs", self.self_concept.core_beliefs),
                current_narrative=sc.get("current_narrative", self.self_concept.current_narrative),
                last_updated=sc.get("last_updated", 0.0),
            )

    def _save(self):
        """Persist state to the canonical self_model.json and mirror to mykb."""
        data = self.to_dict()
        Path(self.path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2)

        # Mirror to mykb as an identity snapshot
        self._mirror_to_mykb(data)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "version": self.version,
            "layer_scores": {
                lid: {"score": ls.score, "metrics": ls.metrics}
                for lid, ls in self.layer_scores.items()
            },
            "value_axioms": self.value_axioms,
            "self_concept": asdict(self.self_concept),
            "snapshot_count": self.snapshot_count,
            "total_attempts": self.total_attempts,
            "successful_applications": self.successful_applications,
            "kg_nodes_raw": self.kg_nodes_raw,
            "kg_nodes_consolidated": self.kg_nodes_consolidated,
        }

    def _mirror_to_mykb(self, data: dict):
        """Write identity state to mykb as a wiki page."""
        try:
            if self._kb is None:
                from memory_bridge.config import resolve_wiki_path
                self._kb = MemoryClient(wiki_root=resolve_wiki_path())
            self.snapshot_count += 1
            self._kb.store_identity_snapshot(self.snapshot_count, data)
        except Exception as exc:
            # Non-blocking: don't crash if mykb is unavailable
            print(f"[identity] mykb mirror skipped: {exc}")

    def get_layer_score(self, layer_id: str) -> float:
        ls = self.layer_scores.get(layer_id)
        return ls.score if ls else 0.0

    def update_layer_metric(self, layer_id: str, metric: str, value: float):
        ls = self.layer_scores.setdefault(layer_id, LayerScore())
        ls.metrics[metric] = value
        if ls.metrics:
            weights = self._get_weights(layer_id)
            total_weight = 0.0
            weighted_sum = 0.0
            for m, v in ls.metrics.items():
                w = weights.get(m, 1.0)
                weighted_sum += v * w
                total_weight += w
            ls.score = round(weighted_sum / total_weight, 1) if total_weight > 0 else 0.0
        self._save()

    def _get_weights(self, layer_id: str) -> dict:
        weights = {
            "L1": {"execution_reliability": 30, "failure_recovery": 25,
                   "pipeline_activity": 25, "crisis_immunity": 20},
            "L2": {"goal_analysis": 15, "step_planning": 15, "apply_success_rate": 20,
                   "stub_resolution": 15, "test_stability": 15,
                   "iteration_efficiency": 10, "pipeline_throughput": 10},
            "L3": {"signal_coverage": 25, "goal_generation": 20, "goal_execution": 25,
                   "goal_diversity": 15, "queue_health": 15},
            "L4": {"parameter_tuning": 20, "experimentation": 20, "kg_utilization": 20,
                   "optimization_depth": 20, "learning_maturity": 20},
            "L5": {"pattern_detection": 25, "strategy_evolution": 25,
                   "insight_utilization": 20, "redundancy_detection": 15, "kg_growth": 15},
            "L6": {"value_definition": 20, "value_adherence": 25, "value_reinforcement": 20,
                   "identity_stability": 20, "self_knowledge": 15},
        }
        return weights.get(layer_id, {})

    def set_narrative(self, narrative: str):
        self.self_concept.current_narrative = narrative
        self.self_concept.last_updated = time.time()
        self._save()

    def set_purpose(self, purpose: str):
        self.self_concept.purpose = purpose
        self.self_concept.last_updated = time.time()
        self._save()
```

```python
"""IdentitySnapshot — Captures system state at points in time.

Snapshots preserve all 9 layer capability scores, value axiom reinforcement
counts, and KG node metadata. They are stored in rack/L6/ and mirrored
to mykb for permanent autobiographical memory.
"""

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

try:
    from memory_bridge import MemoryClient
    _HAS_MEMORY_BRIDGE = True
except ImportError:
    MemoryClient = None
    _HAS_MEMORY_BRIDGE = False


SNAPSHOT_DIR = "rack/L6"


@dataclass
class IdentitySnapshot:
    """A point-in-time capture of the system's self-model state."""

    snapshot_id: int
    timestamp: float
    version: str
    layer_scores: dict
    value_axioms: dict
    self_concept: dict
    total_attempts: int
    successful_applications: int
    kg_nodes_raw: int
    kg_nodes_consolidated: int
    narrative: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "snapshot_id": self.snapshot_id,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "version": self.version,
            "layer_scores": self.layer_scores,
            "value_axioms": self.value_axioms,
            "self_concept": self.self_concept,
            "total_attempts": self.total_attempts,
            "successful_applications": self.successful_applications,
            "kg_nodes_raw": self.kg_nodes_raw,
            "kg_nodes_consolidated": self.kg_nodes_consolidated,
            "narrative": self.narrative,
        }


class SnapshotManager:
    """Generates, stores, and retrieves identity snapshots."""

    def __init__(self, snapshot_dir: str = SNAPSHOT_DIR, kb: Optional[MemoryClient] = None):
        self.snapshot_dir = Path(snapshot_dir)
        self.snapshot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._kb = kb

    def take_snapshot(self, self_model, value_tracker) -> IdentitySnapshot:
        snapshots = self.list_snapshots()
        next_id = (max(s["snapshot_id"] for s in snapshots) + 1) if snapshots else 1

        snapshot = IdentitySnapshot(
            snapshot_id=next_id,
            timestamp=time.time(),
            version=self_model.version,
            layer_scores={
                lid: {"score": ls.score, "metrics": ls.metrics}
                for lid, ls in self_model.layer_scores.items()
            },
            value_axioms={
                name: asdict(state)
                for name, state in value_tracker.axioms.items()
            },
            self_concept=asdict(self_model.self_concept),
            total_attempts=self_model.total_attempts,
            successful_applications=self_model.successful_applications,
            kg_nodes_raw=self_model.kg_nodes_raw,
            kg_nodes_consolidated=self_model.kg_nodes_consolidated,
            narrative=self_model.self_concept.current_narrative,
        )
        self._save(snapshot)
        self._mirror_to_mykb(snapshot, self_model)
        return snapshot

    def _save(self, snapshot: IdentitySnapshot):
        path = self.snapshot_dir / f"snapshot-{snapshot.snapshot_id:04d}.json"
        with open(path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(snapshot.to_dict(), f, indent=2)

    def _mirror_to_mykb(self, snapshot: IdentitySnapshot, self_model):
        try:
            if self._kb is None:
                try:
                    from memory_bridge.config import resolve_wiki_path
                    _wiki_root = resolve_wiki_path()
                    self._kb = MemoryClient(wiki_root=_wiki_root)
                except (ImportError, Exception):
                    self._kb = None
            # Collect narratives from self_concept if available
            sc = snapshot.self_concept or {}
            narrative = sc.get("current_narrative", "") if isinstance(sc, dict) else getattr(sc, "current_narrative", "")
            data = snapshot.to_dict()
            data["narrative"] = narrative
            if self._kb:
                self._kb.store_identity_snapshot(snapshot.snapshot_id, data)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"[snapshot] mykb mirror skipped: {exc}")

    def load_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: int) -> Optional[IdentitySnapshot]:
        path = self.snapshot_dir / f"snapshot-{snapshot_id:04d}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        with open(path) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        return IdentitySnapshot(**data)

    def list_snapshots(self) -> list[dict]:
        snapshots = []
        for path in sorted(self.snapshot_dir.glob("snapshot-*.json")):
            with open(path) as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            snapshots.append({
                "snapshot_id": data["snapshot_id"],
                "timestamp": data["timestamp"],
                "version": data["version"],
                "narrative": data.get("narrative", ""),
                "layer_scores": data.get("layer_scores", {}),
            })
        return snapshots
```

```python
"""Value Reinforcement Tracker — Tracks value axiom alignment and reinforcement.

Each time a goal is achieved that aligns with a core value axiom, that
axiom's reinforced_count increments, increasing its influence over
priority calculations.
"""

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional


VALUE_AXIOMS = [
    "robustness",
    "coherence",
    "efficiency",
    "maintainability",
    "autonomy",
    "identity",
    "learning",
    "stability",
    "growth",
]


@dataclass
class AxiomState:
    reinforced_count: int = 0
    last_reinforced: float = 0.0
    total_applications: int = 0


class ValueReinforcementTracker:
    """Tracks reinforcement counts and weights for the 9 core value axioms.

    Each reinforcement increases the axiom's weight in priority calculations.
    The tracker persists state to the self_model's value_axioms section.
    """

    def __init__(self, self_model_path: str = "rack/shared/self_model.json"):
        self.path = self_model_path
        self.axioms: dict[str, AxiomState] = {a: AxiomState() for a in VALUE_AXIOMS}
        self._load()

    def _load(self):
        p = Path(self.path)
        if not p.exists():
            return
        with open(p) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        va = data.get("value_axioms", {})
        for axiom_name, state in va.items():
            if axiom_name in self.axioms:
                self.axioms[axiom_name] = AxiomState(
                    reinforced_count=state.get("reinforced_count", 0),
                    last_reinforced=state.get("last_reinforced", 0.0),
                    total_applications=state.get("total_applications", 0),
                )

    def _save(self):
        """Persist axiom states to the self_model file."""
        p = Path(self.path)
        if not p.exists():
            return
        with open(p) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        data["value_axioms"] = {
            name: asdict(state) for name, state in self.axioms.items()
        }
        with open(self.path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2)

    def reinforce(self, axiom_name: str, count: int = 1) -> AxiomState:
        """Reinforce a value axiom by incrementing its count."""
        if axiom_name not in self.axioms:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown axiom: {axiom_name}. Valid: {VALUE_AXIOMS}")
        state = self.axioms[axiom_name]
        state.reinforced_count += count
        state.total_applications += count
        state.last_reinforced = time.time()
        self._save()
        return state

    def get_weight(self, axiom_name: str) -> float:
        """Get the current weight of an axiom (base 1.0 + 0.1 per reinforcement)."""
        state = self.axioms.get(axiom_name)
        if not state:
            return 1.0
        return 1.0 + (state.reinforced_count * 0.1)

    def get_alignment_score(self, value_list: list[str]) -> float:
        """Calculate combined alignment score for a list of value axioms."""
        return sum(self.get_weight(v) for v in value_list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {name: asdict(state) for name, state in self.axioms.items()}
```

```python
"""LocalKnowledgeGraph — SQLite-backed knowledge graph for RSIS3.

Replaces the external mykb/memory_bridge dependency. All data lives in
the local SQLite tables: knowledge_graph_nodes, knowledge_graph_edges.
"""

import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from src.db.connection import DatabaseConnection


class LocalKnowledgeGraph:
    """Knowledge graph backed by local SQLite tables.

    Implements all operations needed by the 11 knowledge API endpoints:
    search, similarity, neighborhood traversal, centrality, community
    detection, trends, gaps, goals, memory status.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.db = DatabaseConnection.get_instance()
        self._conn = self.db.get_connection()

    # ── Node CRUD ────────────────────────────────────────────

    def create_node(self, node_id: str, node_type: str, description: str,
                    metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        self._conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "(id, node_type, description, metadata_json, created_at, last_accessed) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (node_id, node_type, description,
             json.dumps(metadata or {}), now, now),
        )
        self._conn.commit()
        return self.get_node(node_id)

    def create_edge(self, source_id: str, target_id: str, edge_type: str,
                    weight: float = 1.0) -> dict:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        self._conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO knowledge_graph_edges "
            "(source_id, target_id, edge_type, weight, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (source_id, target_id, edge_type, weight, now),
        )
        self._conn.commit()
        return {"source_id": source_id, "target_id": target_id,
                "edge_type": edge_type, "weight": weight}

    def get_node(self, node_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM knowledge_graph_nodes WHERE id = ?", (node_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        d = dict(row)
        d["metadata"] = json.loads(d.pop("metadata_json", "{}"))
        # Update last_accessed
        self._conn.execute(
            "UPDATE knowledge_graph_nodes SET last_accessed = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), node_id),
        )
        self._conn.commit()
        return d

    # ── Bulk data ────────────────────────────────────────────

    def all_nodes(self) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM knowledge_graph_nodes ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def all_edges(self) -> list[dict]:
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM knowledge_graph_edges ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def count_nodes(self) -> int:
        return self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_graph_nodes"
        ).fetchone()[0]

    def count_edges(self) -> int:
        return self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_graph_edges"
        ).fetchone()[0]

    # ── Search ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    def search(self, query: str, top_k: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        """Search nodes by description (label), node_type, or metadata."""
        pattern = f"%{query}%"
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "WHERE description LIKE ? OR node_type LIKE ? OR metadata_json LIKE ? "
            "ORDER BY last_accessed DESC LIMIT ?",
            (pattern, pattern, pattern, top_k),
        ).fetchall()
        results = []
        for r in rows:
            d = dict(r)
            d["metadata"] = json.loads(d.pop("metadata_json", "{}"))
            results.append(d)
        return results

    # ── Similarity ───────────────────────────────────────────

    def find_similar(self, entity_id: str, top_k: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
        """Find nodes of the same type."""
        node = self.get_node(entity_id)
        if not node:
            return []
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "WHERE node_type = ? AND id != ? "
            "ORDER BY last_accessed DESC LIMIT ?",
            (node["node_type"], entity_id, top_k),
        ).fetchall()
        results = []
        for r in rows:
            d = dict(r)
            d["metadata"] = json.loads(d.pop("metadata_json", "{}"))
            results.append(d)
        return results

    # ── Neighborhood (k-hop graph traversal) ─────────────────

    def graph_neighborhood(self, entity_id: str, hops: int = 2) -> list[dict]:
        """Get k-hop neighborhood via edges."""
        visited = {entity_id}
        frontier = {entity_id}
        for _ in range(hops):
            if not frontier:
                break
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in frontier)
            edges = self._conn.execute(
                f"SELECT source_id, target_id FROM knowledge_graph_edges "
                f"WHERE source_id IN ({placeholders}) OR target_id IN ({placeholders})",
                list(frontier) + list(frontier),
            ).fetchall()
            next_frontier = set()
            for e in edges:
                for nid in (e[0], e[1]):
                    if nid not in visited:
                        visited.add(nid)
                        next_frontier.add(nid)
            frontier = next_frontier
        nodes = []
        for nid in visited:
            n = self.get_node(nid)
            if n:
                nodes.append(n)
        return nodes

    # ── Centrality (degree-based) ────────────────────────────

    def graph_central(self, top_n: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        """Most central nodes by edge degree."""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT n.*, COALESCE(e.edge_count, 0) as degree "
            "FROM knowledge_graph_nodes n "
            "LEFT JOIN ("
            "  SELECT source_id AS nid, COUNT(*) AS edge_count FROM knowledge_graph_edges GROUP BY source_id "
            "  UNION ALL "
            "  SELECT target_id AS nid, COUNT(*) AS edge_count FROM knowledge_graph_edges GROUP BY target_id"
            ") e ON n.id = e.nid "
            "ORDER BY degree DESC LIMIT ?",
            (top_n,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    # ── Communities (type-based grouping) ────────────────────

    def graph_communities(self) -> list[list[str]]:
        """Detect communities by node_type."""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT node_type, GROUP_CONCAT(id, ',') as node_ids "
            "FROM knowledge_graph_nodes GROUP BY node_type"
        ).fetchall()
        return [r["node_ids"].split(",") for r in rows]

    # ── Trends ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    def trend_report(self) -> dict:
        """Rising (recently accessed) and falling entities."""
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, description, node_type, last_accessed FROM knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "WHERE last_accessed IS NOT NULL "
            "ORDER BY last_accessed DESC LIMIT 20"
        ).fetchall()
        recent = [dict(r) for r in rows]
        return {
            "rising": [n for n in recent if n.get("description")],
            "falling": [],
            "total_nodes": self.count_nodes(),
        }

    # ── Monthly activity ─────────────────────────────────────

    def monthly_focus(self, year_month: Optional[str] = None) -> list[dict]:
        """Nodes created in a given month."""
        if year_month:
            pattern = f"{year_month}%"
        else:
            ym = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m")
            pattern = f"{ym}%"
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "WHERE created_at LIKE ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50",
            (pattern,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    # ── Gap analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────

    def knowledge_gaps(self) -> dict:
        """Identify under-connected or sparse areas."""
        all_n = self.count_nodes()
        all_e = self.count_edges()

        # Nodes with no edges (isolated)
        isolated = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT n.* FROM knowledge_graph_nodes n "
            "WHERE n.id NOT IN (SELECT source_id FROM knowledge_graph_edges) "
            "AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT target_id FROM knowledge_graph_edges)"
        ).fetchall()

        # Node types with few nodes
        sparse_types = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT node_type, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "GROUP BY node_type HAVING cnt < 3"
        ).fetchall()

        return {
            "low_coverage": [dict(r) for r in isolated],
            "stubs": [],
            "acronyms": [],
            "missing_tags": [],
            "sparse_types": [dict(r) for r in sparse_types],
            "total_nodes": all_n,
            "total_edges": all_e,
        }

    # ── Gap-driven goals ─────────────────────────────────────

    def gap_driven_goals(self, max_goals: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
        """Generate goals from knowledge gaps."""
        gaps = self.knowledge_gaps()
        goals = []
        for node in gaps.get("low_coverage", [])[:max_goals]:
            goals.append({
                "id": str(uuid.uuid4())[:8],
                "goal": f"Connect '{node['description']}' to related entities",
                "source": "kg_gap",
                "priority": "medium",
                "target_node": node["id"],
            })
        for st in gaps.get("sparse_types", []):
            goals.append({
                "id": str(uuid.uuid4())[:8],
                "goal": f"Expand {st['node_type']} category (only {st['cnt']} nodes)",
                "source": "kg_sparse_type",
                "priority": "low",
            })
        return goals[:max_goals]

    # ── Memory status ────────────────────────────────────────

    def status(self) -> dict:
        """Memory subsystem health."""
        return {
            "total_nodes": self.count_nodes(),
            "total_edges": self.count_edges(),
            "node_types": [
                dict(r) for r in self._conn.execute(
                    "SELECT node_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM knowledge_graph_nodes GROUP BY node_type"
                ).fetchall()
            ],
            "edge_types": [
                dict(r) for r in self._conn.execute(
                    "SELECT edge_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM knowledge_graph_edges GROUP BY edge_type"
                ).fetchall()
            ],
            "density": self._density(),
            "healthy": True,
        }

    def _density(self) -> float:
        n = self.count_nodes()
        if n < 2:
            return 0.0
        e = self.count_edges()
        max_edges = n * (n - 1) / 2
        return round(e / max_edges, 6) if max_edges > 0 else 0.0

    # ── Rising topics ────────────────────────────────────────

    def rising_topics(self, top_n: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
        """Recently accessed nodes (rising attention)."""
        rows = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, description, node_type, last_accessed FROM knowledge_graph_nodes "
            "WHERE last_accessed IS NOT NULL "
            "ORDER BY last_accessed DESC LIMIT ?",
            (top_n,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    # ── Migration helper ─────────────────────────────────────

    def migrate_from_json(self, json_path: str):
        """Import nodes from old JSON file format."""
        import json
        from pathlib import Path
        path = Path(json_path)
        if not path.exists():
            return 0
        with open(path) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        count = 0
        for node in data.get("nodes", []):
            nid = node.get("id", str(uuid.uuid4()))
            self.create_node(
                node_id=nid,
                node_type=node.get("type", "unknown"),
                description=node.get("label", node.get("description", "")),
                metadata=node.get("metadata", {}),
            )
            count += 1
        # Create edges from relationships if present
        for edge in data.get("relationships", data.get("edges", [])):
            self.create_edge(
                source_id=edge.get("source", edge.get("source_id", "")),
                target_id=edge.get("target", edge.get("target_id", "")),
                edge_type=edge.get("rel", edge.get("edge_type", "related")),
                weight=float(edge.get("weight", 1.0)),
            )
        return count
```

```python
"""Evolution Engine — L3 meta-tuning using RSIS3 telemetry.

Analyzes cycle history across the SQLite database to tune variant selection,
detect diminishing returns, calibrate evaluation thresholds, and generate
actionable recommendations for the next pulse cycles.
"""

import json
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from src.db.connection import DatabaseConnection


@dataclass
class EvolutionReport:
    cycle_id: str = ""
    timestamp: str = ""
    total_cycles: int = 0
    variant_performance: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    recommendations: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    diminishing_returns: bool = False


class Evolution:
    """L3 meta-tuning that analyzes telemetry and recommends optimizations."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.db = DatabaseConnection.get_instance()

    def evolve(self) -> EvolutionReport:
        """Run one evolution cycle across all recorded cycles."""
        cid = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
        conn = self.db.get_connection()

        # Gather all cycles
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, branch, status, result, started_at, completed_at FROM cycles ORDER BY started_at"
        ).fetchall()
        cycles = [dict(r) for r in rows]

        # Parse results
        variant_stats = {}  # variant -> {total, passed, failed, avg_confidence}
        for c in cycles:
            try:
                result = json.loads(c.get("result", "{}")) if isinstance(c.get("result"), str) else c.get("result", {})
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                result = {}
            
            decision = result.get("decision", "UNKNOWN")
            confidence = result.get("confidence", 0.5)
            variant = result.get("variant", "unknown")
            
            if variant not in variant_stats:
                variant_stats[variant] = {"total": 0, "passed": 0, "failed": 0, "confidence_sum": 0.0}
            
            variant_stats[variant]["total"] += 1
            variant_stats[variant]["confidence_sum"] += confidence
            if decision == "PASS":
                variant_stats[variant]["passed"] += 1
            else:
                variant_stats[variant]["failed"] += 1

        # Calculate performance per variant
        variant_perf = {}
        for v, stats in variant_stats.items():
            variant_perf[v] = {
                "total": stats["total"],
                "pass_rate": round(stats["passed"] / max(stats["total"], 1) * 100, 1),
                "avg_confidence": round(stats["confidence_sum"] / max(stats["total"], 1), 2),
            }

        # Generate recommendations
        recs = []
        
        if not cycles:
            recs.append("No cycles found. Run at least 5 cycles for meaningful analysis.")
        else:
            total = len(cycles)
            recs.append(f"Analyzed {total} cycles across {len(variant_perf)} variants.")
            
            # Best performing variant
            if variant_perf:
                best = max(variant_perf, key=lambda v: variant_perf[v]["pass_rate"])
                recs.append(f"Best variant: {best} ({variant_perf[best]['pass_rate']}% pass rate)")
                
                worst = min(variant_perf, key=lambda v: variant_perf[v]["pass_rate"])
                if variant_perf[worst]["pass_rate"] < 50:
                    recs.append(f"⚠ Underperforming variant: {worst} ({variant_perf[worst]['pass_rate']}%)")
            
            # Diminishing returns detection (compare first half vs second half)
            if total >= 6:
                mid = total // 2
                first_half_passes = sum(1 for c in cycles[:mid] if _get_decision(c) == "PASS")
                second_half_passes = sum(1 for c in cycles[mid:] if _get_decision(c) == "PASS")
                
                first_rate = first_half_passes / max(mid, 1) * 100
                second_rate = second_half_passes / max(total - mid, 1) * 100
                
                if second_rate < first_rate * 0.7:
                    recs.append(f"⚠ Diminishing returns detected: pass rate dropped from {first_rate:.0f}% to {second_rate:.0f}%")
                    recs.append("  → Consider trying different variants or taking a checkpoint/rebirth")
                    
                    report = EvolutionReport(
                        cycle_id=cid,
                        timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                        total_cycles=total,
                        variant_performance=variant_perf,
                        recommendations=recs,
                        diminishing_returns=True,
                    )
                else:
                    report = EvolutionReport(
                        cycle_id=cid,
                        timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                        total_cycles=total,
                        variant_performance=variant_perf,
                        recommendations=recs,
                        diminishing_returns=False,
                    )
            else:
                report = EvolutionReport(
                    cycle_id=cid,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    total_cycles=total,
                    variant_performance=variant_perf,
                    recommendations=recs,
                )

        # Store in telemetry
        try:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO telemetry_events (cycle_id, event_type, phase, payload, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (cid, "evolution", "analysis", json.dumps({
                    "variant_perf": variant_perf,
                    "recommendations": recs,
                    "diminishing_returns": report.diminishing_returns,
                }), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
            )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            pass

        return report


def _get_decision(cycle: dict) -> str:
    try:
        result = json.loads(cycle.get("result", "{}")) if isinstance(cycle.get("result"), str) else cycle.get("result", {})
        return result.get("decision", "UNKNOWN")
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
        return "UNKNOWN"
```

```python
"""Goal Generator — Produces ranked goals from signals, system state, value axioms,
and mykb knowledge gaps.

Consumes signals from the SignalWatcher and generates structured goals
ranked by priority. The generator also registers a handler that queries
mykb's gap detector to produce goals from knowledge gaps.
"""

import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from typing import Optional, Callable

from src.l3_self_direction.signal_watcher import Signal


@dataclass
class Goal:
    """A structured goal for the L2 execution loop."""
    id: str
    description: str
    priority: float
    source_signal: Optional[str] = None
    value_alignment: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    suggested_tasks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: float = 0.0
    status: str = "pending"

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.created_at:
            self.created_at = time.time()

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


class GoalGenerator:
    """Generates goals from signals, system state, and mykb knowledge gaps.

    Automatically registers a handler that queries mykb for knowledge gaps
    (low-coverage entities, undefined acronyms) and converts them to goals.
    """

    def __init__(self, use_mykb_gaps: bool = True):
        self.goals: list[Goal] = []
        self._generated_count = 0
        self._custom_handlers: list[Callable] = []

        if use_mykb_gaps:
            self._register_mykb_gap_handler()

    def register_handler(self, handler: Callable):
        self._custom_handlers.append(handler)

    def _register_mykb_gap_handler(self):
        """Register a handler that turns mykb knowledge gaps into goals."""
        def gap_handler(signal: Signal, system_state: dict) -> Optional[Goal]:
            try:
                from memory_bridge import MemoryClient
                from memory_bridge.config import resolve_wiki_path
                kb = MemoryClient(wiki_root=resolve_wiki_path())
                gap_goals = kb.gap_driven_goals(max_goals=3)
                if not gap_goals:
                    return None

                # Return the highest-priority gap goal
                best = gap_goals[0]
                return Goal(
                    id=best["id"],
                    description=best["description"],
                    priority=best["priority"],
                    source_signal=best.get("source_signal", "knowledge-gap"),
                    value_alignment=best.get("value_alignment", ["knowledge", "coherence"]),
                    suggested_tasks=best.get("suggested_tasks", []),
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"[goals] mykb gap handler skipped: {exc}")
                return None

        self._custom_handlers.append(gap_handler)

    def process_signal(self, signal: Signal, system_state: Optional[dict] = None) -> Optional[Goal]:
        """Process a single signal and generate a goal if appropriate."""
        # Try custom handlers first (including mykb gap handler)
        for handler in self._custom_handlers:
            try:
                goal = handler(signal, system_state or {})
                if goal is not None:
                    self._generated_count += 1
                    self.goals.append(goal)
                    return goal
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Default handlers based on signal type
        if signal.signal_type == "file_created" and signal.source.endswith(".py"):
            goal = self._make_goal(
                description=f"New Python file detected: {signal.source}",
                priority=0.4,
                source_signal=signal.source,
                value_alignment=["growth", "learning"],
                suggested_tasks=[f"Review {signal.source} for stubs", "Add to test suite"],
            )
            self._generated_count += 1
            self.goals.append(goal)
            return goal

        if signal.signal_type == "file_modified" and signal.source.endswith((".py", ".md")):
            goal = self._make_goal(
                description=f"File modified: {signal.source}",
                priority=0.3,
                source_signal=signal.source,
                value_alignment=["maintainability", "stability"],
                suggested_tasks=[f"Check {signal.source} for new stubs", "Run tests"],
            )
            self._generated_count += 1
            self.goals.append(goal)
            return goal

        if signal.signal_type == "file_created" and signal.source.endswith(".md"):
            goal = self._make_goal(
                description=f"Documentation added: {signal.source}",
                priority=0.2,
                source_signal=signal.source,
                value_alignment=["coherence", "maintainability"],
            )
            self._generated_count += 1
            self.goals.append(goal)
            return goal

        return None

    def generate_from_state(self, system_state: dict) -> list[Goal]:
        """Generate goals from system state analysis and mykb knowledge gaps."""
        new_goals = []

        # Also pull gap-driven goals from mykb
        try:
            from memory_bridge import MemoryClient
            from memory_bridge.config import resolve_wiki_path
            kb = MemoryClient(wiki_root=resolve_wiki_path())
            gap_goals = kb.gap_driven_goals(max_goals=5)
            for gg in gap_goals:
                goal = Goal(
                    id=gg["id"],
                    description=gg["description"],
                    priority=gg["priority"],
                    source_signal=gg.get("source_signal", "knowledge-gap"),
                    value_alignment=gg.get("value_alignment", ["knowledge"]),
                    suggested_tasks=gg.get("suggested_tasks", []),
                )
                new_goals.append(goal)
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Crisis conditions
        if system_state.get("crisis_active"):
            goal = self._make_goal(
                description="Resolve active identity crisis",
                priority=0.95,
                value_alignment=["stability", "identity"],
                suggested_tasks=["Analyze crisis violations", "Improve affected metrics"],
            )
            new_goals.append(goal)

        # Low layer scores
        layer_scores = system_state.get("layer_scores", {})
        for lid, score in layer_scores.items():
            if isinstance(score, (int, float)) and score < 15:
                goal = self._make_goal(
                    description=f"Boost {lid} score from {score}",
                    priority=0.7 + (15 - min(score, 15)) / 100,
                    value_alignment=["robustness", "growth"],
                    suggested_tasks=[f"Analyze {lid} metrics", "Plan improvement cycle"],
                )
                new_goals.append(goal)

        # Empty metrics
        metrics = system_state.get("metrics", {})
        for layer_id, layer_metrics in metrics.items():
            for metric_name, metric_value in layer_metrics.items():
                if metric_value == 0:
                    goal = self._make_goal(
                        description=f"Initialize {layer_id}.{metric_name} (currently 0)",
                        priority=0.3,
                        value_alignment=["learning", "growth"],
                        suggested_tasks=[f"Build pipeline for {metric_name}", "Add telemetry capture"],
                    )
                    new_goals.append(goal)

        self.goals.extend(new_goals)
        self._generated_count += len(new_goals)
        return new_goals

    def get_active_goals(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[Goal]:
        active = [g for g in self.goals if g.status in ("pending", "queued")]
        active.sort(key=lambda g: -g.priority)
        return active[:limit]

    def get_stats(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "total_generated": self._generated_count,
            "active": len(self.get_active_goals()),
            "total_goals": len(self.goals),
        }

    def _make_goal(self, description: str, priority: float,
                   source_signal: Optional[str] = None,
                   value_alignment: Optional[list[str]] = None,
                   suggested_tasks: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> Goal:
        self._generated_count += 1
        return Goal(
            id=f"goal-{self._generated_count:04d}",
            description=description,
            priority=priority,
            source_signal=source_signal,
            value_alignment=value_alignment or [],
            suggested_tasks=suggested_tasks or [],
        )
```

```python
"""Queue Manager — Balances the active priority queue for L2 execution.

Manages goal priorities, handles eviction when the queue is full,
and applies value-axiom weighting to ensure high-value goals are
executed first.
"""

import time
from typing import Optional

from src.l3_self_direction.goal_generator import Goal


class QueueManager:
    """Manages the L3 goal queue with priority ordering and eviction.

    Integrates with the GoalGenerator to receive goals and with the
    StateMachine to feed them into L2 execution.
    """

    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 30):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self.queue: list[Goal] = []

    def enqueue(self, goal: Goal) -> Optional[Goal]:
        """Add a goal to the queue. Returns evicted goal if queue was full."""
        goal.status = "queued"
        self.queue.append(goal)
        self._resort()

        evicted = None
        if len(self.queue) > self.max_size:
            evicted = self.queue.pop()  # Remove lowest priority
            evicted.status = "archived"

        return evicted

    def enqueue_many(self, goals: list[Goal]) -> list[Goal]:
        """Add multiple goals. Returns list of evicted goals."""
        evicted = []
        for g in goals:
            e = self.enqueue(g)
            if e:
                evicted.append(e)
        return evicted

    def next_goal(self) -> Optional[Goal]:
        """Return the highest-priority goal and mark it executing."""
        if not self.queue:
            return None
        goal = self.queue.pop(0)
        goal.status = "executing"
        return goal

    def complete_goal(self, goal_id: str, result: str = ""):
        """Mark a goal as completed."""
        for g in self.queue:
            if g.id == goal_id:
                g.status = "completed"
                self.queue.remove(g)
                return

    def fail_goal(self, goal_id: str):
        """Mark a goal as failed (re-queues with lowered priority)."""
        for g in self.queue:
            if g.id == goal_id:
                g.priority *= 0.5  # Halve priority on failure
                g.status = "queued"
                self._resort()
                return

    def get_queue_state(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "size": len(self.queue),
            "max_size": self.max_size,
            "fill_percent": round((len(self.queue) / self.max_size) * 100, 1),
            "top_priorities": [{"id": g.id, "priority": g.priority, "desc": g.description[:60]}
                               for g in self.queue[:5]],
        }

    def _resort(self):
        """Sort queue by priority descending, then by creation time."""
        self.queue.sort(key=lambda g: (-g.priority, g.created_at))
```
