.markdown-body h4 { font-size: 1em; margin: 1.1em 0 0.2em; font-weight: 600; }
.markdown-body h5, .markdown-body h6 { font-size: 0.85em; margin: 1em 0 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

.markdown-body p { margin: 0 0 1em; }
.markdown-body a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
.markdown-body a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.markdown-body strong { font-weight: 600; }
.markdown-body em { font-style: italic; }
.markdown-body ul, .markdown-body ol { margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 1.6em; }
.markdown-body li { margin: 0.25em 0; }
.markdown-body li > ul, .markdown-body li > ol { margin: 0.25em 0; }

.markdown-body code {
  font-family: "SF Mono", "Fira Code", "Cascadia Code", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  background: var(--code-bg);
  color: var(--code-text);
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.markdown-body pre {
  margin: 0 0 1em;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  background: var(--code-bg);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}

.markdown-body pre code { background: none; padding: 0; border-radius: 0; font-size: inherit; }

.markdown-body blockquote {
  margin: 0 0 1em;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--quote-border);
  background: var(--quote-bg);
  border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
  color: var(--text-soft);
}

.markdown-body blockquote p:last-child { margin: 0; }
.markdown-body hr { border: none; height: 1px; background: var(--hr-color); margin: 1.5em 0; }

.markdown-body table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 0 0 1em; font-size: 13.5px; }
.markdown-body th, .markdown-body td { border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; }
.markdown-body th { background: var(--sidebar-bg); font-weight: 600; }
.markdown-body tr:nth-child(even) { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.015); }
[data-theme="dark"] .markdown-body tr:nth-child(even) { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.015); }
.markdown-body img { max-width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; }

/* Heading anchors */
.markdown-body h1 .anchor, .markdown-body h2 .anchor, .markdown-body h3 .anchor,
.markdown-body h4 .anchor, .markdown-body h5 .anchor, .markdown-body h6 .anchor {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: -1em;
  padding-right: 0.3em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.1s;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: 400;
  width: 1em;
}

.markdown-body h1:hover .anchor, .markdown-body h2:hover .anchor, .markdown-body h3:hover .anchor,
.markdown-body h4:hover .anchor, .markdown-body h5:hover .anchor, .markdown-body h6:hover .anchor { opacity: 1; }

.keyhint {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 16px;
  right: 16px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: var(--sidebar-bg);
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  opacity: 0.6;
  z-index: 5;
}

/* ── Responsive ── */
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  #sidebar-toggle { display: none; }
  #hamburger { display: flex; }

  #sidebar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 270px;
    min-width: 270px;
    transform: translateX(-105%);
    z-index: 15;
    box-shadow: 4px 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, background 0.2s;
  }

  #sidebar.open { transform: translateX(0); }
  #sidebar.collapsed { width: 270px; min-width: 270px; overflow-y: auto; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }

  #sidebar-overlay {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: var(--overlay-bg);
    z-index: 14;
  }

  #sidebar-overlay.visible { display: block; }
  .markdown-body { padding: 24px 20px 80px; }
  .welcome { padding: 60px 20px; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .markdown-body { padding: 16px 14px 60px; font-size: 14px; }
  .markdown-body h1 { font-size: 1.5em; }
  .markdown-body h2 { font-size: 1.2em; }
  .markdown-body pre { font-size: 12.5px; padding: 10px 12px; }
}

@media print {
  #sidebar, #hamburger, .keyhint, #sidebar-overlay, #sidebar-toggle { display: none !important; }
  body { display: block; }
  #content { overflow: visible; }
  .markdown-body { max-width: none; padding: 0; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<button id="hamburger" aria-label="Toggle sidebar">&#9776;</button>
<div id="sidebar-overlay"></div>

<button id="sidebar-toggle" aria-label="Toggle sidebar" title="Collapse sidebar (Ctrl+B)"><span class="chevron">&#9664;</span></button>

<div id="sidebar">
  <div class="sidebar-header">
    <a href="#" id="sidebar-header-title" class="sidebar-header-title">
      <h1>md</h1>
      <span class="subtitle">documents</span>
    </a>
    <div class="toggle-wrap">
      <span class="toggle-label" id="theme-label">&#9681;</span>
      <div class="toggle-switch" id="theme-toggle" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Toggle dark mode"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="search-wrap">
    <input id="search-input" type="text" placeholder="Search documents&hellip;" spellcheck="false">
  </div>
  <div id="search-results"></div>

  <div class="sidebar-section" id="files-section-label">Documents</div>
  <div id="file-list"></div>
</div>

<div id="content">
  <div class="markdown-body">
    <div class="welcome">
      <h1>md</h1>
      <p>Select a document from the sidebar to view it here.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="keyhint">Ctrl+K search &middot; Ctrl+B sidebar &middot; T theme &middot; python3 server.py</div>

<script>
(function(){
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Markdown Parser
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function slugify(text) {
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '') || 'section';
}

function parseMarkdown(md) {
  var headings = [];
  var frontmatter = null;
  var lines = md.split('\n');
  var html = '';
  var i = 0;

  // Parse YAML frontmatter
  if (lines.length > 0 && lines[0].trim() === '---') {
    var fmEnd = -1;
    for (var j = 1; j < lines.length; j++) {
      if (lines[j].trim() === '---') { fmEnd = j; break; }
    }
    if (fmEnd > 0) {
      frontmatter = {};
      for (var j = 1; j < fmEnd; j++) {
        var fmLine = lines[j];
        var colonIdx = fmLine.indexOf(':');
        if (colonIdx > 0) {
          var key = fmLine.slice(0, colonIdx).trim();
          var val = fmLine.slice(colonIdx + 1).trim();
          if ((val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) || (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))) {
            val = val.slice(1, -1);
          }
          frontmatter[key] = val;
        }
      }
      lines.splice(0, fmEnd + 1);
    }
  }

  while (i < lines.length) {
    var line = lines[i];
    var trimmed = line.trim();

    if (trimmed.startsWith('```')) {
      var lang = trimmed.slice(3).trim();
      var codeLines = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].trim().startsWith('```')) {
        codeLines.push(lines[i]);
        i++;
      }
      i++;
      var code = escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n'));
      html += '<pre' + (lang ? ' data-lang="' + escapeHtml(lang) + '"' : '') + '><code>' + code + '</code></pre>\n';
      continue;
    }

    var hMatch = trimmed.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)(?:\s+\{#([^}]+)\})?\s*$/);
    if (hMatch) {
      var level = hMatch[1].length;
      var text = hMatch[2];
      var explicitSlug = hMatch[3];
      var slug = explicitSlug || slugify(text);
      var plainText = text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/\*\*|__/g, '').replace(/\*|_/g, '');
      headings.push({ level: level, text: plainText, slug: slug });
      html += '<h' + level + ' id="' + slug + '">' +
        '<a class="anchor" href="#' + slug + '" aria-hidden="true">#</a>' + text +
        '</h' + level + '>\n';
      i++;
      continue;
    }

    if (/^[-*_]{3,}\s*$/.test(trimmed) && trimmed.length >= 3) {
      html += '<hr>\n'; i++; continue;
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('> ')) {
      var quoteLines = [];
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith('> ')) {
        quoteLines.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2));
        i++;
      }
      html += '<blockquote><p>' + renderInline(quoteLines.join('\n')) + '</p></blockquote>\n';
      continue;
    }

    if (trimmed.includes('|') && i + 1 < lines.length && /^\|[-:| ]+\|$/.test(lines[i+1].trim())) {
      var tableHtml = '<table>\n';
      var headerCells = trimmed.split('|').slice(1, -1).map(function(c) { return '<th>' + renderInline(c.trim()) + '</th>'; });
      tableHtml += '<tr>' + headerCells.join('') + '</tr>\n';
      i += 2;
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith('|')) {
        var cells = lines[i].trim().split('|').slice(1, -1).map(function(c) { return '<td>' + renderInline(c.trim()) + '</td>'; });
        tableHtml += '<tr>' + cells.join('') + '</tr>\n';
        i++;
      }
      tableHtml += '</table>\n';
      html += tableHtml;
      continue;
    }

    if (/^[-*+]\s/.test(trimmed)) {
      var listLines = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^[-*+]\s/.test(lines[i].trim())) {
        listLines.push('<li>' + renderInline(lines[i].trim().replace(/^[-*+]\s+/, '')) + '</li>');
        i++;
      }
      html += '<ul>' + listLines.join('') + '</ul>\n';
      continue;
    }

    if (/^\d+\.\s/.test(trimmed)) {
      var oLines = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\d+\.\s/.test(lines[i].trim())) {
        oLines.push('<li>' + renderInline(lines[i].trim().replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, '')) + '</li>');
        i++;
      }
      html += '<ol>' + oLines.join('') + '</ol>\n';
      continue;
    }

    if (trimmed === '') { i++; continue; }

    var paraLines = [];
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() !== '') {
      paraLines.push(lines[i]);
      i++;
    }
    html += '<p>' + renderInline(paraLines.join('\n')) + '</p>\n';
  }

  // Build frontmatter header strip
  if (frontmatter) {
    var fmHtml = '<div class="fm-header">';
    if (frontmatter.type)
      fmHtml += '<span class="fm-badge">' + escapeHtml(frontmatter.type) + '</span>';
    if (frontmatter.title)
      fmHtml += '<span class="fm-title">' + escapeHtml(frontmatter.title) + '</span>';
    if (frontmatter.status)
      fmHtml += '<span class="fm-status ' + escapeHtml(frontmatter.status) + '">' + escapeHtml(frontmatter.status) + '</span>';
    if (frontmatter.tags) {
      var tagsStr = frontmatter.tags;
      var tags = tagsStr.replace(/^\[|\]$/g, '').split(',').map(function(t) { return t.trim(); }).filter(function(t) { return t; });
      if (tags.length > 0) {
        fmHtml += '<div class="fm-tags">';
        for (var t = 0; t < tags.length; t++) fmHtml += '<span>' + escapeHtml(tags[t]) + '</span>';
        fmHtml += '</div>';
      }
    }
    if (frontmatter.created)
      fmHtml += '<span class="fm-created">' + escapeHtml(frontmatter.created) + '</span>';
    fmHtml += '</div>';
    html = fmHtml + '\n' + html;
  }

  return { html: html, headings: headings, frontmatter: frontmatter };
}

function renderInline(text) {
  var s = escapeHtml(text);
  s = s.replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<img src="$2" alt="$1">');
  s = s.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2">$1</a>');
  // Obsidian [[wikilinks]] - pipe variant first, then simple
  s = s.replace(/\[\[([^\]|]+)\|([^\]]+)\]\]/g, '<a href="$1.md">$2</a>');
  s = s.replace(/\[\[([^\]]+)\]\]/g, '<a href="$1.md">$1</a>');
  s = s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
  s = s.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  s = s.replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  s = s.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
  s = s.replace(/(?<!_)_([^_]+)_(?!_)/g, '<em>$1</em>');
  s = s.replace(/~~([^~]+)~~/g, '<del>$1</del>');
  s = s.replace(/  $/gm, '<br>');
  return s;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   State & DOM refs
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var state = {
  files: [],
  currentFile: '',
  fileContents: {},
  searchIndex: {},
  fileHeadings: {},
  accordionExpanded: {},
  dirCollapsed: {},
};

var content = document.getElementById('content');
var sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
var fileList = document.getElementById('file-list');
var searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
var searchResults = document.getElementById('search-results');
var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
var overlay = document.getElementById('sidebar-overlay');
var themeToggle = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
var themeLabel = document.getElementById('theme-label');
var sidebarToggle = document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle');
var sidebarHeaderTitle = document.getElementById('sidebar-header-title');

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Theme
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var currentTheme = localStorage.getItem('md-theme') || 'light';
document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme);
updateThemeLabel();

function toggleTheme() {
  currentTheme = (currentTheme === 'light') ? 'dark' : 'light';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme);
  localStorage.setItem('md-theme', currentTheme);
  updateThemeLabel();
}

function updateThemeLabel() {
  themeLabel.textContent = currentTheme === 'light' ? '\u2600' : '\u263E';
}

themeToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);
themeToggle.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleTheme(); }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   File Loading
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function loadFileList() {
  // Three-layer auto-discovery: 1) server.py endpoint, 2) static index.json, 3) parallel probe
  function probeFiles() {
    var candidates = [];
    // Numbered files: 00-*.md through 99-*.md, plus 000-*.md
    for (var i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
      var n = i.toString().padStart(i < 10 ? 1 : 2, '0');
      if (i >= 10) candidates.push(n + '-*.md');
      if (i === 0) candidates.push('00' + (i+1) + '-*.md');
    }
    // Use '*' as a wildcard sentinel — we'll probe exact names
    var probes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
      probes.push(String(i).padStart(2, '0'));
    }
    probes.push('000');
    // Known extra filenames to try
    var extras = ['README', 'quick-reference', 'presentation-outline', 'comparison-frameworks',
                  'terminology_inventory', 'canonical_vocabulary', 'deprecated_terms',
                  'notation_reference', 'rewrite_map', 'manuscript_terminology_update',
                  'index', 'glossary', 'abstract', 'introduction-map'];
    
    var allNames = [];
    probes.forEach(function(p) { allNames.push(p + '-*.md'); });
    extras.forEach(function(e) { allNames.push(e + '.md'); });
    // Also try numbered from probes directly
    probes.forEach(function(p) { allNames.push(p + '.md'); });
    
    // Deduplicate and remove invalid
    var seen = {};
    var unique = [];
    allNames.forEach(function(n) {
      n = n.replace('*', '');
      if (!seen[n]) { seen[n] = true; unique.push(n); }
    });
    
    // Probe all in parallel
    var found = [];
    var remaining = unique.length;
    unique.forEach(function(name) {
      fetch(getBaseUrl() + '/' + encodeURIComponent(name))
        .then(function(r) {
          if (r.ok && name.endsWith('.md')) found.push(name);
        })
        .catch(function() {})
        .then(function() {
          remaining--;
          if (remaining === 0) {
            found.sort();
            state.files = found;
            renderSidebar();
            resolveRoute();
          }
        });
    });
  }

  // Try /files.json first (from server.py or similar)
  fetch('/files.json')
    .then(function(r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
    .then(function(files) {
      state.files = files;
      renderSidebar();
      resolveRoute();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      // Fallback to static index.json
      fetch('index.json')
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(files) {
          state.files = files;
          renderSidebar();
          resolveRoute();
        })
        .catch(function() {
          // Pure HTML fallback: parallel probe
          probeFiles();
        });
    });
}

function getBaseUrl() { return '.'; }

function prefetchFile(filename) {
  if (state.fileContents[filename]) return;
  fetch(getBaseUrl() + '/' + encodeURIComponent(filename))
    .then(function(r) { return r.text(); })
    .then(function(md) {
      state.fileContents[filename] = md;
      buildSearchIndex(filename, md);
      var result = parseMarkdown(md);
      state.fileHeadings[filename] = result.headings;
    })
    .catch(function() {});
}

function buildSearchIndex(filename, md) {
  var lines = md.split('\n');
  var index = [];
  lines.forEach(function(line, i) {
    var trimmed = line.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > 10) {
      index.push({ line: i + 1, text: trimmed });
    }
  });
  state.searchIndex[filename] = index;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Search
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var searchTimeout = null;

searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
  clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
  searchTimeout = setTimeout(performSearch, 150);
});

searchInput.addEventListener('focus', function() {
  if (searchInput.value) performSearch();
});

function performSearch() {
  var query = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!query || query.length < 2) {
    searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
    return;
  }

  var results = [];
  Object.keys(state.searchIndex).forEach(function(fname) {
    var entries = state.searchIndex[fname];
    var fileResults = [];
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      var lower = entry.text.toLowerCase();
      var idx = lower.indexOf(query);
      if (idx !== -1) {
        fileResults.push({ line: entry.line, text: entry.text, matchIdx: idx });
      }
    });
    if (fileResults.length > 0) {
      results.push({ file: fname, matches: fileResults.slice(0, 3) });
    }
  });

  results.sort(function(a, b) { return a.file.localeCompare(b.file); });
  results = results.slice(0, 15);

  if (results.length === 0) {
    searchResults.innerHTML = '<div class="search-result" style="color:var(--text-muted);cursor:default">No results</div>';
    searchResults.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }

  var html = '';
  results.forEach(function(r) {
    html += '<div class="search-result" data-file="' + escapeHtml(r.file) + '">';
    html += '<span class="file-label">' + escapeHtml(r.file) + '</span>: ';
    r.matches.forEach(function(m, i) {
      if (i > 0) html += ' &middot; ';
      var before = escapeHtml(m.text.slice(Math.max(0, m.matchIdx - 20), m.matchIdx));
      var match = escapeHtml(m.text.slice(m.matchIdx, m.matchIdx + query.length));
      var after = escapeHtml(m.text.slice(m.matchIdx + query.length, m.matchIdx + query.length + 40));
      html += before + '<span class="match">' + match + '</span>' + after;
    });
    html += '</div>';
  });

  searchResults.innerHTML = html;
  searchResults.classList.add('visible');

  searchResults.querySelectorAll('.search-result').forEach(function(el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var fname = el.getAttribute('data-file');
      searchInput.blur();
      searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
      navigateTo(fname);
    });
  });
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Sidebar rendering (accordion)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function renderSidebar() {
  fileList.innerHTML = '';

  // Home entry
  var home = document.createElement('a');
  home.className = 'file-entry home-entry';
  home.innerHTML = '<span class="icon">\u2302</span> All Documents';
  home.href = '#';
  home.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    closeSidebar();
    navigateHome();
  });
  if (!state.currentFile) home.classList.add('active');
  fileList.appendChild(home);

  // Group files by directory
  var groups = {};
  state.files.forEach(function(f) {
    if (f === 'complete.md') return;
    var dir = '';
    var name = f;
    var slash = f.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (slash !== -1) {
      dir = f.slice(0, slash);
      name = f.slice(slash + 1);
    }
    if (!groups[dir]) groups[dir] = [];
    groups[dir].push({ full: f, name: name });
  });

  // Sort directory keys: root first, then alphabetical
  var dirs = Object.keys(groups).sort(function(a, b) {
    if (a === '') return -1;
    if (b === '') return 1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  // Update section label
  var sectionLabel = document.getElementById('files-section-label');
  if (sectionLabel) {
    var count = state.files.length;
    sectionLabel.textContent = dirs.length > 1
      ? 'Documents (' + count + ' in ' + dirs.length + ' dirs)'
      : 'Documents (' + count + ')';
  }

  dirs.forEach(function(dir) {
    var entries = groups[dir];

    // Directory section header (skip for root)
    if (dir !== '') {
      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sidebar-section';
      
      var arrow = document.createElement('span');
      arrow.className = 'dir-arrow' + (state.dirCollapsed[dir] ? ' collapsed' : '');
      arrow.textContent = '\u25BC';
      header.appendChild(arrow);
      
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = dir;
      header.appendChild(label);
      
      var count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'dir-count';
      count.textContent = entries.length;
      header.appendChild(count);
      
      (function(d) {
        header.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          state.dirCollapsed[d] = !state.dirCollapsed[d];
          renderSidebar();
        });
      })(dir);
      
      fileList.appendChild(header);
    }

    // Container for entries (collapsible)
    var entriesContainer = document.createElement('div');
    entriesContainer.className = 'dir-entries' + (dir !== '' && state.dirCollapsed[dir] ? ' collapsed' : '');
    fileList.appendChild(entriesContainer);

    // File entries for this directory
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      var wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'file-entry-wrap';

      var main = document.createElement('a');
      main.className = 'file-entry-main';
      if (state.currentFile === entry.full) main.classList.add('active');

      var icon = entry.name.match(/^\d+/);
      var iconChar = icon ? String.fromCharCode(9312 + parseInt(icon[0])) : '\u2022';

      // Arrow
      var arrow = document.createElement('span');
      arrow.className = 'file-arrow';
      arrow.textContent = '\u25B6';
      if (state.accordionExpanded[entry.full]) arrow.classList.add('expanded');

      (function(filename) {
        arrow.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.preventDefault();
          var h = state.fileHeadings[filename] || [];
          var dh = h.filter(function(x) { return x.level <= 4; });
          if (dh.length === 0) return;
          state.accordionExpanded[filename] = !state.accordionExpanded[filename];
          renderSidebar();
        });
      })(entry.full);

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.innerHTML = '<span class="icon">' + iconChar + '</span>' + escapeHtml(entry.name);

      main.appendChild(arrow);
      main.appendChild(label);
      main.href = '#' + encodeURIComponent(entry.full);

      (function(filename) {
        main.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeSidebar();
          navigateTo(filename);
        });
      })(entry.full);

      wrap.appendChild(main);

      // Headings sub-list
      var hList = state.fileHeadings[entry.full] || [];
      var dhList = hList.filter(function(x) { return x.level <= 4; });

      if (state.accordionExpanded[entry.full] && dhList.length > 0) {
        var sub = document.createElement('div');
        sub.className = 'file-headings';
        dhList.forEach(function(h) {
          var hEl = document.createElement('a');
          hEl.className = 'file-heading level-' + h.level;
          hEl.textContent = h.text;
          hEl.href = '#' + encodeURIComponent(entry.full) + '#' + h.slug;
          (function(slug) {
            hEl.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              closeSidebar();
              navigateTo(entry.full, slug);
            });
          })(h.slug);
          sub.appendChild(hEl);
        });
        wrap.appendChild(sub);
      }

      entriesContainer.appendChild(wrap);
    });
  });
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Navigation
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function navigateTo(filename, anchor) {
  if (!filename) return;

  // If already viewing this file with an anchor, just scroll
  if (filename === state.currentFile && anchor) {
    history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + encodeURIComponent(filename) + '#' + anchor);
    var el = document.getElementById(anchor);
    if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    return;
  }

  state.currentFile = filename;
  history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + encodeURIComponent(filename) + (anchor ? '#' + anchor : ''));
  renderSidebar();

  function afterRender() {
    if (anchor) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        var el = document.getElementById(anchor);
        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }, 100);
    }
  }

  if (state.fileContents[filename]) {
    renderContent(filename, state.fileContents[filename]);
    afterRender();
    return;
  }

  content.innerHTML = '<div class="markdown-body"><div class="loading">Loading&hellip;</div></div>';

  fetch(getBaseUrl() + '/' + encodeURIComponent(filename))
    .then(function(r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Not found');
      return r.text();
    })
    .then(function(md) {
      state.fileContents[filename] = md;
      buildSearchIndex(filename, md);
      renderContent(filename, md);
      afterRender();
    })
    .catch(function() {
      content.innerHTML = '<div class="markdown-body"><div class="welcome"><h1>Error</h1><p>Could not load <strong>' + escapeHtml(filename) + '</strong>.</p></div></div>';
    });
}

function renderContent(filename, md) {
  var result = parseMarkdown(md);
  content.innerHTML = '<div class="markdown-body">' + result.html + '</div>';
  state.fileHeadings[filename] = result.headings;
  renderSidebar();
  document.title = filename.replace(/\.md$/i, '') + ' — md';
  document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
  closeSidebar();
}

function resolveRoute() {
  var hash = window.location.hash.slice(1);
  if (!hash) {
    if (state.files.length > 0 && !state.currentFile) { navigateTo(state.files[0]); }
    return;
  }
  var parts = hash.split('#');
  var file = decodeURIComponent(parts[0]);
  var anchor = parts.slice(1).join('#');

  // If the hash is a known file, navigate to it
  if (state.files.indexOf(file) !== -1) {
    navigateTo(file, anchor || null);
    return;
  }

  // If viewing a file and hash is a heading ID in it, just scroll
  if (state.currentFile) {
    var el = document.getElementById(hash);
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      return;
    }
  }

  // Unknown hash with no current file: navigate to first file
  if (state.files.length > 0 && !state.currentFile) {
    navigateTo(state.files[0]);
  }
}

window.addEventListener('hashchange', function() {
  resolveRoute();
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Sidebar collapse (desktop)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

var sidebarCollapsed = localStorage.getItem('md-sidebar-collapsed') === 'true';

function applySidebarState() {
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) return;
  sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed', sidebarCollapsed);
  sidebarToggle.setAttribute('title', (sidebarCollapsed ? 'Expand' : 'Collapse') + ' sidebar (Ctrl+B)');
}

function toggleSidebar() {
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) return;
  sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
  localStorage.setItem('md-sidebar-collapsed', sidebarCollapsed);
  applySidebarState();
}

sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);

window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
  if (window.innerWidth < 820) {
    sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
  } else {
    applySidebarState();
  }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Home
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function navigateHome() {
  state.currentFile = '';
  history.replaceState(null, '', '#');
  renderSidebar();
  document.title = 'md — documents';
  content.innerHTML = '' +
    '<div class="markdown-body">' +
    '<div class="welcome">' +
    '<h1>md</h1>' +
    '<p>Select a document from the sidebar to view it here.</p>' +
    '</div>' +
    '</div>';
}

sidebarHeaderTitle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  closeSidebar();
  navigateHome();
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Mobile sidebar
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

function openSidebar() { sidebar.classList.add('open'); overlay.classList.add('visible'); }
function closeSidebar() { sidebar.classList.remove('open'); overlay.classList.remove('visible'); }

hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
  if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) { closeSidebar(); }
  else { openSidebar(); }
});

overlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);

var touchStartX = 0;
document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; });
document.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
  if (sidebar.classList.contains('open') && e.changedTouches[0].screenX - touchStartX < -50) { closeSidebar(); }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Keyboard shortcuts
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'k') {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.focus();
    return;
  }
  if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'b') {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleSidebar();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    if (document.activeElement === searchInput) {
      searchInput.blur();
      searchResults.classList.remove('visible');
    }
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === 't' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
    var tag = document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName : '';
    if (tag !== 'INPUT' && tag !== 'TEXTAREA' && tag !== 'SELECT') {
      toggleTheme();
    }
  }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Internal heading link handling
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

// Intercept heading anchor clicks and .md links for internal navigation
content.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  var target = e.target;
  if (target.tagName === 'A' && target.getAttribute('href')) {
    var href = target.getAttribute('href');

    // Internal .md link -> navigate within viewer
    if (href.match(/\.md$/i)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      navigateTo(href);
      return;
    }

    // Heading anchor -> smooth scroll
    if (href.charAt(0) === '#') {
      var id = href.slice(1);
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && state.currentFile) {
        e.preventDefault();
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + encodeURIComponent(state.currentFile) + '#' + id);
      }
    }
  }
});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Init
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

loadFileList();
applySidebarState();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```python
"""Recursive markdown documentation server.

Usage:  python3 server.py [port]
        python3 server.py 8080

Serves .md files from all subdirectories with auto-discovery,
syntax highlighting, dark mode, and search.
"""

import os, sys, json, http.server, socketserver, glob, urllib.parse, re
import subprocess
import math

PORT = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8765
DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# Load search index at startup
SEARCH_INDEX = None
SEARCH_DIR = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon')
SEARCH_PATH = os.path.join(SEARCH_DIR, 'search_index.json')
if os.path.exists(SEARCH_PATH):
    try:
        import math
        with open(SEARCH_PATH) as f:
            SEARCH_INDEX = json.load(f)
        print(f"   Search index: {len(SEARCH_INDEX['paths'])} docs")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"   Search index: failed to load ({e})")

def search_query(q, limit=20):
    if not SEARCH_INDEX or not q.strip():
        return []
    q = q.lower().strip()
    query_words = set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', q))
    if not query_words:
        return []
    
    # Score each document by TF-IDF cosine similarity
    scores = []
    for i, doc in enumerate(SEARCH_INDEX['docs']):
        doc_words = doc.split()
        score = 0
        for w in query_words:
            if w in SEARCH_INDEX['idf']:
                tf = doc_words.count(w) / max(len(doc_words), 1)
                score += tf * SEARCH_INDEX['idf'][w]
        if score > 0:
            scores.append((score, i))
    
    scores.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
    results = []
    for score, i in scores[:limit]:
        # Get relative path
        full = SEARCH_INDEX['paths'][i]
        rel = os.path.relpath(full, DIR)
        # Get title from frontmatter
        with open(full) as f:
            first = f.read(300)
        m = re.search(r'title:\s*"?([^"\n]+)"?', first)
        title = m.group(1) if m else os.path.basename(full).replace('.md', '')
        results.append({
            'path': rel,
            'title': title,
            'score': round(score, 3)
        })
    return results


def get_system_stats():
    """Gather system statistics about the wiki bundle."""
    import re
    from collections import Counter
    
    stats = {
        'files': {'total': 0, 'entities': 0, 'sessions': 0, 'domains': 0},
        'sizes': {'total_bytes': 0, 'smallest': None, 'largest': None},
        'graph': {'nodes': 0, 'edges': 0},
        'domains': {},
        'tags': {},
    }
    
    entity_count = 0
    domain_counts = Counter()
    tag_counts = Counter()
    
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DIR):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith('.md'):
                continue
            fpath = os.path.join(root, fn)
            sz = os.path.getsize(fpath)
            stats['files']['total'] += 1
            stats['sizes']['total_bytes'] += sz
            
            if 'supercategories' in root:
                entity_count += 1
                if fn not in ('index.md', 'overview.md'):
                    parts = root.split(os.sep)
                    if 'domains' in parts:
                        didx = parts.index('domains')
                        if didx + 1 < len(parts):
                            domain_counts[parts[didx + 1]] += 1
                    # Read tags
                    try:
                        with open(fpath) as fh:
                            first = fh.read(300)
                        tm = re.search(r'tags:\s*\[(.*?)\]', first)
                        if tm:
                            tags = [t.strip().strip("\"'") for t in tm.group(1).split(',') if t.strip()]
                            for t in tags:
                                if t not in ('entity', 'ast', 'acronym'):
                                    tag_counts[t] += 1
                    except:
                        pass
            
            if stats['sizes']['smallest'] is None or sz < stats['sizes']['smallest']['size']:
                rel = os.path.relpath(fpath, DIR)
                stats['sizes']['smallest'] = {'path': rel, 'size': sz}
            if stats['sizes']['largest'] is None or sz > stats['sizes']['largest']['size']:
                rel = os.path.relpath(fpath, DIR)
                stats['sizes']['largest'] = {'path': rel, 'size': sz}
    
    # Session count
    session_dir = os.path.join(DIR, 'wiki', 'sessions')
    if os.path.isdir(session_dir):
        stats['files']['sessions'] = len([f for f in os.listdir(session_dir) if f.endswith('.md')])
    
    stats['files']['entities'] = entity_count
    stats['domains'] = dict(domain_counts.most_common())
    stats['tags'] = dict(tag_counts.most_common(20))
    
    # Graph stats
    graph_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
    if os.path.exists(graph_path):
        try:
            with open(graph_path) as f:
                g = json.load(f)
            stats['graph']['nodes'] = len(g.get('nodes', []))
            stats['graph']['edges'] = len(g.get('edges', []))
        except:
            pass
    
    stats['sizes']['total_mb'] = round(stats['sizes']['total_bytes'] / 1024 / 1024, 1)
    stats['sizes']['smallest']['size_kb'] = round(stats['sizes']['smallest']['size'] / 1024, 2)
    stats['sizes']['largest']['size_kb'] = round(stats['sizes']['largest']['size'] / 1024, 2)
    
    return stats

class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_json(self, data):
        """Send JSON response with CORS headers."""
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode())

    def do_GET(self):
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
        
        if parsed.path == '/graph.json':
            graph_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
            if os.path.exists(graph_path):
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
                self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
                self.end_headers()
                with open(graph_path) as f:
                    self.wfile.write(f.read().encode())
            else:
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b'{"nodes":[],"edges":[]}')
            return
        
        if parsed.path == '/search':
            q = params.get('q', [''])[0]
            results = search_query(q)
            self.send_json(results)
            return
        
        if parsed.path == '/api/stats':
            stats = get_system_stats()
            self.send_json(stats)
            return
        

        # ── Hybrid Search API ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/search/hybrid':
            q = params.get('q', [''])[0]
            if not q:
                self.send_json({'query': '', 'results': [], 'total': 0})
                return
            try:
                import importlib.util
                sf_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'search_fusion.py')
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sf_module', sf_path)
                sf = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(sf)
                index = sf.load_index()
                if not index:
                    self.send_json({'error': 'Search index not built. Run: python3 .wiki-daemon/search_fusion.py build-index'})
                    return
                results = sf.search_query(index, q)
                self.send_json({'query': q, 'results': results, 'total': len(results)})
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Graph Topology API ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/graph/topology':
            try:
                graph_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
                root_id = params.get('root', [None])[0]
                depth = int(params.get('depth', ['2'])[0])
                with open(graph_path) as f:
                    g = json.load(f)
                if root_id:
                    # Build adjacency list
                    adj = {}
                    for e in g.get('edges', []):
                        adj.setdefault(e['source'], set()).add(e['target'])
                        adj.setdefault(e['target'], set()).add(e['source'])
                    # BFS from root
                    visited = set([root_id])
                    queue = [(root_id, 0)]
                    while queue:
                        node, d = queue.pop(0)
                        if d >= depth: continue
                        for neighbor in adj.get(node, set()):
                            if neighbor not in visited:
                                visited.add(neighbor)
                                queue.append((neighbor, d + 1))
                    # Filter nodes and edges
                    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in g.get('nodes', [])}
                    filtered_nodes = [node_map[nid] for nid in visited if nid in node_map]
                    filtered_edges = [e for e in g.get('edges', []) 
                                      if e['source'] in visited and e['target'] in visited]
                    self.send_json({
                        'nodes': filtered_nodes,
                        'edges': filtered_edges,
                        'root': root_id,
                        'depth': depth,
                        'total_nodes': len(g.get('nodes', [])),
                        'total_edges': len(g.get('edges', []))
                    })
                else:
                    self.send_json(g)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Linter Health API ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/health/lint':
            try:
                import importlib.util
                kl_path = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'kb_linter.py')
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('kl_module', kl_path)
                kl = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(kl)
                report = kl.lint(return_json=True)
                self.send_json(report)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Temporal History: file change log ──
        if parsed.path.startswith('/api/v2/history/log/'):
            filepath = parsed.path.replace('/api/v2/history/log/', '', 1)
            try:
                eng = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'temporal_engine.py')
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, eng, 'history', filepath],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
                data = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout else []
                self.send_json(data)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Temporal History: time-travel snapshot ──
        if parsed.path.startswith('/api/v2/history/snapshot'):
            filepath = params.get('path', [''])[0]
            timestamp = params.get('ts', [''])[0]
            if not filepath or not timestamp:
                self.send_json({'error': 'Required: path=<filepath>&ts=<timestamp>'})
                return
            try:
                eng = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'temporal_engine.py')
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, eng, 'snapshot', filepath, timestamp],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
                data = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout else {'error': 'No data'}
                self.send_json(data)
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── Build search index ──
        if parsed.path == '/api/v2/search/build':
            try:
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'search_fusion.py'), 'build-index'],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
                self.send_json({'status': 'ok' if result.returncode == 0 else 'error', 'output': result.stdout})
            except Exception as e:
                self.send_json({'error': str(e)})
            return
        
        # ── List all .md files ──
        if self.path == '/files.json':
            # Recursively find all .md files, return relative paths
            md_files = []
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DIR):
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.') and d != '__pycache__']
                for f in sorted(files):
                    if f.endswith('.md'):
                        full = os.path.join(root, f)
                        rel = os.path.relpath(full, DIR)
                        md_files.append(rel)
            self.send_json(md_files)
            return
        
        # Fall through to default file server for everything else
        return super().do_GET()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        print(f"  {args[0]} {args[1]} {args[2]}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Check daemon buffer directory health
    buffer_dir = os.path.join(DIR, '.wiki-daemon', 'buffers')
    if not os.path.isdir(buffer_dir):
        print(f"   ⚠ Buffer dir missing: {buffer_dir}")
        print(f"     Run: mkdir -p {buffer_dir}")
    else:
        buffer_count = len(os.listdir(buffer_dir))
        print(f"   Daemon buffers: {buffer_dir} ({buffer_count} files)")
        signals_dir = os.path.join(buffer_dir, 'signals')
        if os.path.isdir(signals_dir):
            sig_count = len(os.listdir(signals_dir))
            print(f"   Pending signals: {sig_count}")
    
    # Count .md files
    count = sum(1 for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DIR) 
                for f in files if f.endswith('.md')
                if not any(d.startswith('.') for d in root.split(os.sep)))
    print(f"📄 md — Self-Contained Documentation Viewer")
    print(f"   Serving: {DIR}")
    print(f"   .md files: {count}")
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
PORT=${1:-8825}
PID_FILE="$DIR/.wiki-daemon/server.pid"

# Check if running
if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  OLD_PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")
  if kill -0 "$OLD_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "✅ Server already running (PID $OLD_PID) on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "⚠️  Stale PID found — removing"
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
fi

# Start server
cd "$DIR"
nohup python3 server.py "$PORT" > .wiki-daemon/server.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$PID_FILE"
sleep 1

NEW_PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")
if kill -0 "$NEW_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "🚀 Server started (PID $NEW_PID) on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
  echo "   Log: tail -f .wiki-daemon/server.log"
else
  echo "❌ Server failed to start"
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  exit 1
fi

# Open browser if available
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Backlink index for mykb — finds what references each entity.
"""
import os, re, json

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki')
BL_PATH = os.path.join(BUNDLE, '.wiki-daemon', 'backlinks.json')

def build_backlink_index():
    """Build backlink index: entity_id → list of (referencer_id, referencer_title, referencer_type)."""
    backlinks = {}
    
    # Scan all wiki files
    all_files = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(WIKI):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
            path = os.path.join(root, fn)
            rel = os.path.relpath(path, WIKI).replace('.md', '')
            all_files.append((rel, path))
    
    # Build a map of entity titles to their IDs
    title_to_id = {}
    for fn in os.listdir(os.path.join(WIKI, 'entities')):
        if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
        try:
            text = open(os.path.join(WIKI, 'entities', fn), encoding='utf-8').read()
            m = re.search(r'^title:\s*"([^"]+)"', text, re.MULTILINE)
            if m:
                title = m.group(1).lower()
                slug = fn.replace('.md', '')
                title_to_id[title] = f"entities/{slug}"
        except: pass
    
    # For each entity, find files that mention its title
    print("Building backlink index...", flush=True)
    for rel_path, path in all_files:
        try:
            text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
            for title, eid in title_to_id.items():
                if title in text.lower():
                    # Extract the referencer's own title and type
                    m_type = re.search(r'^type:\s*"([^"]+)"', text, re.MULTILINE)
                    m_title = re.search(r'^title:\s*"([^"]+)"', text, re.MULTILINE)
                    ref_type = m_type.group(1) if m_type else 'concept'
                    ref_title = m_title.group(1) if m_title else rel_path
                    
                    if eid not in backlinks:
                        backlinks[eid] = []
                    backlinks[eid].append({
                        'id': rel_path,
                        'title': ref_title,
                        'type': ref_type,
                    })
        except: pass
    
    # Deduplicate
    for eid in backlinks:
        seen = set()
        unique = []
        for bl in backlinks[eid]:
            if bl['id'] not in seen:
                seen.add(bl['id'])
                unique.append(bl)
        backlinks[eid] = unique
    
    # Save
    with open(BL_PATH, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(backlinks, f)
    print(f"  Backlinks saved: {len(backlinks)} entities have backlinks", flush=True)
    return backlinks

def load_backlinks():
    if os.path.exists(BL_PATH):
        with open(BL_PATH) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    return {}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    bl = build_backlink_index()
    # Show some examples
    for eid in sorted(bl.keys(), key=lambda x: -len(bl[x]))[:5]:
        print(f"  {eid}: {len(bl[eid])} backlinks")
        for b in bl[eid][:3]:
            print(f"    <- {b['title']} ({b['type']})")
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Consolidate duplicate concepts via phrase-assembly clustering.

Strategy:
  1. Group all concept files by their normalized title (exact dedup)
  2. Merge exact duplicates: union tags, append bodies, cross-link sessions
  3. For remaining entities: build inverted index by word → compare pairs 
     that share a word (Jaccard + edit distance)
  4. Cluster similar titles (threshold > 0.55) and write cluster summaries
  5. Update wiki index with consolidated stats

Usage:
  python3 .wiki-daemon/consolidate.py [--dry-run] [--rebuild-links]
"""

import os, re, sys, json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, "wiki")
DRY_RUN = "--dry-run" in sys.argv

# ── IO ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def read_md(path):
    try:
        text = Path(path).read_text()
    except: return None
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not m: return None
    fm = {}
    for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
        if ':' not in line: continue
        k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k == 'tags':
            v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
        fm[k] = v
    return {
        'type': fm.get('type', 'concept'),
        'title': fm.get('title', ''),
        'description': fm.get('description', ''),
        'tags': fm.get('tags', []),
        'timestamp': fm.get('timestamp', ''),
        'resource': fm.get('resource', ''),
        'body': (m.group(2) or '').strip(),
        'path': str(path),
    }

def write_md(path, obj):
    tags_str = ', '.join(f'"{t}"' for t in obj.get('tags', []))
    Path(path).write_text(
        f'---\ntype: "{obj["type"]}"\ntitle: "{obj["title"]}"'
        f'\ndescription: "{obj.get("description", "")}"'
        f'\ntags: [{tags_str}]'
        f'\ntimestamp: "{obj.get("timestamp", "")}"'
        f'\nresource: "{obj.get("resource", "")}"'
        f'\n---\n\n{obj.get("body", "").strip()}\n'
    )

def slugify(t):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', t.lower()).strip('-')[:60]

# ── Scan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def scan():
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    type_dirs = {
        'session': 'sessions', 'entity': 'entities', 'decision': 'decisions',
        'tool': 'tools', 'topic': 'topics'
    }
    for ctype, dname in type_dirs.items():
        d = os.path.join(WIKI, dname)
        if not os.path.isdir(d): continue
        for fn in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
            if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
            obj = read_md(os.path.join(d, fn))
            if obj: obj['_fname'] = fn; groups[ctype].append(obj)
    return dict(groups)

# ── Normalization ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def norm(t):
    t = re.sub(r'\s*\(×\d+\)$', '', t)  # tool count suffix
    t = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t).strip()
    return t

def tokenize(t):
    return {w for w in re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', ' ', t.lower()).split() if len(w) > 1}

# ── Similarity ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def lev_sim(a, b):
    n, m = len(a), len(b)
    if n > m: a, b = b, a; n, m = m, n
    if m == 0: return 1.0
    prev = list(range(n + 1))
    for cb in b:
        cur = [prev[0] + 1]
        for j, ca in enumerate(a, 1):
            cur.append(min(cur[-1] + 1, prev[j] + 1, prev[j-1] + (0 if ca == cb else 1)))
        prev = cur
    return 1.0 - prev[n] / m

def combined_sim(a, b):
    at, bt = tokenize(a), tokenize(b)
    if not at or not bt: return 0.0
    jac = len(at & bt) / len(at | bt)
    lev = lev_sim(a.lower(), b.lower())
    if len(at) <= 2 and len(bt) <= 2: return lev
    return 0.6 * jac + 0.4 * lev

# ── Phase 1: Merge exact duplicates ────────────────────────────────

def merge_dupes(groups):
    stats = {'removed': 0}
    for ctype in ['entity', 'tool', 'topic']:
        items = groups.get(ctype, [])
        by_title = defaultdict(list)
        for item in items:
            by_title[norm(item['title']).lower()].append(item)
        
        for title, dupes in by_title.items():
            if len(dupes) <= 1: continue
            primary = dupes[0]
            all_tags = set()
            all_bodies = []
            all_resources = set()
            latest_ts = primary['timestamp']
            
            for d in dupes:
                all_tags.update(d['tags'])
                if d['body'] and d['body'] not in all_bodies:
                    all_bodies.append(d['body'])
                if d.get('resource'): all_resources.add(d['resource'])
                if d['timestamp'] > latest_ts: latest_ts = d['timestamp']
            
            # Remove duplicate files
            for d in dupes[1:]:
                if not DRY_RUN: os.remove(d['path'])
                groups[ctype].remove(d)
                stats['removed'] += 1
            
            # Update primary
            p = groups[ctype][groups[ctype].index(primary)]
            p['tags'] = sorted(all_tags)
            p['timestamp'] = latest_ts
            p['resource'] = ', '.join(sorted(all_resources)) if all_resources else primary['resource']
            p['body'] = '\n\n'.join(all_bodies)
            if not DRY_RUN: write_md(p['path'], p)
    
    return stats

# ── Phase 2: Fuzzy cluster (inverted index, fast) ──────────────────

def fuzzy_cluster(groups, threshold=0.55):
    clusters = []
    
    for ctype in ['entity', 'tool', 'topic']:
        items = groups.get(ctype, [])
        if len(items) < 2: continue
        
        # Build inverted index: word -> list of item indices
        inverted = defaultdict(set)
        for i, item in enumerate(items):
            for w in tokenize(item['title']):
                inverted[w].add(i)
        
        # Compute adjacency only for pairs sharing a word
        adj = defaultdict(set)
        compared = set()
        for word, indices in inverted.items():
            indices = list(indices)
            for ai in range(len(indices)):
                for bi in range(ai + 1, len(indices)):
                    i, j = indices[ai], indices[bi]
                    if i == j: continue
                    key = (min(i, j), max(i, j))
                    if key in compared: continue
                    compared.add(key)
                    sim = combined_sim(items[i]['title'], items[j]['title'])
                    if sim >= threshold:
                        adj[i].add(j)
                        adj[j].add(i)
        
        # Connected components
        visited = set()
        for i in range(len(items)):
            if i in visited: continue
            stack = [i]
            comp = []
            while stack:
                idx = stack.pop()
                if idx in visited: continue
                visited.add(idx)
                comp.append(idx)
                for nb in adj.get(idx, set()):
                    if nb not in visited: stack.append(nb)
            if len(comp) > 1:
                clusters.append({
                    'type': ctype,
                    'items': [items[idx] for idx in comp],
                })
    
    return clusters

# ── Phase 3: Write cluster concepts ────────────────────────────────

def write_clusters(clusters):
    cluster_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'clusters')
    os.makedirs(cluster_dir, exist_ok=True)
    written = []
    
    for cl in clusters:
        titles = [item['title'] for item in cl['items']]
        
        # Find common prefix
        common = os.path.commonprefix(titles).strip()
        if len(common) < 3:
            words = Counter()
            for t in titles:
                for w in t.lower().split():
                    if len(w) > 3: words[w] += 1
            common = (words.most_common(1)[0][0].capitalize() + " variants"
                     ) if words else f"{cl['type']} cluster"
        
        title = common[:60]
        slug = slugify(f"cluster-{cl['type']}-{title}")
        
        body = f"# {title}\n\n**Type:** {cl['type']} cluster\n**Members:** {len(titles)}\n\n"
        body += "## Members\n" + ''.join(f"- {t}\n" for t in titles)
        
        all_tags = set()
        for item in cl['items']: all_tags.update(item.get('tags', []))
        body += "\n## Tags\n" + ', '.join(f'`{t}`' for t in sorted(all_tags)[:15])
        
        obj = {
            'type': 'synthesis',
            'title': title,
            'description': f"Cluster of {len(titles)} {cl['type']} concepts",
            'tags': sorted(all_tags)[:8],
            'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
            'resource': '',
            'body': body,
        }
        
        path = os.path.join(cluster_dir, f"{slug}.md")
        if not DRY_RUN: write_md(path, obj)
        written.append(path)
    
    return written

# ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print(f"Bundle: {WIKI}")
    if DRY_RUN: print("DRY RUN — no files modified\n")
    else: print()

    # Scan
    print("Scanning...", end=' ', flush=True)
    groups = scan()
    total = sum(len(v) for v in groups.values())
    print(f"{total} files")
    for t, items in groups.items():
        print(f"  {t}: {len(items)}")
    print()

    # Phase 1: Exact dedup
    print("Phase 1: Exact dedup...", end=' ', flush=True)
    stats = merge_dupes(groups)
    total2 = sum(len(v) for v in groups.values())
    print(f"removed {stats['removed']} files → {total2} remaining")
    print()

    # Phase 2: Fuzzy cluster
    print("Phase 2: Fuzzy clustering...", end=' ', flush=True)
    clusters = fuzzy_cluster(groups)
    print(f"{len(clusters)} clusters found")

    # Show top clusters
    for cl in sorted(clusters, key=lambda c: -len(c['items']))[:15]:
        titles = [item['title'] for item in cl['items']]
        print(f"  [{cl['type']}] {' | '.join(titles[:5])}", end='')
        print(f" (+{len(titles)-5})" if len(titles) > 5 else "")
    print()

    # Phase 3: Write cluster summaries
    print("Phase 3: Cluster summaries...", end=' ', flush=True)
    written = write_clusters(clusters)
    print(f"wrote {len(written)} files to wiki/clusters/")
    print()

    # Summary
    print("=== Summary ===")
    print(f"Before: {total} files")
    print(f"After dedup: {total2} files")
    print(f"Clusters: {len(clusters)}")
    print(f"Cluster summaries: {len(written)}")
    print(f"Files removed: {stats['removed']}")
    print("Done.")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

### 📄 `.wiki-daemon/curate-wiki.py`  [32.8KB]

<a id="file-wiki-daemoncurate-wiki-py"></a>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""mykb wiki curator — enriches stub entities with session-synthesized content.

Strategy:
  1. Build an index: entity → list of sessions that mention it
  2. For each entity, extract relevant context from those sessions
  3. Generate enriched content: definition, usage patterns, cross-refs
  4. Track progress in ops/curation-todo.md

Usage:
  python3 .wiki-daemon/curate-wiki.py [--top N] [--dry-run] [--fill] [--status]
"""

import os, re, sys, json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from datetime import datetime

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, "wiki")
OPS = os.path.join(BUNDLE, "ops")
DRY_RUN = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
FILL = "--fill" in sys.argv  # actually write content
STATUS = "--status" in sys.argv
TOP_N = None
if "--top" in sys.argv:
    idx = sys.argv.index("--top")
    TOP_N = int(sys.argv[idx + 1])

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_md(path):
    try: text = Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    except: return None
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not m: return None
    fm = {}
    for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
        if ':' not in line: continue
        k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k == 'tags':
            v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
        fm[k] = v
    return {'fm': fm, 'body': (m.group(2) or '').strip(), 'path': str(path)}

def write_md(path, obj):
    tags_str = ', '.join(f'"{t}"' for t in obj.get('tags', []))
    resource = obj.get('resource', '')
    Path(path).write_text(
        f'---\ntype: "{obj["type"]}"\ntitle: "{obj["title"]}"'
        f'\ndescription: "{obj.get("description", "")}"'
        f'\ntags: [{tags_str}]'
        f'\ntimestamp: "{obj.get("timestamp", "")}"'
        f'\nresource: "{resource}"'
        f'\n---\n\n{obj.get("body", "").strip()}\n'
    )


# ── Stub detection ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def is_stub(body):
    """Return True if entity body is a stub (no real knowledge content).

    Detects entities that only have auto-generated session references
    and cross-link "Related:" tags but no actual knowledge.
    Real enrichment is indicated by ## Overview (known-tech definitions)
    or ## Context (session-derived snippets), or non-trivial prose.
    """
    if not body or len(body.strip()) < 50:
        return True

    # Has real content sections from prior enrichment
    if '## Overview' in body:    # Known-tech definition present
        return False
    if '## Context' in body:     # Session-derived context present
        return False

    # Strip all auto-generated scaffolding
    cleaned = body
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^---\n.*?\n---\n?', '', cleaned, flags=re.DOTALL)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^Referenced in agent session.*$', '', cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^Auto-extracted from agent session.*$', '', cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^Referenced in \d+ session.*$', '', cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^Related:.*$', '', cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^#\s+.*$', '', cleaned, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    cleaned = cleaned.strip()

    return len(cleaned) < 80  # No real content if only scaffolding remains

# ── Build index ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_index():
    """Build entity-to-sessions index and collect session bodies."""
    print("Building entity↔session index...", end=' ', flush=True)
    
    sessions = {}
    for fn in os.listdir(os.path.join(WIKI, 'sessions')):
        if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
        path = os.path.join(WIKI, 'sessions', fn)
        p = parse_md(path)
        if not p: continue
        slug = fn.replace('.md', '')
        # Store both by full slug (session-XXXX) and bare hash (XXXX)
        hash_part = slug.replace('session-', '') if slug.startswith('session-') else slug
        sessions[slug] = {
            'title': p['fm'].get('title', slug),
            'tags': p['fm'].get('tags', []),
            'body': p['body'],
            'path': path,
        }
        sessions[hash_part] = sessions[slug]  # Also accessible by bare hash
    
    # Build reverse index: entity slug → list of session slugs
    # (from entity body references back to sessions)
    entity_sessions = defaultdict(list)
    
    # Load entity metadata
    entities = {}
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(os.path.join(WIKI, 'domains')):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith('.md') or fn == 'index.md': continue
            path = os.path.join(root, fn)
            p = parse_md(path)
            if not p: continue
            slug = fn.replace('.md', '')
            title = p['fm'].get('title', slug)
            body = p['body']
            entities[slug] = {
                'title': title,
                'body': body,
                'path': path,
                'tags': p['fm'].get('tags', []),
                'desc': p['fm'].get('description', ''),
                "session_count": 0,
                "sessions": [],
            }
    

    # Build entity→session index from entity body references
    for e_slug, entity in entities.items():
        body = entity['body']
        session_refs = set(re.findall(r'(?:session |session-)([0-9a-f]+)', body, re.IGNORECASE))
        for ref in session_refs:
            entity_sessions[e_slug].append(ref)

    # Update entities with session data
    for slug in entities:
        entities[slug]['session_count'] = len(entity_sessions.get(slug, []))
        entities[slug]['sessions'] = entity_sessions.get(slug, [])

    print(f"{len(entities)} entities, {len(sessions)} sessions")
    return entities, sessions

# ── Content enrichment ────────────────────────────────────────────

def extract_session_context(session, entity_title):
    """Extract relevant snippets from a session body about an entity."""
    body = session['body']
    if not body:
        return []
    
    snippets = []
    # Find lines containing the entity title
    for i, line in enumerate(body.split('\n')):
        if entity_title.lower() in line.lower():
            # Get context: 1 line before and after
            lines = body.split('\n')
            start = max(0, i - 1)
            end = min(len(lines), i + 2)
            snippet = '\n'.join(lines[start:end]).strip()
            if snippet and len(snippet) > 10:
                snippets.append(snippet[:200])
    
    return snippets[:5]  # max 5 snippets

def enrich_entity(entity, sessions, known_tech):
    """Generate enriched content for an entity."""
    title = entity['title']
    slug = Path(entity['path']).stem
    session_count = entity['session_count']
    tags = entity['tags']
    old_body = entity['body']
    
    # Skip if already has real knowledge content
    if not is_stub(old_body):
        return None
    
    # Collect context from sessions
    all_context = []
    session_titles = []
    for s_slug in entity['sessions']:
        session = sessions.get(s_slug)
        if session:
            session_titles.append((s_slug, session['title']))
            snippets = extract_session_context(session, title)
            all_context.extend(snippets)
    
    # Determine if it's a known tech (from our knowledge)
    is_known = title.lower() in known_tech
    
    # Build new body
    body_parts = []
    
    # Description (skip auto-generated refs)
    desc = entity.get('desc', '')
    if desc and 'Auto-extracted' not in desc and 'Referenced in agent session' not in desc:
        body_parts.append(desc)
    
    # Session context (what was actually discussed)
    if session_titles:
        body_parts.append(f"\n## References\n\nReferenced in {len(session_titles)} session(s):\n")
        for s_slug, s_title in sorted(session_titles):
            file_slug = s_slug if s_slug.startswith('session-') else f"session-{s_slug}"
            rel = f"../sessions/{file_slug}.md"
            body_parts.append(f"- [{s_title}]({rel})\n")
    
    # If known tech, add definition
    if is_known:
        known_info = known_tech.get(title.lower())
        if known_info:
            body_parts.insert(0, f"## Overview\n\n{known_info}")
    
    # Add context snippets
    if all_context:
        body_parts.append(f"\n## Context\n\n")
        for snip in all_context[:3]:
            body_parts.append(f"> {snip}\n")
    
    # If no context was found and not a known tech, generate tag-based description
    if not is_known and not all_context and tags:
        tag_groups = []
        if 'android' in tags: tag_groups.append('Mobile')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['api', 'rest', 'graphql', 'websocket']): tag_groups.append('API')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['auth', 'authentication', 'authorization', 'oauth', 'jwt']): tag_groups.append('Security')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['aws', 'gcp', 'azure', 'cloud', 'deployment']): tag_groups.append('Cloud')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['database', 'sqlite', 'postgresql', 'mongodb', 'redis']): tag_groups.append('Database')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['python', 'javascript', 'typescript', 'rust', 'go', 'java']): tag_groups.append('Language')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['bash', 'terminal', 'termux', 'shell']): tag_groups.append('Shell')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['angular', 'react', 'vue', 'svelte', 'frontend', 'css', 'html']): tag_groups.append('Frontend')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['backend', 'fastapi', 'django', 'flask', 'node']): tag_groups.append('Backend')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['docker', 'kubernetes', 'nginx', 'deployment']): tag_groups.append('DevOps')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['git', 'github', 'ci/cd']): tag_groups.append('Version Control')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['ai', 'llm', 'gemini', 'openai', 'claude', 'ml']): tag_groups.append('AI')
        if any(t in tags for t in ['bug', 'error', 'debug']): tag_groups.append('Debugging')
        
        # Only add tag context if we have meaningful tag groups
        if tag_groups:
            clean_tags = [t for t in tags if not t.endswith('.') and t not in ['entity', 'bug', 'ast']]
            if clean_tags:
                tag_groups_str = ', '.join(sorted(set(tag_groups)))
                tags_str = ', '.join(sorted(set(clean_tags)))
                body_parts.append(f"\n## Overview\n\n{title} appears in {session_count} session(s) categorized as {tag_groups_str}. Related topics: {tags_str}.")
        elif tags:
            clean_tags = [t for t in tags if not t.endswith('.') and t != 'entity']
            body_parts.append(f"\n## Overview\n\n{title} is referenced in {session_count} session(s). Related tags: {', '.join(sorted(set(clean_tags)))}.")
    
    # Also add a note about the session count for unknown entities
    if not is_known and not all_context:
        if not body_parts or all(p == '' for p in body_parts):
            body_parts.append(f"Referenced in {session_count} session(s).")
    
    new_body = '\n'.join(body_parts).strip()
    if not new_body:
        new_body = f"Referenced in {session_count} session(s)."
    
    return new_body

def print_status(entities):
    """Print current curation status."""
    total = len(entities)
    enriched = sum(1 for e in entities.values() if not is_stub(e['body']))
    stubs = total - enriched
    by_sessions = Counter()
    for e in entities.values():
        if e['session_count'] > 0:
            by_sessions[e['session_count']] += 1
    
    print(f"\n=== Curation Status ===")
    print(f"Total entities: {total}")
    print(f"Already enriched (300+ bytes): {enriched}")
    print(f"Stubs to fill: {stubs}")
    print(f"\nEntities by session reach:")
    for count, num in sorted(by_sessions.items(), reverse=True)[:10]:
        print(f"  {count} sessions: {num} entities")
    print(f"\nTop 10 entities to work on next:")
    sorted_e = sorted(entities.values(), key=lambda x: -x['session_count'])
    for e in sorted_e[:10]:
        auto = 'Auto-extracted from agent session' in e['body']
        status = "X" if len(e['body']) > 300 and not auto else " "
        print(f"  [{status}] {e['title']:35s} → {e['session_count']:3d} sessions ({len(e['body']):4d}b)")

def update_todo(entities, enriched_count):
    """Write/update the curation TODO list."""
    os.makedirs(OPS, exist_ok=True)
    
    sorted_e = sorted(entities.values(), key=lambda x: -x['session_count'])
    
    lines = [
        "---",
        'type: "log"',
        'title: "Curation TODO"',
        'description: "Progressive entity enrichment tracker"',
        "tags: [\"curation\", \"todo\"]",
        "---",
        "",
        f"# Curation TODO",
        "",
        f"_Last updated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}_",
        "",
        f"**Progress:** {enriched_count}/{len(entities)} entities enriched",
        "",
        "## Queue (by session reach)",
        "",
        "| # | Entity | Sessions | Status |",
        "|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    

    for i, e in enumerate(sorted_e[:100], 1):
        auto = 'Auto-extracted from agent session' in e['body']
        status = "X" if not is_stub(e['body']) else ' '
        lines.append(f"| {i} | {e['title']} | {e['session_count']} | {status} |")
    lines.extend([
        "",
        f"## Remaining ({len(sorted_e) - 100} more entities)",
        "",
        f"Total entities: {len(entities)}",
        f"Enriched: {enriched_count}",
        f"Stubs remaining: {len(entities) - enriched_count}",
    ])

    Path(os.path.join(OPS, 'curation-todo.md')).write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')

def main():
    entities, sessions = build_index()
    
    if STATUS:
        print_status(entities)
        return
    
    if FILL:
        # Sort by session count (most referenced first)
        # Prioritize stubs needing fill, then by session count
        sorted_entities = sorted(entities.items(), key=lambda x: (
            0 if not is_stub(x[1]['body']) else 1,
            -x[1]['session_count']
        ))
        if TOP_N:
            sorted_entities = sorted_entities[:TOP_N]
        
        enriched_count = sum(1 for e in entities.values() 
                           if not is_stub(e['body']))
        
        print(f"\nEnriching {len(sorted_entities)} entities...\n")
        count = 0
        
        for slug, entity in sorted_entities:
            # Skip already enriched
            if not is_stub(entity['body']):
                continue
            
            print(f"  [{count+1}] {entity['title']} ({entity['session_count']} sessions)...", end=' ', flush=True)
            
            enriched_body = enrich_entity(entity, sessions, KNOWN_TECH)
            if not enriched_body:
                print("skipped")
                continue
            
            if not DRY_RUN:
                # Update the entity file
                parsed = parse_md(entity['path'])
                if parsed:
                    parsed['body'] = enriched_body
                    desc = parsed['fm'].get('description', '')
                    if not desc:
                        # Generate description from first line of body
                        first_line = enriched_body.split('\n')[0]
                        if not first_line.startswith('#'):
                            desc = first_line[:150]
                        else:
                            desc = f"Entity referenced in {entity['session_count']} sessions"
                    write_md(entity['path'], {
                        'type': parsed['fm'].get('type', 'entity'),
                        'title': entity['title'],
                        'description': desc,
                        'tags': parsed['fm'].get('tags', []),
                        'timestamp': datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
                        'resource': parsed['fm'].get('resource', ''),
                        'body': enriched_body,
                    })
                enriched_count += 1
            
            print(f"{len(enriched_body)}b")
            count += 1
        
        # Update TODO tracker
        if not DRY_RUN:
            update_todo(entities, enriched_count)
        
        print(f"\nEnriched {count} entities")
        return
    
    # Default: just show status and write TODO
    enriched_count = sum(1 for e in entities.values() 
                        if not is_stub(e['body']))
    print_status(entities)
    if not DRY_RUN:
        update_todo(entities, enriched_count)
        print(f"\nTODO list written to ops/curation-todo.md")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Curate the mykb wiki into a multi-tier hierarchy with tight classification.

Usage:
  python3 .wiki-daemon/curate.py [--dry-run] [--insights-only]
"""

import os, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, "wiki")
DRY_RUN = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
INSIGHTS_ONLY = "--insights-only" in sys.argv

# ── IO ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_md(path):
    try: text = Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    except: return None
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not m: return None
    fm = {}
    for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
        if ':' not in line: continue
        k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k == 'tags':
            v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
        fm[k] = v
    return {'fm': fm, 'body': (m.group(2) or '').strip()}

def write_md(path, title, type_, desc, tags, body):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tags_str = ', '.join(f'"{t}"' for t in tags)
    path.write_text(f'---\ntype: "{type_}"\ntitle: "{title}"\ndescription: "{desc}"\ntags: [{tags_str}]\n---\n\n{body.strip()}\n')
```
