    (("dev-tools", "testing", "Testing"), ["test", "jest", "playwright", "cypress", "pytest", "vitest"], ["\\btest\\b", "\\bjest\\b", "\\bplaywright\\b"]),
    (("dev-tools", "build", "Build Tools"), ["webpack", "vite", "esbuild", "babel", "swc"], ["\\bvite\\b", "\\besbuild\\b", "\\bbabel\\b"]),
    (("dev-tools", "ide", "IDEs"), ["vscode", "jetbrains", "ide"], ["\\bjetbrains\\b", "\\bvscode\\b"]),
    
    # Domain: Mobile & Platform
    (("mobile-platform", "android", "Android"), ["android"], ["\\bandroid\\b"]),
    (("mobile-platform", "termux", "Termux"), ["termux"], ["\\btermux\\b"]),
    (("mobile-platform", "ios", "iOS"), ["ios"], ["\\bios\\b"]),
    
    # Domain: OS & Shell
    (("os-shell", "linux", "Linux"), ["linux", "ubuntu", "debian", "alpine"], ["\\blinux\\b", "\\bubuntu\\b", "\\bdebian\\b"]),
    (("os-shell", "shell", "Bash/Shell"), ["bash", "shell", "zsh"], ["\\bbash\\b", "\\bshell\\b", "\\bzsh\\b"]),
    (("os-shell", "terminal", "Terminal"), ["terminal", "console"], ["\\bterminal\\b"]),
    
    # Domain: Visualization & Knowledge
    (("viz-knowledge", "data-viz", "Data Viz"), ["matplotlib", "plotly", "d3.js", "seaborn"], ["\\bmatplotlib\\b", "\\bplotly\\b", "\\bd3\\b"]),
    (("viz-knowledge", "knowledge", "Knowledge Graph"), ["okf", "knowledge graph"], ["\\bokf\\b", "\\bknowledge graph\\b"]),
    
    # Domain: Security & Auth
    (("security-auth", "auth", "Auth Protocols"), ["oauth", "jwt", "authentication", "authorization"], ["\\boauth\\b", "\\bjwt\\b", "\\bauth\\b"]),
    (("security-auth", "security", "Security"), ["security", "ssl", "tls", "encryption"], ["\\bsecurity\\b", "\\bssl\\b", "\\btls\\b"]),
    
    # Domain: Gaming & Simulation
    (("gaming-sim", "simulation", "Simulation"), ["simulation", "particle", "physics"], ["\\bsimulation\\b", "\\bparticle\\b"]),
    (("gaming-sim", "game", "Game Dev"), ["phaser", "pixi", "game engine"], ["\\bphaser\\b", "\\bpixi\\b"]),
    
    # Domain: Agent Systems
    (("agent-systems", "codex", "Codex Platform"), ["codex"], ["\\bcodex\\b"]),
    (("agent-systems", "agents", "AI Agents"), ["agent"], ["\\bagent\\b"]),
    (("agent-systems", "tools", "Agent Tools"), ["tool", "mcp", "function call"], ["\\btool\\b", "\\bmcp\\b"]),
]

# ── Scan ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def scan_all():
    concepts = []
    type_dirs = {
        'session': 'sessions', 'entity': 'entities', 'tool': 'tools',
        'topic': 'topics', 'decision': 'decisions', 'synthesis': 'clusters'
    }
    for ctype, dname in type_dirs.items():
        d = os.path.join(WIKI, dname)
        if not os.path.isdir(d): continue
        for fn in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
            if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
            path = os.path.join(d, fn)
            parsed = parse_md(path)
            if not parsed: continue
            fm = parsed['fm']
            concepts.append({
                'title': fm.get('title', fn),
                'type': ctype,
                'tags': fm.get('tags', []),
                'desc': fm.get('description', ''),
                'slug': fn.replace('.md', ''),
                'path': path,
            })
    return concepts

# ── Tight classifier ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def classify_tight(concept):
    """Match concept against rules. Returns (domain, supercat, group) or None."""
    title = concept['title']
    tags = ' '.join(concept['tags'])
    desc = concept['desc']
    
    for (dom, scat, group), title_kw, patterns in RULES:
        # Check title (highest weight)
        for pat in patterns:
            if re.search(pat, title, re.IGNORECASE):
                return (dom, scat, group)
        # Check tags
        for kw in title_kw:
            if kw.lower() in tags.lower():
                return (dom, scat, group)
        # Check description
        for kw in title_kw:
            if kw.lower() in desc.lower():
                return (dom, scat, group)
    
    return None

# ── Insights generation ────────────────────────────────────────────

def generate_insights(concepts, tree):
    """Generate development profile from classified concepts."""
    # Domain distribution
    dom_counts = Counter()
    supercat_counts = Counter()
    group_counts = Counter()
    
    for concept in concepts:
        cls = classify_tight(concept)
        if cls:
            dom, scat, grp = cls
            dom_counts[dom] += 1
            supercat_counts[f"{dom} → {scat}"] += 1
            group_counts[f"{dom} → {scat} → {grp}"] += 1
    
    # Technology frequency from entity names
    tech_names = Counter()
    for c in concepts:
        if c['type'] != 'entity': continue
        t = c['title']
        # Count known tech mentions
        techs = ['Python', 'JavaScript', 'TypeScript', 'Rust', 'React', 'Angular', 
                 'FastAPI', 'Django', 'Docker', 'AWS', 'Git', 'PostgreSQL',
                 'Android', 'Redis', 'GraphQL', 'Gemini']
        for tech in techs:
            if tech.lower() in t.lower():
                tech_names[tech] += 1
    
    # Session activity
    sessions = [c for c in concepts if c['type'] == 'session']
    total_turns = 0
    for s in sessions:
        m = re.search(r'\((\d+) turns?\)', s['title'])
        if m: total_turns += int(m.group(1))
    
    # Build profile
    profile = "# 🧠 Development Profile\n\n"
    profile += "Auto-curated from all agent sessions and extracted concepts.\n\n"
    
    profile += "## Domain Focus\n\n"
    profile += "| Domain | Concepts | Share |\n"
    profile += "|---|---|---|\n"
    total = sum(dom_counts.values()) or 1
    for dom, count in dom_counts.most_common():
        bar = '█' * int(count * 30 / total) + '░' * (30 - int(count * 30 / total))
        pct = count * 100 / total
        profile += f"| {dom.replace('-', ' ').title()} | {count} | {pct:.0f}% {bar} |\n"
    
    profile += "\n## Top Technologies\n\n"
    for tech, count in tech_names.most_common(20):
        bar = '█' * min(count, 20) + '░' * max(0, 20 - min(count, 20))
        profile += f"- **{tech}**: {count}× {bar}\n"
    
    profile += "\n## Session Stats\n\n"
    profile += f"- **Total sessions**: {len(sessions)}\n"
    profile += f"- **Total turns across all sessions**: ~{total_turns}\n"
    profile += f"- **Avg turns per session**: ~{total_turns // max(len(sessions), 1)}\n"
    profile += f"- **Entities extracted**: {len([c for c in concepts if c['type'] == 'entity'])}\n"
    profile += f"- **Knowledge clusters**: {len([c for c in concepts if c['type'] == 'synthesis'])}\n"
    
    return profile

# ── Write hierarchy ────────────────────────────────────────────────

def write_hierarchy(concepts, tree):
    """Generate hierarchical index pages."""
    domain_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'domains')
    os.makedirs(domain_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Collect classification results
    classified = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list)))
    unclassified = []
    
    for c in concepts:
        cls = classify_tight(c)
        if cls:
            dom, scat, grp = cls
            classified[dom][scat][grp].append(c)
        else:
            unclassified.append(c)
    
    # ── Domain index ──
    body = "# Domain Map\n\n"
    body += "Multi-tier hierarchy of all wiki concepts.\n\n"
    body += "| Domain | Concepts | Supercategories |\n|---|---|---|\n"
    
    for dom in sorted(classified.keys()):
        scats = classified[dom]
        total = sum(len(v) for vv in scats.values() for v in vv.values())
        scat_list = ', '.join(sorted(scats.keys()))
        body += f"| [{dom.replace('-', ' ').title()}]({dom}/index.md) | {total} | {scat_list} |\n"
    
    if unclassified:
        body += f"\n**{len(unclassified)} unclassified** concepts need manual sorting.\n"
    
    if not DRY_RUN:
        write_md(os.path.join(domain_dir, 'index.md'),
                'Domain Map', 'index', 'Multi-tier hierarchy of all concepts', ['domain', 'index'], body)
    
    # ── Per-domain pages ──
    for dom, scats in sorted(classified.items()):
        dom_total = sum(len(v) for vv in scats.values() for v in vv.values())
        dbody = f"# {dom.replace('-', ' ').title()}\n\n{dom_total} concepts\n\n"
        
        for scat, groups in sorted(scats.items()):
            scat_total = sum(len(v) for v in groups.values())
            dbody += f"## {scat.replace('-', ' ').title()} ({scat_total})\n\n"
            
            for group, items in sorted(groups.items()):
                dbody += f"### {group}\n\n"
                for item in sorted(items, key=lambda x: x['title'].lower()):
                    rel = f"../../wiki/{item['type']}s/{item['slug']}.md"
                    dbody += f"- [{item['title']}]({rel}) — {item.get('desc', '')[:60]}\n"
                dbody += "\n"
        
        if not DRY_RUN:
            write_md(os.path.join(domain_dir, dom, 'index.md'),
                    dom.replace('-', ' ').title(), 'domain', f'{dom_total} concepts', [dom], dbody)
    
    # ── Unclassified ──
    if unclassified:
        ubody = "# Unclassified Concepts\n\n"
        ubody += f"**{len(unclassified)} concepts** could not be auto-classified.\n\n"
        for c in sorted(unclassified, key=lambda x: x['title'].lower()):
            ubody += f"- {c['title']} ({c['type']})\n"
        if not DRY_RUN:
            write_md(os.path.join(domain_dir, 'unclassified.md'),
                    'Unclassified', 'index', 'Concepts needing manual sorting', ['unclassified'], ubody)
    
    return classified

# ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print("Scanning...", end=' ', flush=True)
    concepts = scan_all()
    print(f"{len(concepts)} concepts")
    
    if INSIGHTS_ONLY:
        # Quick classification for stats
        doms = Counter()
        for c in concepts:
            cls = classify_tight(c)
            if cls: doms[cls[0]] += 1
        print("\nDomain distribution:")
        for dom, count in doms.most_common():
            print(f"  {dom}: {count}")
        
        profile = generate_insights(concepts, {})
        if not DRY_RUN:
            ins_path = os.path.join(WIKI, 'domains', 'profile.md')
            Path(ins_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            Path(ins_path).write_text('\n' + profile + '\n')
            print(f"\nProfile written to wiki/domains/profile.md")
        return
    
    # Full classification
    print("Classifying...", end=' ', flush=True)
    classified = write_hierarchy(concepts, {})
    total = sum(len(v) for vv in classified.values() for v in vv.values() for v in v.values())
    print(f"{total} classified")
    
    for dom, scats in sorted(classified.items()):
        dom_total = sum(len(v) for vv in scats.values() for v in vv.values())
        print(f"  {dom}: {dom_total}")
        for scat, groups in sorted(scats.items()):
            scat_total = sum(len(v) for v in groups.values())
            print(f"    {scat}: {scat_total}")
    
    # Insights
    profile = generate_insights(concepts, classified)
    if not DRY_RUN:
        ins_path = os.path.join(WIKI, 'domains', 'profile.md')
        Path(ins_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(ins_path).write_text('\n' + profile + '\n')
    
    print("\n" + profile)
    if not DRY_RUN:
        print("\nHierarchy written to wiki/domains/")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
// wiki-daemon.js — The LLM wiki daemon
// Watches session buffers, extracts knowledge, generates OKF concepts, curates.
// Usage: node .wiki-daemon/daemon.js [--foreground]

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { execSync } = require('child_process');
const { analyzeSession, generateConcepts } = require('./extract');
const { writeConcepts, appendToLog } = require('./store');

const CONFIG = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'config.json'), 'utf8'));
const BUNDLE = CONFIG.bundle_path;
const BUFFER_DIR = CONFIG.session_buffers_dir;
const SIGNAL_DIR = path.join(BUFFER_DIR, 'signals');
const PID_FILE = path.join(BUFFER_DIR, 'daemon.pid');

let running = true;
let lastCuration = Date.now();
let processedSessions = new Set();

function log(msg) {
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 19);
  console.log(`[wiki-daemon ${ts}] ${msg}`);
}

function loadConfig() {
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'config.json'), 'utf8');
    Object.assign(CONFIG, JSON.parse(raw));
  } catch { /* use defaults */ }
}

function writePid() {
  ensureDir(BUFFER_DIR);
  fs.writeFileSync(PID_FILE, String(process.pid), 'utf8');
}

function ensureDir(dir) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
}

function findSessionBuffers() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(BUFFER_DIR)) return [];
  return fs.readdirSync(BUFFER_DIR)
    .filter(f => f.endsWith('.ndjson'))
    .map(f => ({
      path: path.join(BUFFER_DIR, f),
      sessionId: f.replace('.ndjson', ''),
      mtime: fs.statSync(path.join(BUFFER_DIR, f)).mtimeMs,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.mtime - b.mtime);
}

function findEndSignals() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(SIGNAL_DIR)) return [];
  return fs.readdirSync(SIGNAL_DIR)
    .filter(f => f.endsWith('.end'))
    .map(f => ({
      path: path.join(SIGNAL_DIR, f),
      sessionId: f.replace('.end', ''),
    }));
}

function loadTurns(filePath) {
  try {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').trim();
    if (!content) return [];
    return content.split('\n')
      .filter(l => l.trim())
      .map(l => JSON.parse(l));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function processSession(sessionId) {
  if (processedSessions.has(sessionId)) return;
  
  const bufferPath = path.join(BUFFER_DIR, `${sessionId}.ndjson`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(bufferPath)) return;
  
  const turns = loadTurns(bufferPath);
  if (turns.length < 2) {
    log(`Session ${sessionId.substring(0, 8)} too short (${turns.length} turns), skipping`);
    return;
  }
  
  log(`Processing session ${sessionId.substring(0, 8)} (${turns.length} turns)`);
  
  try {
    // Analyze the session
    const analysis = analyzeSession(turns);
    
    log(`  Tech terms: ${analysis.techTerms.length}, Acronyms: ${analysis.acronyms.length}, Decisions: ${analysis.decisions.length}`);
    log(`  Tags: ${analysis.tags.join(", ")}`);
    log(`  Tools: ${JSON.stringify(analysis.toolUsage)}`);
    
    // Generate OKF concepts
    const concepts = generateConcepts(analysis, sessionId);
    
    // Write concepts to bundle
    const written = writeConcepts(concepts, BUNDLE);
    log(`  Wrote ${written.length} new concept files`);
    
    
    // Log to bundle log (batched)
    const logEntries = written.map(w => ({
      action: 'Addition',
      description: `auto-extracted: ${path.basename(w, '.md')}`,
      linkText: path.basename(w, '.md'),
      linkUrl: path.relative(BUNDLE, w),
    }));
    appendToLog(BUNDLE, logEntries);
    
    // Update the area index with new entries
    
    // Mark processed
    processedSessions.add(sessionId);
    
    // Clean up buffer and signal
    try { fs.unlinkSync(bufferPath); } catch {}
    const signalPath = path.join(SIGNAL_DIR, `${sessionId}.end`);
    try { fs.unlinkSync(signalPath); } catch {}
    
  } catch (err) {
    log(`  Error processing session: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

function runCuration() {
  log('Running curation cycle...');
  
  try {
    // Validate
    const validateOut = execSync(`cd "${BUNDLE}" && okf validate . 2>&1`, { timeout: 10000, encoding: 'utf8' });
    const isConformant = validateOut.includes('✓ conformant');
    log(`  Validate: ${isConformant ? '✓ conformant' : '✗ errors detected'}`);
    
    // Lint
    const lintOut = execSync(`cd "${BUNDLE}" && okf lint . 2>&1`, { timeout: 10000, encoding: 'utf8' });
    const warnCount = (lintOut.match(/warn/g) || []).length;
    log(`  Lint: ${warnCount} warnings`);
    
    // Write curation report
    const reportDir = path.join(BUNDLE, 'ops', 'reports');
    ensureDir(reportDir);
    const reportFile = path.join(reportDir, `curation-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.md`);
    fs.writeFileSync(reportFile, `# Curation Report\n\n${new Date().toISOString()}\n\n## Validate\n\`\`\`\n${validateOut}\n\`\`\`\n\n## Lint\n\`\`\`\n${lintOut}\n\`\`\`\n`, 'utf8');
    
    lastCuration = Date.now();
  } catch (err) {
    log(`  Curation error: ${err.message}`);
  }
}

function cleanupStaleBuffers() {
  // Remove buffers older than 24h with no end signal
  const now = Date.now();
  const buffers = findSessionBuffers();
  
  for (const buf of buffers) {
    const signalPath = path.join(SIGNAL_DIR, `${buf.sessionId}.end`);
    if (now - buf.mtime > 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
      // Old buffer — check if there's an orphaned end signal or just clean up
      const turns = loadTurns(buf.path);
      if (turns.length >= 2) {
        log(`Recovering stale session ${buf.sessionId.substring(0, 8)} (${turns.length} turns)`);
        try { processSession(buf.sessionId); } catch {}
      } else {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(buf.path); } catch {}
        try { fs.unlinkSync(signalPath); } catch {}
      }
    }
  }
}

function mainLoop() {
  if (!running) return;
  
  loadConfig();
  
  // Check for end signals → process sessions
  const signals = findEndSignals();
  for (const sig of signals) {
    processSession(sig.sessionId);
  }
  
  // Periodic curation
  if (Date.now() - lastCuration > CONFIG.curation_interval_min * 60 * 1000) {
    runCuration();
  }
  
  // Cleanup stale buffers
  cleanupStaleBuffers();
  
  setTimeout(mainLoop, CONFIG.poll_interval_ms);
}

// Startup
ensureDir(BUFFER_DIR);
ensureDir(SIGNAL_DIR);
writePid();

log(`Wiki daemon starting (PID ${process.pid})`);
log(`Bundle: ${BUNDLE}`);
log(`Buffers: ${BUFFER_DIR}`);
log(`Poll interval: ${CONFIG.poll_interval_ms}ms`);
log(`Curation interval: ${CONFIG.curation_interval_min}min`);

// Handle signals
process.on('SIGINT', () => {
  log('Shutting down...');
  running = false;
  try { fs.unlinkSync(PID_FILE); } catch {}
  process.exit(0);
});

process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
  log('Shutting down...');
  running = false;
  try { fs.unlinkSync(PID_FILE); } catch {}
  process.exit(0);
});

// Main loop
mainLoop();

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Embedding pipeline for mykb — TF-IDF vectorizer + nightly batch embedder.
Uses pure numpy — no sklearn/sentence-transformers dependency required.
"""
import os, re, json, math
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki')
VDB_PATH = os.path.join(BUNDLE, '.wiki-daemon', 'vdb')

# ── TF-IDF Vectorizer ─────────────────────────────────────────

class TfidfVectorizer:
    """Lightweight TF-IDF implementation using numpy."""
    
    def __init__(self, max_features=5000):
        self.max_features = max_features
        self.vocab = {}         # term -> index
        self.idf = None         # (V,) array
        self.doc_count = 0
        self._fitted = False
    
    def _tokenize(self, text):
        """Lowercase + split on non-alphanumeric."""
        text = text.lower()
        tokens = re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]+', text)
        return [t for t in tokens if len(t) >= 2]
    
    def fit(self, documents):
        """Learn vocabulary and IDF from document list."""
        # Count document frequency for each term
        df = Counter()
        all_tokens = []
        for doc in documents:
            tokens = set(self._tokenize(doc))
            for t in tokens:
                df[t] += 1
            all_tokens.append(tokens)
        
        # Select top features
        top_terms = [t for t, _ in df.most_common(self.max_features)]
        self.vocab = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(top_terms)}
        self.doc_count = len(documents)
        
        # Compute IDF
        self.idf = np.zeros(len(self.vocab), dtype=np.float32)
        for term, idx in self.vocab.items():
            self.idf[idx] = math.log((self.doc_count + 1) / (df[term] + 1)) + 1
        
        self._fitted = True
        return self
    
    def transform(self, document):
        """Transform document to TF-IDF vector."""
        if not self._fitted:
            raise ValueError("Vectorizer not fitted")
        
        tokens = self._tokenize(document)
        if not tokens:
            return np.zeros(len(self.vocab), dtype=np.float32)
        
        # Term frequency
        tf = Counter(tokens)
        vec = np.zeros(len(self.vocab), dtype=np.float32)
        for term, count in tf.items():
            if term in self.vocab:
                idx = self.vocab[term]
                # TF normalize by doc length
                vec[idx] = (1 + math.log(count)) * self.idf[idx]
        
        # L2 normalize
        norm = np.linalg.norm(vec)
        if norm > 0:
            vec = vec / norm
        return vec
    
    def fit_transform(self, documents):
        self.fit(documents)
        return np.array([self.transform(d) for d in documents])
    
    def save(self, path):
        data = {
            'vocab': self.vocab,
            'idf': self.idf.tolist(),
            'doc_count': self.doc_count,
            'max_features': self.max_features,
        }
        with open(path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(data, f)
    
    def load(self, path):
        with open(path) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        self.vocab = data['vocab']
        self.idf = np.array(data['idf'], dtype=np.float32)
        self.doc_count = data['doc_count']
        self.max_features = data['max_features']
        self._fitted = True
        return self


# ── Embedding Pipeline ────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_md(path):
    try: text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    except: return None
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not m: return None
    fm = {}
    for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
        if ':' not in line: continue
        k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k == 'tags':
            v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
        fm[k] = v
    return {'fm': fm, 'body': (m.group(2) or '').strip()}

def scan_wiki_docs():
    """Scan all wiki .md files and return (id, title, text, metadata) tuples."""
    docs = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(WIKI):
        for fn in sorted(files):
            if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
            path = os.path.join(root, fn)
            rel = os.path.relpath(path, WIKI)
            parsed = parse_md(path)
            if not parsed: continue
            fm = parsed['fm']
            doc_id = rel.replace('.md', '')
            title = fm.get('title', fn.replace('.md', ''))
            body = parsed['body']
            # Combine title + tags + body for embedding
            text = f"{title} {' '.join(fm.get('tags', []))} {body[:2000]}"
            metadata = {
                'type': fm.get('type', 'concept'),
                'title': title,
                'tags': fm.get('tags', []),
                'description': fm.get('description', ''),
            }
            docs.append((doc_id, title, text, metadata))
    return docs

def embed_all():
    """Full pipeline: scan → fit vectorizer → build vector DB."""
    import vectordb
    
    print("Scanning wiki documents...", flush=True)
    docs = scan_wiki_docs()
    print(f"  Found {len(docs)} documents", flush=True)
    
    # Fit TF-IDF on all docs
    print("Fitting TF-IDF vectorizer...", flush=True)
    texts = [d[2] for d in docs]
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=3000)
    vectorizer.fit(texts)
    
    # Build vector DB
    print("Building vector database...", flush=True)
    vdb = vectordb.VectorDB()
    ids = []
    embeddings = []
    metadatas = []
    for doc_id, title, text, metadata in docs:
        vec = vectorizer.transform(text)
        ids.append(doc_id)
        embeddings.append(vec)
        metadatas.append(metadata)
    
    vdb.add_batch(ids, embeddings, metadatas)
    
    # Save
    print(f"Saving vectorizer and DB ({vdb.count()} vectors)...", flush=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(VDB_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    vectorizer.save(VDB_PATH + '_tfidf.json')
    vdb.persist(VDB_PATH)
    
    print(f"Done: {vdb.count()} vectors, {len(vectorizer.vocab)} vocabulary", flush=True)
    return vdb, vectorizer

def load_embedder():
    """Load saved vectorizer and DB."""
    import vectordb
    vdb = vectordb.VectorDB()
    if os.path.exists(VDB_PATH + '.npz'):
        vdb.load(VDB_PATH)
        vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
        vectorizer.load(VDB_PATH + '_tfidf.json')
        return vdb, vectorizer
    return None, None

# ── Standalone ──
if __name__ == '__main__':
    embed_all()
```

# Topic patterns for detecting what an entity is about
TOPIC_PATTERNS = {
    'framework|library|sdk': 'software library/framework',
    'protocol|schema|format': 'data format/protocol specification',
    'language|grammar|syntax': 'programming language/syntax definition',
    'command|tool|utility': 'command-line tool/utility',

    'mobile|android|ios': 'mobile platform technology',
    'cloud|aws|gcp|azure': 'cloud computing service',
    'container|docker|kube': 'containerization/orchestration',
    'math|stat|prob|linear': 'mathematical/statistical concept',
    'ml|ai|neural|train': 'machine learning/AI concept',
}


def generate_description(entity_name, filepath, tags=None):
    """Generate a meaningful description for an entity based on its name and context."""
    if not entity_name:
        return ""
    
    entity_lower = entity_name.lower().strip()
    
    # Try known acronym expansion first
    acronym_key = entity_lower.replace('-', '').replace('_', '')
    if acronym_key in KNOWN_ACRONYMS:
        expansion = KNOWN_ACRONYMS[acronym_key]
        return f"{entity_name}: {expansion}"
    
    # Try partial acronym match (e.g., "auth" → "Authentication")
    for key, expansion in KNOWN_ACRONYMS.items():
        if entity_lower == key or entity_lower.startswith(key + '-') or entity_lower.endswith('-' + key):
            # Check if this is just the acronym alone
            if entity_lower == key or entity_lower == key + 's':
                return f"{entity_name}: {expansion}"
    
    # Check topic patterns
    for pattern, topic in TOPIC_PATTERNS.items():
        if re.search(pattern, entity_lower):
            # Check if it has a version number suffix
            version_match = re.search(r'[-](\d+)$', entity_name)
            if version_match:
                return f"{entity_name}: A {topic} referenced in agent sessions (appears in {version_match.group(1)} sessions)"
            return f"{entity_name}: A {topic} referenced in agent sessions"
    
    # Check if it looks like a code construct
    if re.match(r'^[a-z]+[-_][a-z]+', entity_lower) and len(entity_lower) > 4:
        words = re.split(r'[-_]', entity_name)
        title_words = [w.capitalize() for w in words]
        return f"{entity_name}: A technical concept/code identifier ({' '.join(title_words)}) referenced in agent sessions"
    
    # Versioned entity
    version_match = re.search(r'[-](\d+)$', entity_name)
    if version_match:
        count = version_match.group(1)
        return f"{entity_name}: A concept/entity referenced in {count} agent session(s)"
    
    # Default
    return f"{entity_name}: A concept/entity referenced in agent session data"


def get_path_context(filepath):
    """Extract hierarchical context from the file path."""
    parts = filepath.replace(BUNDLE + '/', '').split('/')
    
    context = []
    for part in parts:
        if part and part not in ('wiki', 'domains', 'supercategories', 'categories', 'subcategories', 'index.md'):
            if part.endswith('.md'):
                part = part[:-3]
            context.append(part.replace('-', ' ').replace('_', ' ').title())
    
    return ' / '.join(context)


def enrich_file(abspath, apply=False, force=False):
    """Enrich a single entity file."""
    with open(abspath) as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Parse frontmatter
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', content, re.DOTALL)
    if not m:
        return None, "No frontmatter"
    
    fm_text = m.group(1)
    body = m.group(2) or ''
    
    # Parse frontmatter fields
    fm = {}
    for line in fm_text.split('\n'):
        if ':' in line:
            k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
            fm[k.strip()] = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    
    # Skip if already enriched (has meaningful description beyond just "referenced in session")
    current_desc = fm.get('description', '')
    if not force and current_desc and ':' in current_desc and len(current_desc) > 20:
        # Has a colon-formatted description (likely enriched already)
        return None, "Already enriched"
    
    if not force and len(body) > 200:
        return None, "Already has substantial body"
    
    title = fm.get('title', '')
    tags_str = fm.get('tags', '[]')
    tags = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in tags_str.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
    
    relpath = os.path.relpath(abspath, BUNDLE)
    path_context = get_path_context(relpath)
    
    # Generate new description
    new_desc = generate_description(title, relpath, tags)
    
    # Generate a body if it's empty or very thin
    new_body_lines = []
    
    if not body.strip() or len(body.strip()) < 50:
        new_body_lines.append(f"\n")
        new_body_lines.append(f"## Overview\n")
        new_body_lines.append(f"\n{new_desc}\n")
        
        # Add path context
        if path_context:
            new_body_lines.append(f"\n**Context**: {path_context}\n")
        
        # Add tags as categories
        if tags:
            tag_filter = [t for t in tags if t not in ('entity', 'acronym', 'ast')]
            if tag_filter:
                new_body_lines.append(f"\n**Related Topics**: {', '.join(sorted(set(tag_filter)))}\n")
    else:
        new_body_lines = [body]
    
    # Build new frontmatter with improved description
    new_fm_lines = []
    for line in fm_text.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('description:'):
            new_fm_lines.append(f'description: "{new_desc}"')
        elif line.startswith('title:'):
            new_fm_lines.append(line)
            new_fm_lines.append(f'description: "{new_desc}"')
        else:
            new_fm_lines.append(line)
    
    # Deduplicate description if it was added twice
    seen_keys = set()
    deduped = []
    for line in new_fm_lines:
        key = line.split(':')[0] if ':' in line else ''
        if key and key in seen_keys and key == 'description':
            continue
        seen_keys.add(key) if key else None
        deduped.append(line)
    new_fm_lines = deduped
    
    new_body = ''.join(new_body_lines)
    new_content = f"---\n{chr(10).join(new_fm_lines)}\n---\n{new_body}\n"
    
    # Stats
    old_len = len(content)
    new_len = len(new_content)
    
    if apply:
        with open(abspath, 'w') as f:
            f.write(new_content)
    
    return {
        'path': relpath,
        'title': title,
        'old_size': old_len,
        'new_size': new_len,
        'description': new_desc,
    }, "enriched"


def main():
    apply = '--apply' in sys.argv
    force = '--force' in sys.argv
    
    if apply:
        print("🔧 Enrich mode — will modify files")
    else:
        print("🔍 Dry run — use --apply to write changes")
    
    if force:
        print("  Force mode — re-enrich even already-rich files")
    
    total = 0
    enriched = 0
    skipped = 0
    errors = 0
    
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(DOMAINS_DIR):
        for fn in files:
            if not fn.endswith('.md'):
                continue
            abspath = os.path.join(root, fn)
            total += 1
            
            result, status = enrich_file(abspath, apply=apply, force=force)
            if result:
                enriched += 1
                if apply:
                    print(f"  ✅ {result['path']} ({result['old_size']}→{result['new_size']}b)")
                else:
                    print(f"  📄 {result['path']} → would enrich ({result['old_size']}→{result['new_size']}b)")
            elif status == "Already enriched":
                skipped += 1
            elif status == "Already has substantial body":
                skipped += 1
            else:
                errors += 1
    
    print(f"\n{'═'*50}")
    print(f"  Total files: {total}")
    print(f"  Enriched:    {enriched}")
    print(f"  Skipped:     {skipped}")
    print(f"  Errors:      {errors}")
    
    if not apply:
        print(f"\n  Run with --apply to write changes")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""External knowledge integration for mykb — PyPI, npm, GitHub APIs.
"""
import os, re, json, sys
from datetime import datetime

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki')

def fetch_json(url, timeout=10):
    """Fetch JSON from URL with error handling."""
    try:
        import urllib.request
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'mykb/1.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            return json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    except Exception as e:
        return {'error': str(e)}

class PyPIClient:
    """Python Package Index client."""
    
    def get(self, package_name):
        """Get package metadata from PyPI."""
        url = f"https://pypi.org/pypi/{package_name}/json"
        data = fetch_json(url)
        if 'error' in data:
            return None
        info = data.get('info', {})
        return {
            'name': info.get('name', package_name),
            'version': info.get('version', ''),
            'summary': info.get('summary', ''),
            'home_page': info.get('home_page', ''),
            'project_urls': info.get('project_urls', {}),
            'requires_dist': info.get('requires_dist', []),
            'requires_python': info.get('requires_python', ''),
            'license': info.get('license', ''),
            'downloads': info.get('downloads', {}),
            'source': 'pypi',
        }

class NPMClient:
    """npm registry client."""
    
    def get(self, package_name):
        url = f"https://registry.npmjs.org/{package_name}"
        data = fetch_json(url)
        if 'error' in data:
            return None
        latest = data.get('versions', {}).get(data.get('dist-tags', {}).get('latest', ''), {})
        return {
            'name': data.get('name', package_name),
            'version': data.get('dist-tags', {}).get('latest', ''),
            'description': latest.get('description', ''),
            'homepage': latest.get('homepage', ''),
            'license': latest.get('license', ''),
            'dependencies': list(latest.get('dependencies', {}).keys()),
            'source': 'npm',
        }

def guess_package_type(entity_title):
    """Guess if an entity is a Python or npm package based on patterns."""
    # Python packages: lowercase, underscores
    if re.match(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]+$', entity_title):
        # Common Python packages
        python_keywords = ['fastapi', 'pydantic', 'uvicorn', 'sqlalchemy', 'pytest', 'flask',
                          'django', 'numpy', 'pandas', 'scipy', 'torch', 'transformers',
                          'celery', 'redis', 'requests', 'click', 'typer', 'black', 'ruff',
                          'mypy', 'alembic', 'gunicorn', 'boto', 'jinja', 'pillow']
        if entity_title.lower() in python_keywords:
            return 'pypi'
    # npm packages: @scope/name or kebab-case
    if re.match(r'^@?[a-z][a-z0-9-]+$', entity_title):
        return 'npm'
    return None

def enrich_entity(entity_slug, entity_title):
    """Enrich a single entity with external data."""
    pkg_type = guess_package_type(entity_title)
    if not pkg_type:
        return None
    
    data = None
    if pkg_type == 'pypi':
        client = PyPIClient()
        data = client.get(entity_title.lower())
    elif pkg_type == 'npm':
        client = NPMClient()
        data = client.get(entity_title.lower())
    
    if not data:
        return None
    
    return data

def format_external_section(data):
    """Format external data as markdown section."""
    lines = ['\n## External References\n']
    
    if data.get('source') == 'pypi':
        lines.append(f'- **Package**: [{data["name"]}](https://pypi.org/project/{data["name"]}/)')
        lines.append(f'- **Version**: {data.get("version", "?")}')
        if data.get('summary'):
            lines.append(f'- **Summary**: {data["summary"]}')
        if data.get('home_page'):
            lines.append(f'- **Homepage**: [{data["home_page"]}]({data["home_page"]})')
        if data.get('requires_python'):
            lines.append(f'- **Python**: {data["requires_python"]}')
        if data.get('license'):
            lines.append(f'- **License**: {data["license"]}')
        if data.get('requires_dist'):
            deps = [d.split(';')[0].strip() for d in data['requires_dist'][:10]]
            lines.append(f'- **Dependencies**: {", ".join(deps)}')
    
    elif data.get('source') == 'npm':
        lines.append(f'- **Package**: [{data["name"]}](https://www.npmjs.com/package/{data["name"]})')
        lines.append(f'- **Version**: {data.get("version", "?")}')
        if data.get('description'):
            lines.append(f'- **Description**: {data["description"]}')
        if data.get('homepage'):
            lines.append(f'- **Homepage**: [{data["homepage"]}]({data["homepage"]})')
    
    return '\n'.join(lines)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    # Test with a known entity
    test_entities = [
        ('entities/fastapi-10', 'FastAPI'),
        ('entities/pytest-2', 'pytest'),
        ('entities/react-2', 'react'),
    ]
    for slug, title in test_entities:
        print(f"\n=== {title} ===")
        data = enrich_entity(slug, title)
        if data:
            print(f"  Found: {data.get('name')} v{data.get('version')} ({data.get('source')})")
            print(f"  Summary: {data.get('summary', 'N/A')[:100]}")
        else:
            print(f"  No external data found")

];

// ── Extraction: tech terms ──────────────────────────────────────────

function extractTechTerms(text) {
  if (!text) return [];
  const candidates = new Map(); // term → count
  const inMidSentence = new Map(); // term → count (for terms appearing mid-sentence)

  // Scan for capitalized words with mid-sentence context
  // A word is "mid-sentence" if preceded by a lowercase letter, number, or punctuation
  const midSentence = /[a-z0-9,;:]\s+([A-Z][a-z]{2,})\b/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = midSentence.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const word = m[1];
    if (!STOP_WORDS.has(word) && word.length >= 3) {
      inMidSentence.set(word, (inMidSentence.get(word) || 0) + 1);
    }
  }

  // Multi-word capitalized phrases
  while ((m = MULTI_CAP.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const phrase = m[1].trim();
    if (phrase.length >= 3 && phrase.length <= 50 && !STOP_WORDS.has(phrase.split(/\s+/)[0])) {
      // Check: at least one non-stop word in the phrase
      const words = phrase.split(/\s+/);
      const meaningful = words.filter(w => !STOP_WORDS.has(w));
      if (meaningful.length >= 1) {
        candidates.set(phrase, (candidates.get(phrase) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  // Mixed-case identifiers (TypeORM, FastAPI, etc.)
  while ((m = MIXED_CASE.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const term = m[1];
    if (term.length >= 4 && !STOP_WORDS.has(term)) {
      candidates.set(term, (candidates.get(term) || 0) + 3); // weighted — high signal
    }
  }

  // Single capitalized words — only if they appear mid-sentence with enough frequency
  for (const [word, count] of inMidSentence) {
    // Only accept single caps that appear mid-sentence at least once
    candidates.set(word, (candidates.get(word) || 0) + Math.min(count, 2));
  }

  // Score & filter: keep only terms that seem like genuine tech references
  const result = [...candidates.entries()]
    .filter(([term, score]) => {
      // Must score at least 1
      if (score < 1) return false;
      // Must be 3+ chars
      if (term.length < 3) return false;
      // Skip pure stop-words
      if (STOP_WORDS.has(term)) return false;
      return true;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]) // highest score first
    .map(([term]) => term)
    .slice(0, 25);

  // De-duplicate by lowercase
  const seen = new Set();
  return result.filter(t => {
    const key = t.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  });
}

// ── Other extractors ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function extractAcronyms(text) {
  if (!text) return [];
  const found = new Set();
  const midSentence = /[a-z0-9]\s+([A-Z]{2,5})\b/g;
  let m;
  while ((m = midSentence.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const acr = m[1];
    if (!STOP_WORDS.has(acr) && acr.length >= 2) found.add(acr);
  }
  return [...found].sort();
}

function extractDecisions(text) {
  if (!text) return [];
  const found = [];
  let m;
  while ((m = DECISION_PAT.exec(text)) !== null) {
    found.push({ action: m[1].toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' '), target: m[2].trim() });
  }
  return found;
}

function extractFilePaths(text) {
  if (!text) return [];
  const found = new Set();
  let m;
  while ((m = INLINE_CODE.exec(text)) !== null) {
    const code = m[1];
    if (code.includes('/') || code.includes('\\') || code.includes('.')) {
      found.add(code);
    }
  }
  return [...found];
}

function extractUrls(text) {
  if (!text) return [];
  const found = new Set();
  let m;
  while ((m = URL_PAT.exec(text)) !== null) found.add(m[0]);
  return [...found];
}

function extractTags(text) {
  if (!text) return [];
  const found = new Set();
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  for (const kw of TECH_KEYWORDS) {
    if (lower.includes(kw)) found.add(kw);
  }
  return [...found].sort();
}

function extractToolUsage(turns) {
  const counts = {};
  for (const t of turns) {
    if (t.tool) counts[t.tool] = (counts[t.tool] || 0) + 1;
  }
  return counts;
}

function describeTurn(turn) {
  const tool = turn.tool || 'unknown';
  const content = (turn.content || '').substring(0, 80).replace(/\n/g, ' ').trim();
  const response = (turn.response || '').substring(0, 60).replace(/\n/g, ' ').trim();
  return { tool, content: content || '(no content)', response: response || '(done)' };
}

// ── Session analysis ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function analyzeSession(turns) {
  const allContent = turns.map(t => t.content || '').join('\n');
  const allResponses = turns.map(t => t.response || '').join('\n');
  const fullText = allContent + '\n' + allResponses;

  return {
    techTerms: extractTechTerms(fullText),
    acronyms: extractAcronyms(fullText),
    decisions: extractDecisions(fullText),
    filePaths: extractFilePaths(fullText),
    urls: extractUrls(fullText),
    tags: extractTags(fullText),
    toolUsage: extractToolUsage(turns),
    turnTitles: turns.map(t => describeTurn(t)),
    turnCount: turns.length,
    totalChars: fullText.length,
    sessionHash: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fullText).digest('hex').substring(0, 12),
  };
}

// ── Concept generation ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function generateConcepts(analysis, sessionId) {
  const concepts = [];
  const ts = new Date().toISOString();
  const shortId = sessionId.substring(0, 8);
  const sessionSlug = `session-${shortId}`;
  const seenConcepts = new Set();

  function make(type, title, desc, extraTags, body, resource) {
    const key = type + '::' + title.toLowerCase();
    if (seenConcepts.has(key)) return null;
    seenConcepts.add(key);
    return {
      type,
      title: title.substring(0, 80),
      description: desc ? desc.substring(0, 200) : '',
      tags: [...new Set([type, ...(extraTags || []), ...analysis.tags])].slice(0, 6),
      timestamp: ts,
      body: body || `# ${title}\n\nAuto-extracted from agent session [${shortId}](${sessionSlug}).`,
      resource: resource || '',
    };
  }

  // 1. Session
  const turnSummary = analysis.turnTitles.map((t, i) =>
    `${i + 1}. **${t.tool}**: ${t.content}`
  ).join('\n');
  concepts.push(make(
    'session', `Session ${shortId}`,
    `Agent session with ${analysis.turnCount} turns — ${analysis.tags.slice(0, 5).join(', ') || 'general'}`,
    [],
    `# Session ${shortId}\n\n## Summary\n- **Turns**: ${analysis.turnCount}\n- **Tools**: ${JSON.stringify(analysis.toolUsage)}\n\n## Turn log\n\n${turnSummary}\n\n## Tags\n${analysis.tags.map(t => `- ${t}`).join('\n')}`,
    `codex://session/${sessionId}`
  ));

  // 2. Tools
  for (const [tool, count] of Object.entries(analysis.toolUsage)) {
    if (count === 0) continue;
    concepts.push(make(
      'tool', `${tool} (×${count})`,
      `Tool used ${count} time(s) in session ${shortId}`,
      ['tool'],
      `# ${tool}\n\nUsed **${count}×** in session [${shortId}](${sessionSlug}).`
    ));
  }

  // 3. Tech terms
  for (const term of analysis.techTerms.slice(0, 12)) {
    concepts.push(make(
      'entity', term,
      `Referenced in session ${shortId}`,
      ['entity'],
      `# ${term}\n\nReferenced in agent session [${shortId}](${sessionSlug}).\n\nRelated: ${analysis.tags.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}.`
    ));
  }

  // 4. Acronyms
  for (const acr of analysis.acronyms.slice(0, 8)) {
    concepts.push(make(
      'entity', acr,
      `Acronym referenced in session ${shortId}`,
      ['entity', 'acronym']
    ));
  }

  // 5. Decisions
  for (const dec of analysis.decisions.slice(0, 8)) {
    const target = dec.target.substring(0, 80);
    concepts.push(make(
      'decision', `${dec.action} ${target.substring(0, 50)}`,
      `Decision: ${dec.action} ${target.substring(0, 120)}`,
      ['decision'],
      `# Decision\n\n**Action**: ${dec.action}\n**Target**: ${target}\n\nFrom session [${shortId}](${sessionSlug}).`
    ));
  }

  // 6. Topics (only tags that look like meaningful topics, not generic)
  const meaningfulTags = analysis.tags.filter(t =>
    !['api', 'cli', 'sdk', 'ui', 'ux', 'json', 'yaml', 'xml', 'css', 'html'].includes(t)
  );
  for (const tag of meaningfulTags.slice(0, 5)) {
    concepts.push(make(
      'topic', tag,
      `Topic discussed in session ${shortId}`,
      ['topic']
    ));
  }

  return concepts.filter(Boolean);
}

module.exports = { analyzeSession, generateConcepts, extractTechTerms, extractDecisions, extractTags };

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fixed viewer for mykb."""
import os, json, re, sys, mimetypes
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki')
PORT = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8809

print("Scanning...", flush=True)
concepts = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(WIKI):
    for fn in sorted(files):
        if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
        try:
            text = open(os.path.join(root, fn), encoding='utf-8').read()
        except: continue
        m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
        if not m: continue
        fm = {}
        for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
            if ':' not in line: continue
            k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
            k = k.strip()
            v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
            if k == 'tags':
                v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
            fm[k] = v
        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, fn), WIKI)
        concepts.append({
            'id': rel[:-3],
            'title': fm.get('title', ''),
            'desc': fm.get('description', ''),
            'type': fm.get('type', ''),
            'tags': fm.get('tags', []),
        })

concepts_json = json.dumps(concepts)
stats = {}
for c in concepts:
    t = c['type']
    stats[t] = stats.get(t, 0) + 1
stats['total'] = len(concepts)
stats_json = json.dumps(stats)

print(f"{len(concepts)} concepts ({len(concepts_json)}b)", flush=True)

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        path = self.path.split('?')[0]
        if path == '/api/concepts':
            self.send_json(concepts_json)
        elif path == '/api/stats':
            self.send_json(stats_json)
        else:
            self.serve_file(path)
    
    def send_json(self, data):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data.encode())
    
    def serve_file(self, path):
        if path == '/':
            path = '/index.html'
        filepath = BUNDLE + path
        if not os.path.isfile(filepath) or '../' in path:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
                data = f.read()
            ctype, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(filepath)
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype or 'application/octet-stream')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)
        except:
            self.send_response(500)
            self.end_headers()
    
    def log_message(self, format, *args): pass

print(f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}", flush=True)
HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', PORT), Handler).serve_forever()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""mykb Gap Detector — finds knowledge gaps, generates questions, cross-session synthesis.
"""
import os, re, json, sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki')

def parse_md(path):
    try: text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    except: return None
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not m: return None
    fm = {}
    for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
        if ':' not in line: continue
        k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k == 'tags':
            v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
        fm[k] = v
    return {'fm': fm, 'body': (m.group(2) or '').strip()}

def scan_entities():
    """Scan all entity files and return structured data."""
    entities = []
    ent_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'entities')
    for fn in os.listdir(ent_dir):
        if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
        p = parse_md(os.path.join(ent_dir, fn))
        if p:
            body = p['body']
            session_refs = re.findall(r'session-([\w-]+)', body)
            has_overview = '## Overview' in body
            has_context = '## Context' in body
            body_len = len(body)
            is_auto = 'Auto-extracted' in body or 'Referenced in' in body and not has_overview and not has_context
            entities.append({
                'slug': fn.replace('.md', ''),
                'title': p['fm'].get('title', ''),
                'tags': p['fm'].get('tags', []),
                'body_len': body_len,
                'has_overview': has_overview,
                'has_context': has_context,
                'session_count': len(session_refs),
                'is_stub': is_auto and body_len < 500,
                'desc': p['fm'].get('description', ''),
            })
    return entities

def scan_sessions():
    """Scan all session files."""
    sessions = []
    ses_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'sessions')
    for fn in os.listdir(ses_dir):
        if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
        p = parse_md(os.path.join(ses_dir, fn))
        if p:
            tags = [t.lower().replace('.', '') for t in p['fm'].get('tags', []) 
                    if t not in ('session', '') and not t.endswith('.')]
            sessions.append({
                'slug': fn.replace('.md', ''),
                'title': p['fm'].get('title', ''),
                'tags': list(set(tags)),
                'turns': len(re.findall(r'^\d+\.\s+\*\*', p['body'], re.MULTILINE)),
            })
    return sessions

def detect_gaps(entities):
    """Find knowledge gaps."""
    gaps = {
        'low_coverage': [],   # Referenced often but poorly described
        'missing_tags': [],    # No domain tags
        'orphans': [],         # No connections to other entities
        'stubs': [],           # Auto-extracted with minimal body
        'acronyms': [],        # All-caps short names with no definition
    }
    
    for e in entities:
        # Low coverage: 3+ sessions but < 500 body
        if e['session_count'] >= 3 and e['body_len'] < 500:
            gaps['low_coverage'].append(e)
        
        # Stubs: auto-extracted with minimal content
        if e['is_stub']:
            gaps['stubs'].append(e)
        
        # Acronyms: all-caps, short, no overview
        if re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,6}$', e['title']) and not e['has_overview']:
            gaps['acronyms'].append(e)
        
        # Missing tags
        if not e['tags'] or len(e['tags']) <= 2:
            gaps['missing_tags'].append(e)
    
    return gaps

def detect_session_clusters(sessions, min_cluster_size=5):
    """Cluster sessions by tag overlap."""
    clusters = defaultdict(list)
    
    for s in sessions:
        # Use sorted tags as cluster key
        key = tuple(sorted(s['tags']))
        for existing_key in list(clusters.keys()):
            overlap = len(set(key) & set(existing_key))
            if overlap >= 3:  # 3+ shared tags = same cluster
                key = existing_key
                break
        clusters[key].append(s)
    
    # Only keep substantial clusters
    return {k: v for k, v in clusters.items() if len(v) >= min_cluster_size}

def generate_questions(gaps):
    """Generate questions for gaps."""
    questions = []
    
    for e in gaps['low_coverage'][:20]:
        questions.append({
            'entity': e['title'],
            'slug': e['slug'],
            'question': f"What is {e['title']} and how is it used in your workflow?",
            'priority': 'high',
            'reason': f"Referenced in {e['session_count']} sessions but body is only {e['body_len']} bytes",
        })
    
    for e in gaps['acronyms'][:20]:
        questions.append({
            'entity': e['title'],
            'slug': e['slug'],
            'question': f"What does {e['title']} stand for in your development context?",
            'priority': 'medium',
            'reason': f"Acronym with no definition in {e['session_count']} sessions",
        })
    
    return questions

def write_questions(questions):
    """Write questions to wiki/questions/open-questions.md."""
    q_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'questions')
    os.makedirs(q_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    lines = [
        '---',
        'type: "index"',
        'title: "Open Questions"',
        'description: "Auto-generated knowledge gaps requiring user input"',
        'tags: ["questions", "gap-analysis"]',
        '---',
        '',
        f'# Open Questions',
        '',
        f'_Generated: {datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")}_',
        f'_Total: {len(questions)} questions_',
        '',
    ]
    
    for q in questions:
        lines.append(f'## {q["entity"]} (Priority: {q["priority"]})')
        lines.append(f'- **Question**: {q["question"]}')
        lines.append(f'- **Slug**: `{q["slug"]}`')
        lines.append(f'- **Reason**: {q["reason"]}')
        lines.append('')
    
    path = os.path.join(q_dir, 'open-questions.md')
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    print(f"  Wrote {len(questions)} questions to {path}", flush=True)
    return path

def write_gap_report(gaps):
    """Write gap analysis report."""
    lines = [
        '---',
        'type: "log"',
        'title: "Gap Analysis Report"',
        'description: "Auto-generated knowledge gap analysis"',
        'tags: ["gap-analysis", "curation"]',
        '---',
        '',
        f'# Gap Analysis Report',
        '',
        f'_Generated: {datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")}_',
        '',
        '## Summary',
        '',
        f'| Gap Type | Count |',
        '|----------|-------|',
        f'| Low coverage (3+ sessions, <500b body) | {len(gaps["low_coverage"])} |',
        f'| Stubs (auto-extracted, minimal body) | {len(gaps["stubs"])} |',
        f'| Acronyms without definition | {len(gaps["acronyms"])} |',
        f'| Entities with few/no tags | {len(gaps["missing_tags"])} |',
        '',
    ]
    
    if gaps['low_coverage']:
        lines.append('## Low Coverage Entities')
        lines.append('')
        for e in sorted(gaps['low_coverage'], key=lambda x: -x['session_count'])[:30]:
            lines.append(f'- **{e["title"]}** ({e["session_count"]} sessions, {e["body_len"]}b body)')
        lines.append('')
    
    path = os.path.join(WIKI, 'ops', 'gap-report.md')
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
    print(f"  Wrote gap report to {path}", flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print("Scanning entities...", flush=True)
    entities = scan_entities()
    sessions = scan_sessions()
    
    print(f"  {len(entities)} entities, {len(sessions)} sessions", flush=True)
    
    gaps = detect_gaps(entities)
    print(f"  Low coverage: {len(gaps['low_coverage'])}")
    print(f"  Stubs: {len(gaps['stubs'])}")
    print(f"  Acronyms: {len(gaps['acronyms'])}")
    print(f"  Missing tags: {len(gaps['missing_tags'])}")
    
    questions = generate_questions(gaps)
    write_questions(questions)
    write_gap_report(gaps)
    
    clusters = detect_session_clusters(sessions)
    print(f"  Session clusters: {len(clusters)}")
    for tags, sess_list in sorted(clusters.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1]))[:5]:
        print(f"    {', '.join(tags[:4])}: {len(sess_list)} sessions")
    
    print("Gap analysis complete.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""mykb Graph Engine — co-occurrence graph, community detection, traversal.
Uses networkx (available) for graph operations.
"""
import os, re, json, sys
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
import networkx as nx
from networkx.algorithms.community import greedy_modularity_communities

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
BUNDLE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
WIKI = os.path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki')
GRAPH_PATH = os.path.join(BUNDLE, '.wiki-daemon', 'graph.json')
COMMUNITY_DIR = os.path.join(WIKI, 'communities')

def parse_md(path):
    try: text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    except: return None
    m = re.match(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\n?(.*)', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not m: return None
    fm = {}
    for line in m.group(1).split('\n'):
        if ':' not in line: continue
        k, v = line.strip().split(':', 1)
        k = k.strip()
        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if k == 'tags':
            v = [t.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for t in v.strip('[]').split(',') if t.strip()]
        fm[k] = v
    return {'fm': fm, 'body': (m.group(2) or '').strip()}

def build_cooccurrence_graph():
    """Build entity co-occurrence graph from session data."""
    G = nx.Graph()
    
    # Get all session files and extract entity references from bodies
    session_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'sessions')
    entity_dir = os.path.join(WIKI, 'entities')
    
    # Build session→entity map 
    session_entities = defaultdict(set)
    entity_titles = {}
    
    for fn in os.listdir(entity_dir):
        if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
        p = parse_md(os.path.join(entity_dir, fn))
        if p:
            slug = fn.replace('.md', '')
            title = p['fm'].get('title', slug).lower()
            entity_titles[slug] = title
            # Parse entity body for session refs
            session_refs = set(re.findall(r'session-([\w-]+)', p['body']))
            for s in session_refs:
                session_entities[s].add(slug)
    
    # Build co-occurrence edges
    print("Building co-occurrence graph...", flush=True)
    edge_weights = Counter()
    edge_sessions = defaultdict(set)
    
    for s_slug, e_slugs in session_entities.items():
        e_slugs = list(e_slugs)
        for i in range(len(e_slugs)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(e_slugs)):
                pair = tuple(sorted([e_slugs[i], e_slugs[j]]))
                edge_weights[pair] += 1
                edge_sessions[pair].add(s_slug)
    
    # Add nodes and edges to graph
    for slug, title in entity_titles.items():
        G.add_node(slug, title=title, type='entity')
    
    for (e1, e2), weight in edge_weights.items():
        if weight >= 2:  # Only edges with 2+ co-occurrences
            G.add_edge(e1, e2, weight=weight, sessions=list(edge_sessions[(e1, e2)]))
    
    print(f"  Graph: {G.number_of_nodes()} nodes, {G.number_of_edges()} edges", flush=True)
    return G, entity_titles

def detect_communities(G, min_community_size=3):
    """Detect communities using greedy modularity optimization."""
    communities = list(greedy_modularity_communities(G, weight='weight'))
    
    # Filter small communities
    communities = [c for c in communities if len(c) >= min_community_size]
    
    # Sort by size descending
    communities.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    
    community_map = {}  # entity_id -> community_id
    for i, comm in enumerate(communities):
        community_map[i] = list(comm)
        for entity_id in comm:
            entity_id_clean = entity_id.replace('-', '_')
            # Store community membership in entity data
            pass  # Will write to frontmatter later
    
    print(f"  Communities detected: {len(communities)}", flush=True)
    return communities, community_map

def save_graph(G, path=GRAPH_PATH):
    """Save graph to JSON format."""
    data = {
        'nodes': [{'id': n, 'title': G.nodes[n].get('title', n)} for n in G.nodes()],
        'edges': [{'source': u, 'target': v, 'weight': d['weight'], 
                   'sessions': list(d.get('sessions', []))[:5]} 
                  for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)]
    }
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(data, f)
    print(f"  Saved {len(data['nodes'])} nodes, {len(data['edges'])} edges to {path}", flush=True)

def load_graph(path=GRAPH_PATH):
    """Load graph from JSON format."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None, {}
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    G = nx.Graph()
    for n in data['nodes']:
        G.add_node(n['id'], title=n.get('title', n['id']))
    for e in data['edges']:
        G.add_edge(e['source'], e['target'], weight=e.get('weight', 1), sessions=e.get('sessions', []))
    return G, {n['id']: n.get('title', n['id']) for n in data['nodes']}

def neighborhood(G, entity_id, hops=2):
    """Get k-hop neighborhood of an entity."""
    if entity_id not in G:
        return []
    visited = {entity_id: 0}
    queue = [entity_id]
    while queue:
        current = queue.pop(0)
        depth = visited[current]
        if depth >= hops:
            continue
        for neighbor in G.neighbors(current):
            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited[neighbor] = depth + 1
                queue.append(neighbor)
    return [{'id': nid, 'title': G.nodes[nid].get('title', nid), 'depth': d} 
            for nid, d in visited.items() if nid != entity_id]

def shortest_path(G, entity_a, entity_b):
    """Find shortest path between two entities."""
    try:
        path = nx.shortest_path(G, source=entity_a, target=entity_b, weight='weight')
        return [{'id': nid, 'title': G.nodes[nid].get('title', nid)} for nid in path]
    except (nx.NodeNotFound, nx.NetworkXNoPath):
        return None

def central_entities(G, top_n=20):
    """Get most central entities by degree centrality."""
    centrality = nx.degree_centrality(G)
    sorted_cent = sorted(centrality.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])
    return [{'id': nid, 'title': G.nodes[nid].get('title', nid), 'centrality': round(c, 4)} 
            for nid, c in sorted_cent[:top_n]]

def bridge_entities(G, community_a, community_b):
    """Find entities that connect two communities."""
    bridges = []
    for n in G.nodes():
        neighbors = set(G.neighbors(n))
        in_a = len(neighbors & community_a)
        in_b = len(neighbors & community_b)
        if in_a > 0 and in_b > 0:
            bridges.append({
                'id': n,
                'title': G.nodes[n].get('title', n),
                'connections': {'to_a': in_a, 'to_b': in_b}
            })
    bridges.sort(key=lambda x: x['connections']['to_a'] + x['connections']['to_b'], reverse=True)
    return bridges

def write_community_summaries(communities, entity_titles, G):
    """Write community index pages with LLM summaries."""
    os.makedirs(COMMUNITY_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Write overview
    overview = f"# Knowledge Communities\n\n{len(communities)} communities detected via modularity optimization.\n\n"
    for i, comm in enumerate(communities):
        comm_name = f"Community {i+1}"
        overview += f"- **[{comm_name}](community-{i:03d}/index.md)**: {len(comm)} entities\n"
    
    with open(os.path.join(COMMUNITY_DIR, 'index.md'), 'w') as f:
        f.write(f'---\ntype: "index"\ntitle: "Knowledge Communities"\ndescription: "{len(communities)} entity communities detected via graph modularity"\ntags: ["graph", "community", "clustering"]\n---\n\n{overview}')
    
    for i, comm in enumerate(communities):
        comm_dir = os.path.join(COMMUNITY_DIR, f'community-{i:03d}')
        os.makedirs(comm_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        entity_list = []
        for eid in comm:
            title = entity_titles.get(eid, eid)
            # Get neighbors within community
            neighbors_in_comm = [entity_titles.get(n, n) for n in G.neighbors(eid) if n in comm]
            entity_list.append(f"- **{title}** ({eid}) — connected to {', '.join(neighbors_in_comm[:5])}")
        
        body = f"# Community {i+1}\n\n{len(comm)} entities.\n\n## Entities\n\n" + "\n".join(sorted(entity_list))
        
        with open(os.path.join(comm_dir, 'index.md'), 'w') as f:
            f.write(f'---\ntype: "community"\ntitle: "Community {i+1}"\ndescription: "Group of {len(comm)} related entities"\ntags: ["community", "graph"]\n---\n\n{body}')
    
    print(f"  Wrote {len(communities)} community pages to {COMMUNITY_DIR}", flush=True)


# ── Main ──
if __name__ == '__main__':
    G, entity_titles = build_cooccurrence_graph()
    save_graph(G)
    communities, community_map = detect_communities(G)
    write_community_summaries(communities, entity_titles, G)
    
    # Central entities  
    print("\nMost central entities:")
    for e in central_entities(G, 10):
        print(f"  {e['title']:30s} centrality={e['centrality']}")
    
    print("\nGraph engine ready.")

#!/usr/bin/env node
// import-gemini.js — Import Gemini CLI session history into the OKF bundle
// Reads JSONL files from ~/.gemini/tmp/ and processes each session
// through the same extraction pipeline as the live daemon.
//
// Usage: node .wiki-daemon/import-gemini.js [--dry-run] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--max N] [--summary]

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { analyzeSession, generateConcepts } = require('./extract');
const { writeConcepts, appendToLog } = require('./store');

const CONFIG = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'config.json'), 'utf8'));
const BUNDLE = CONFIG.bundle_path;
const GEMINI_DIR = path.join(process.env.HOME || path.resolve(__dirname, '../..'), '.gemini', 'tmp');

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const DRY_RUN = args.includes('--dry-run');
const SINCE = args.includes('--since') ? new Date(args[args.indexOf('--since') + 1]) : null;
const MAX = args.includes('--max') ? parseInt(args[args.indexOf('--max') + 1], 10) : Infinity;
const SUMMARY = args.includes('--summary');

// ── Safe string conversion ──

function safeString(val, maxLen) {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.substring(0, maxLen || 10000);
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    try { return JSON.stringify(val).substring(0, maxLen || 10000); }
    catch { return String(val).substring(0, maxLen || 10000); }
  }
  return String(val).substring(0, maxLen || 10000);
}

// ── Find all Gemini session JSONL files ──

function findSessionFiles() {
  const files = [];
  function walk(dir) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return;
    for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
      if (e.isDirectory()) walk(full);
      else if (e.name.endsWith('.jsonl') && e.name.startsWith('session-')) {
        files.push(full);
      }
    }
  }
  walk(GEMINI_DIR);
  files.sort();
  return files;
}

// ── Parse Gemini JSONL format ──

function parseSession(filePath) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').trim();
  if (!content) return null;

  const lines = content.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());
  const events = lines.map(l => {
    try { return JSON.parse(l); } catch { return null; }
  }).filter(Boolean);

  // Extract session metadata from first line
  const meta = events[0];
  if (!meta || !meta.sessionId) return null;

  const sessionId = meta.sessionId;
  const startTime = meta.startTime || '';

  // Derive project name from file path
  const relPath = path.relative(GEMINI_DIR, filePath);
  const projectDir = relPath.split(path.sep)[0];
  const projectName = projectDir || 'default';

  // Build a thread name
  const threadName = `${projectName} — ${path.basename(filePath, '.jsonl')}`;

  // Group events into turns
  const turns = [];
  let pendingUser = null;
  let pendingToolCalls = [];
  let pendingAssistantContent = '';

  function flushPending() {
    // 1. User message turn
    if (pendingUser && pendingUser.trim()) {
      turns.push({
        tool: 'user',
        content: pendingUser.trim().substring(0, 10000),
        response: '',
      });
    }

    // 2. Tool call turns (each tool call is a separate turn)
    for (const tc of pendingToolCalls) {
      const argsStr = safeString(tc.args, 5000);
      const resultStr = safeString(tc.result, 5000);
      turns.push({
        tool: tc.tool || 'tool',
        content: argsStr,
        response: resultStr,
      });
    }

    // 3. Assistant response turn (text content)
    if (pendingAssistantContent && pendingAssistantContent.trim()) {
      turns.push({
        tool: 'assistant',
        content: '',
        response: pendingAssistantContent.trim().substring(0, 10000),
      });
    }

    pendingUser = null;
    pendingToolCalls = [];
    pendingAssistantContent = '';
  }

  for (const ev of events) {
    // Skip metadata and state updates
    if (ev.$set) continue;
    if (ev.sessionId) continue;

    const type = ev.type || '';

    if (type === 'user') {
      // Flush previous pending group before starting a new one
      if (pendingUser || pendingAssistantContent || pendingToolCalls.length > 0) {
        flushPending();
      }
      const texts = (ev.content || [])
        .filter(c => c && c.text)
        .map(c => c.text)
        .join('\n');
      pendingUser = texts.trim();
    } else if (type === 'gemini') {
      const geminiContent = typeof ev.content === 'string' ? ev.content : '';

      if (geminiContent && geminiContent.trim()) {
        pendingAssistantContent += '\n' + geminiContent.trim();
      }

      // Process tool calls from this gemini response
      const toolCalls = ev.toolCalls || [];
      for (const tc of toolCalls) {
        // resultDisplay can be a string OR an object (like {"fileDiff": "..."})
        // result is often an array of functionResponse objects
        const resultStr = safeString(tc.resultDisplay) || safeString(tc.result, 5000);
        pendingToolCalls.push({
          tool: tc.name || 'unknown',
          args: tc.args || '',
          result: resultStr,
        });
      }
    } else if (type === 'info' || type === 'error' || type === 'warning') {
      // Treat as a system message
      if (pendingUser || pendingAssistantContent || pendingToolCalls.length > 0) {
        flushPending();
      }
      turns.push({
        tool: 'system',
        content: `${type}: ${ev.content || ''}`.substring(0, 10000),
        response: '',
      });
    }
  }

  // Flush last pending group
  flushPending();

  if (turns.length < 2) return null;

  return { sessionId, threadName, projectName, startTime, turns };
}

// ── Main ──

async function main() {
  console.log(`Bundle: ${BUNDLE}`);
  console.log(`Gemini sessions dir: ${GEMINI_DIR}`);
  console.log(`Dry run: ${DRY_RUN}`);
  if (SINCE) console.log(`Since: ${SINCE.toISOString().split('T')[0]}`);
  if (MAX !== Infinity) console.log(`Max: ${MAX}`);
  console.log('');

  const files = findSessionFiles();
  console.log(`Found ${files.length} Gemini session files`);

  // Load already-processed session IDs from existing session concepts
  const existingDir = path.join(BUNDLE, 'wiki', 'sessions');
  const processedIds = new Set();
  if (fs.existsSync(existingDir)) {
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(existingDir, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.name.endsWith('.md')) {
        try {
          const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(existingDir, e.name), 'utf8');
          const match = content.match(/resource:\s*"(?:codex|gemini):\/\/session\/([^"]+)"/);
          if (match) processedIds.add(match[1]);
        } catch {}
      }
    }
  }
  console.log(`Already processed: ${processedIds.size} session IDs in wiki`);
  console.log('');

  if (SUMMARY) {
    let potentialNew = 0;
    for (const file of files) {
      try {
        const parsed = parseSession(file);
        if (!parsed) continue;
        if (processedIds.has(parsed.sessionId)) continue;
        if (SINCE && new Date(parsed.startTime) < SINCE) continue;
        potentialNew++;
      } catch {}
    }
    console.log(`Sessions ready to import: ${potentialNew}`);
    return;
  }

  let imported = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let totalConcepts = 0;
  let errors = 0;

  for (const file of files) {
    if (imported >= MAX) break;

    try {
      const parsed = parseSession(file);
      if (!parsed) { skipped++; continue; }

      if (SINCE && new Date(parsed.startTime) < SINCE) { skipped++; continue; }
      if (processedIds.has(parsed.sessionId)) { skipped++; continue; }

      const analysis = analyzeSession(parsed.turns);
      const concepts = generateConcepts(analysis, parsed.sessionId);

      // Override session resource to gemini:// for dedup tracking
      for (const c of concepts) {
        if (c.type === 'session') {
          c.resource = `gemini://session/${parsed.sessionId}`;
        }
      }

      console.log(`[${imported + 1}/${files.length}] ${parsed.sessionId.substring(0, 12)} — ${parsed.threadName.substring(0, 50)}`);
      console.log(`  ${parsed.turns.length} turns → ${concepts.length} concepts | tools: ${JSON.stringify(analysis.toolUsage)}`);
      console.log(`  tags: ${analysis.tags.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
      console.log(`  terms: ${analysis.techTerms.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);

      if (!DRY_RUN) {
        const written = writeConcepts(concepts, BUNDLE);
        if (written.length > 0) {
          appendToLog(BUNDLE, written.map(w => ({
            action: 'Addition',
            description: `gemini-imported: ${path.basename(w, '.md')}`,
            linkText: path.basename(w, '.md'),
            linkUrl: path.relative(BUNDLE, w),
          })));
        }
        totalConcepts += written.length;
        console.log(`  wrote ${written.length} new concept files`);
      }

      imported++;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`  ERROR [${path.basename(file)}]: ${err.message}`);
      errors++;
    }
  }

  console.log('\n=== Summary ===');
  console.log(`Processed: ${imported} Gemini sessions`);
  console.log(`Skipped: ${skipped} (already done, too short, or filtered)`);
  console.log(`Errors: ${errors}`);
  if (!DRY_RUN) {
    console.log(`New concepts written: ${totalConcepts}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`(dry run — no files written)`);
  }
}

main().catch(err => { console.error('Fatal:', err); process.exit(1); });
